# Behavioral health coverage for employers

We’re breaking down the barriers that get in the way of getting quality mental health care. Explore
programs and resources that help members thrive, not just get by.

[Contact an Aetna rep ][77]

## Together, helping members feel better

Mental health has a powerful impact on the workplace, including extremely high costs to employers
for stress-related health care and missed work. Learn how we’re transforming the system.

### Aetna behavioral health case manager

Help arranging outpatient care, connecting with community resources and consulting with caregivers
after a hospital stay.

### Collaborative provider relationships

Service collaborations and technology to address gaps in mental health care and inconsistent
provider quality.

### Enhanced digital tools

Online resources to get the whole care team on the same page, in the same room.

### Streamlined utilization management

Support to ease the administrative burden of getting care, like claims payments and authorizations.

### Caregiver resources

Nationwide support with over 257,219 behavioral health providers and 89,196 EAP providers in
network.

### Ongoing peer support

Support and guidance from someone who’s tackled similar challenges.

## Always somewhere to turn

With these confidential resources, your members have anytime support for everyday challenges. And
you have a sound strategy to boost workplace wellness, productivity and savings.
* ### Employee assistance program

Members can meet with a counselor in confidence by phone, video or in person about work, family or
personal issues. They can also get legal help, financial assistance, and referrals to local
psychologists.
* ### Telehealth/virtual counseling

Members can get personalized mental well-being health counseling services from anywhere — on their
schedule — to help manage overwhelming health and life events.

## A healthy foundation

Help your members feel their physical and emotional best with a mix of whole-health plans, programs
and services, only from Aetna.
* ### Member services

Keep your members healthy and engaged with programs and services that keep whole health in mind.

[Find services ][78]
* ### Health plan options

Explore a menu of protection from group medical and Medicare options to ancillary dental and
vision plans.

[Find plans ][79]
* ### Easy administration

Find quoting, enrollment and reporting tools to ease the process for plan sponsors and brokers.

[Find tools ][80]

## Breaking down barriers

Helping members build resilience and connect to quality mental health care.

[Contact a rep ][81]

# Diabetes support program

Transform Diabetes Care gives members the tools, education and personalized support to stick with
treatment and manage diabetes with success.

[Contact an Aetna rep ][77]

**Are you a member?** If your plan includes Transform Diabetes Care, you can take charge of diabetes
with the [Health Optimizer app][78].

## How is Aetna® transforming diabetes care? It starts with data.

Managing diabetes goes beyond doctor visits and blood sugar checks. The right support, at the right
time, is what matters. Yet condition programs have long been one-size-fits all. We’re changing that.

A combination of analytics, technology and nurse-led support lets us meet members where they are and
offer a holistic, personalized approach to diabetes management.

We support members using five clinical areas of impact:

1. Taking the right medicine
2. Taking medicine as prescribed
3. Getting preventive screenings
4. Managing coexisting conditions
5. Self-monitoring with connected devices

[Doctor assisting male patient on weighing scales in hospital]

## Personalized diabetes care for every level of need

We offer support to all members with diabetes, not just those at higher risk. We connect with
members throughout their journeys — from diagnosis to monitoring to treatment. The goal? Help them
live healthier with diabetes, manage coexisting conditions and get quality care at the right time.

**Want to add this program?** If you have one of our care management programs, you can add Transform
Diabetes Care to your benefits package. Your Aetna rep can tell you more.

[patient member icon]

### Proactive support

We use advanced analytics and member data to find members who need support to create a customized
care experience.

### Personalized care

Members get individualized guidance and coordination from Aetna registered nurses who are Certified
Diabetes Care and Education Specialists.

### Connected devices

We help members who may benefit from blood glucose testing get the meter that works best for them.
We also use glucose monitoring data to shape each member’s experience based on their needs and
risks.

[Convenient care]

### Convenient care

Members can connect with care that fits their needs. We offer clinical support from Aetna nurses,
CVS® pharmacists, CVS® HealthHUB™ and MinuteClinic® providers.

## Health Optimizer® appAn app to help members take charge of diabetes care

The app brings everyday diabetes care together in one place.

* Members can connect their glucose meter, blood pressure cuff and about 300 other devices,
including popular fitness trackers, to track readings and add notes.
* Data is shared securely with the Transform Diabetes Care team. Members can also choose to share it
with their health care providers.
* Beyond tracking, the app offers education, tips, recipes and nutrition coaching, plus mental
wellness resources. It can also generate a downloadable or printable activity log and uses
AI-driven insights to deliver personalized feedback based on each member’s readings.

# Aetna One® care managementFrom predictive data to proactive care

Bringing together advanced analytics, personal outreach and intuitive digital tools to support your
employees’ health when they need it most.

[Contact my Aetna rep ][77]

This page is pending approval in AZ, CA and WV.

## Why choose Aetna®Care management when it counts

Better health and lower costs are just the beginning. We’re transforming the health care experience
to engage employees in a more proactive, preventive and connected way to help bring more value to
your organization.

### Identify

**Earlier insights find members when it matters most**

Our integrated clinical, claims and pharmacy data — combined with predictive analytics — help us
spot risks earlier and target outreach more precisely. It’s care management that reaches out at the
right time, before employees have to.

### Personalize

**Tailored support meets each person’s unique needs**

We connect data to create deeper insights for a more personal touch. From high-risk case management
to rising-risk condition coaching and specialized clinical support, our care teams help deliver the
right intervention at the right time.

### Connect

**Digital tools and real human support work together**

Smarter, more intuitive [digital tools][78] help employees find answers faster and feel more
confident managing their health. Personalized guidance, simpler navigation and the convenience of
CVS Health® touchpoints further boost engagement.

## Tailored options with your team in mind

From acute events to chronic care, there’s an Aetna One for you. We embed each option with our
whole-health approach, and you have the flexibility to address specific health conditions within
your team. Your Aetna® rep can tell you more.

### Aetna One Essentials

This option is a more cost-effective solution for major health events. **Essentials** focuses on
acute, short-term care episodes and support to help avoid hospital admissions.

### Aetna One Flex

This option takes it a step further to help spot potential chronic conditions before they begin.
**Flex** offers a single nurse for the family for acute and chronic care and an expanded care team.

### Aetna One Choice

This option features the highest level of clinical touch. **Choice** offers group coaching,
integrated utilization management and expanded staffing. It’s all wrapped around single-nurse model
for acute and chronic care management.

## A trusted advocate for every step of care

# Advocacy that works for every employee

Aetna One® Advocate delivers seamless, personalized access to care through a single point of contact
— supporting employees across the full health journey.

## Why choose Aetna®Experienced support — delivered with heart

Our model offers a hands-on, personal approach that blends caring, human support — from clinical
teams to customer service advocates — with smart technology, to make health care easier for every
employee.

**The result:** A better experience with better outcomes for your employees, and measurable value
for your business.

**Aetna One Advocate offers:**

* Centralized, personalized service and clinical support
* Customizable enhancements to fit employer needs
* A seamless experience that drives improved health and cost outcomes
* ### A single destination for navigating health

From medical, pharmacy, dental and behavioral health to employer programs, our clinical team helps
employees navigate to the care they need.

Disease management specialists for conditions like cancer and diabetes ensure they get extra
support without having to leave the program.
* ### Personalized support across your workforce

Every journey is unique, so the Aetna One Advocate program is deeply personalized.

Whether employees are managing a complex condition or just starting a health journey, we help make
it easier with compassionate, seamless guidance for a better experience and better health.
* ### Technology that empowers people

Our proactive outreach connects with members via chat, video, text or phone, meeting them where
they are and engaging them before they reach out.

Real-time data, behavioral insights and analytics help flag emerging needs up to [100 days
earlier*][77] so advocates and nurse case managers can deliver timely, personal support.

Together with CVS Health®, we can leverage the power of integrated data to lead to an earlier
diagnosis.

# Women’s health benefits for every stage

Women — they’re the heart of your company. Investing in their total well-being is investing in their
success, and yours. Improved recruitment, retention and productivity is just the beginning. Our
offerings meet women’s unique needs to help them stay healthier at every stage.

## Aetna® and CVS Health® Bringing together what matters most to your employees’ health
* ### Trusted care

With our broad network, women have more choices in care. They have access to virtual and in-person
providers with enhanced training in women’s physical and behavioral health conditions to better
serve women’s needs.
* ### Integrated resources

Our integrated solutions help us identify members when they need support. We can match them to
programs and providers that can improve their health across virtual care, behavioral health and
specialty programs.
* ### Customized support

We can help you deploy add-on programs to address the whole woman. Support includes lifestyle
coaching and adoption reimbursement.
* ### Personalized benefits

We use claims data to understand your company’s health trends and create a holistic view of each
member. Our account, data and clinical teams can support you in creating personalized employee
benefits.
* ### A history of firsts

From advancing fertility coverage benefits to offering in-network menopause specialists, we’ve
been first. And you can count on us to continue investing and innovating for women.
* ### Range of retail services

Women can access care more easily through our integration with CVS®. MinuteClinic® has a
comprehensive menu of [women's physical and mental health services][77] — heart health, breast
health and more.
* ### Whole-health focus

Period health. Fertility. Maternity. Menopause. Women’s health is all these things, and more.
That’s why we bring together benefits and resources to address the full range of health concerns
women have through their lives.
* ### Flexible plan designs

Our seasoned women’s health experts work alongside our actuarial team to predict health trends and
infuse clinical excellence into our plan designs. We can help you choose the right benefits for
your employees.

## Coverage and support Every journey is unique. We believe her benefits should be, too.

We embed physical and [mental health resources][78] at every stage of health to enhance total health
and well-being. First period, gynecological condition, fertility, condition management, menopause
and beyond.

Support extends beyond a woman’s stage of health. We tailor mental health support for her unique and
personal life challenges, such as moving into adulthood, experiencing fertility issues or caring for
older parents.

Sexual and reproductive health Healthy aging and menopause Preventive health care services Care
management support
Sexual and reproductive health

### Sexual and reproductive health benefits matter to employees

Offering coverage for these important health services can [boost workplace productivity by
15%.*][79] From period health to family planning, we’ve got you covered.
* #### Family planning and fertility
* Deep clinical expertise and 20+ years of proven experience supporting over ½ million members in
building families
* Flexible plan designs to support access to contraception, preconception and family-building
services
* National infertility unit to help members navigate coverage and precertification
* Infertility Institutes of Excellence® for special care from providers chosen for quality, safety
and value
* [Coverage for intrauterine insemination (IUI)][80] as a medical benefit on eligible plans
* #### Maternity and postpartum
* Access to specially trained nurses for high-risk moms-to-be
* Education on prenatal care, labor and delivery, and newborn care
* Broader access to virtual support for moms, such as a lactation network, mental health
counseling and more
* Option to add [Maven Clinic][81] for 24/7 virtual maternity support and access to doctors,
nurses, mental health providers, coaches and other specialists
* #### More support
* 24/7 virtual coaching for complex hormonal, metabolic and gynecological conditions through
[Allara Health][82] in-network specialty clinics
* Access to** **[CVS products and services to support her well-being][83], like contraception
support and heart screenings

#### WANT TO LEARN MORE?
* [Sexual and reproductive health resources ][84]

Healthy aging and menopause

### Menopause is more than a hot flash. It’s a total health experience.

Millions of women go through menopause every year. Yet there’s a significant [care gap around
menopause health.*][85] Most women don’t seek treatment due to stigma and 46% aren’t prepared for
this stage. Providers receive limited menopause training, so diagnosis and treatment may take
longer.

Why it matters: Changing hormone levels impact whole health, including her heart, bone and mental
health. We’re committed to supporting women during this stage.
* #### In-person and virtual support
* [Virtual and in-person appointments][86] with MinuteClinic board-certified providers and
licensed therapists trained to discuss menopause symptoms and treatment
* Menopause-trained care managers to guide members to resources and support
* Trusted, expert menopause care through virtual in-network specialists at [Gennev][87] or
[Midi][88]
* Access to Aetna in-network Ob/gyns and specialists with experience in menopause symptoms
* #### Add-on support
* 1:1 support from Aetna care managers trained in menopause symptoms, medication, mental health
and more
* Individual and group lifestyle coaching for menopause relief and healthy aging plus access to
on-demand resources through [Active Health][89] and [Maven Clinic][90]
* #### Proactive education
* Outreach campaigns to empower women to take control of their menopause journey
* Educational resources about preventive care to help improve outcomes and lower costs

#### WANT TO LEARN MORE?
* [Healthy aging and menopause resources ][91]

Preventive health care services

### Preventive care to help her live healthier today, and for a lifetime

The right care at the right time matters. Yet [42% of women put off preventive care*][92] due to
cost, time and competing priorities. We cover screenings, well-woman care and immunizations to
support women’s health needs, year after year.
* #### Covered screenings
* Heart disease screenings and more [heart health plan benefits][93]
* Pap smears, mammograms, certain vaccines and [more lifesaving screenings][94]
* Diabetes and high blood pressure screenings

# Helping your employees find care with confidence

Aetna Smart Compare® with Intelligent Matching helps employees get the care they need without the
guesswork — offering transparency, clarity and personalized support every step of the way.

## A single, coordinated approach to finding care

Searching for the right doctor can feel overwhelming and impersonal. Aetna Smart Compare with
Intelligent Matching uses the latest technology, along with your employees’ medical history and
personal preferences, to instantly find the [top three providers that may best fit their
needs.*][77]

### Aetna Smart Compare provider recommendations

Employees can look for their top three provider matches under the “Picked for you” banner in their
results. Each [provider's profile*][78] explains why they’re a match, so employees can compare with
confidence.

### Data-backed care with Intelligent Matching

Intelligent Matching automatically personalizes your employees’ search, matching them with providers
based on their unique preferences.

### Improved outcomes and proven results

Aetna Smart Compare with Intelligent Matching helps make sure your employee’s next provider offers
quality, cost-effective care.

# Protecting workers for over 170 years

Year after year, we’re delivering access to customized care, in your community, to keep your labor
fund healthy. It’s our promise to you and your members.

## Why Aetna® Labor?

Labor is the backbone of our country. Here’s how we support you.

### Collaboration to contain costs

We work with third-party administrators to bring you deep discounts, clear reporting and care
management.

### Colleagues dedicated to labor

Over 1,300 Aetna colleagues work solely for labor, state and local government. We’re ready to meet
your unique needs.

### A full range of coverage options

You get one stop for coverage — from medical to dental to retiree and beyond — from one national
benefits carrier.

### Local care that’s personalized

Your members have the comfort of knowing local care is there when they need it, in their own
communities.

## Programs just for labor funds
* ### Essential Worker Peer Support program

#### Help from someone whose walked in their shoes

Essential workers are critical to our health and safety. But they may put their own mental health
needs on hold. We created the Essential Worker Peer Support Program for the unique needs of
building trades, transit and health care workers. They get a direct line to trusted peers who
understand what they’re going through and can help them on their path to better health.

Features include:

##### 24/7 confidential helpline

This line is staffed by active and retired essential workers. It offers a path toward therapy for
those who fear being labeled or who might not otherwise seek help.

##### Confidential therapy referrals

Members get support in the moment and referrals to network clinicians who have experience working
with essential workers.

##### Face-to-face engagement

Retired essential workers promote programs directly to members to create a connection between the
program and local resources.

##### Mobile app and online resources

Essential workers can access content created just for them and their families — on their own time,
in a safe place.

##### Continuing education

Other resources are available, including live and on-demand training, clinical self-assessment and
self-help tools, and outreach communications.

* ### Joint claims administration program

#### Working together for easier administration

Our joint claims administration program supports Taft-Hartley labor clients who self-administer
their medical benefits or partner with a third-party administrator. You handle the key services
members expect. And we lend our managed care expertise in areas like:

* Claims intake, pricing and editing
* Network management and provider services
* Provider payment and remittance
* Care management and reporting

## Plans to keep your labor fund strong

You get a menu of affordable plan designs to protect your members’ health. Choose from:

### Medical insurance plans

like performance networks and network-only and option plan designs

### Ancillary options

like pharmacy, vision, dental, and behavioral health, for a total approach to wellness

### Voluntary coverage

to help pay for unexpected accident, illness and hospital expenses that medical doesn’t cover

### Retiree solutions

like Aetna Medicare Advantage plans, supplemental retiree plans and pre-65 health plans

We also offer these health expense funds:

### Health reimbursement arrangement (HRA)

You set the amount that your members can use to pay for covered health care costs. HRAs are not
available to HMO members in Illinois and small group members in Florida.

### Health savings account (HSA)****

You — and/or your members — make tax-advantaged contributions to help them save for future expenses.
HSAs are not available to HMO members in California and Illinois.

### Flexible spending account (FSA)

Members can put part of their pre-taxed salary into this account to get reimbursed for eligible
expenses.

## Different jobs, unique solutions

Aetna Industry Solutions for Labor Union offers personalized solutions for specific labor industries
to help you contain health care costs, improve productivity and reduce absenteeism. Industries
include:

* Building trades, for carpenters, electricians, pipefitters and masons
* Shipping and transportation, for long-haul truck drivers, cement truck operators and material
handlers
* First responders, for fire fighters, law enforcement and emergency medical technicians

To learn about custom benefits for other industries, [contact your Aetna rep][76].

# Supporting state and local government

For over 160 years, we’ve been delivering customized health care solutions to state and local
government employees, with integration to drive down costs.

[Contact an Aetna® rep ][76]

#### Video transcript for "First responder peer support program"

I’ve been saving lives for over 15 years. But this call was different. The stress. The pain. The
nightmares.

Maybe I should talk to someone. But who? My squad? They’ll think I’m weak. The department shrink? I
could put my job at risk.

The First Responder Peer Support Program. I can talk with peers who’ve seen what I’ve seen and know
what it’s like.

Get confidential referrals to trusted therapists experienced with first responders. And access
content that may be helpful for me and my family.

I’ve been saving lives for over 15 years. Now I can finally trust someone else to help save mine.

## Helping our first responders

First responders don’t always use traditional employee assistance programs. Our First Responder Peer
Support Program offers first responders and their families trusted, confidential, accessible support
for their unique needs that’s just a click or phone call away.

## Our experience, your results

Together, we’ll work on a long-term strategic plan to cut costs, customize access to care and
improve health outcomes for a strong and healthy workforce.

### Local service

Work with a team of over 1,300 Aetna® employees dedicated to state and local government, along with
labor, to deliver affordable coverage where your employees live and work.

### Cost control

Control rising care costs with features like provider transparency, integrated pharmacy, competitive
provider contracts, health expense funds and more.

### Clinical value

Improve care and health outcomes with our patented CareEngine^{®} system, which finds gaps in care
to alert attending doctors.

### Tailored benefits

Get a customized benefits package with the exact plans, products and services you need, at a cost
that fits your budget.

## Easy administration, not guesswork

Save time, money and hassles with shared administration services. You handle key member services,
like benefits determination. And we’ll lend our managed care expertise in areas like:

* Claims intake, pricing and editing
* Network management and provider services
* Provider payment and remittance
* Care management and reporting

## Win the battle against rising costs

With our tax-advantaged options, you get savings when employees contribute to health expense funds.
And they get quality benefits. With ongoing savings, the program can even pay for itself.

Available plan options:

* **Health reimbursement arrangement (HRA)***
You set the amount that your employees can use to pay for covered health care costs.
* **Health savings account (HSA)****
You — and/or your employees — make tax-advantaged contributions to help them save for future
expenses.
* **Flexible spending account (FSA)**
Your employees can put part of their pre-taxed salary into this account to get reimbursed for
eligible expenses.

## Supporting total wellness

Our mix of plans, programs and tools helps employees take charge of their whole self, from their
plan, to their costs, to their health.

We’re helping employees:
* ### Improve their health

We offer support for 35+ conditions, with outreach to help those at risk stick with healthy
behaviors.
* ### Understand their plan

It's easy to find care, view claims and store personal health information on their member website.
* ### Manage their costs

They can compare costs for doctors and hospitals before they go, and even pay their bill online.

## Tailored plans for today and tomorrow

The right combination of plans, programs and cost sharing can help you protect your employees'
health and budget — not just today, but in the future. With these plan choices, everyone wins.

* **Medical insurance plans** like performance networks, and network-only and network-option plans
* **Ancillary options **for a total approach to wellness, like pharmacy, vision, dental and
behavioral health
* **Voluntary coverage** to help pay for unexpected accident, illness and hospital expenses that
medical doesn’t cover
* **Retiree solutions**, like Aetna^{®}Medicare Advantage plans, supplemental retiree plans, pre-65
health plans and more

# Supporting student health needs

Your students are the beating heart of your campus. So count on Aetna Student Health^{SM }plans to
help them reach better health together and help you build a healthier higher education institution.

[Contact us][77]

## Add value to your campus with Aetna Student Health

As the largest health services company in the student health industry, we excel at serving your
higher education health needs, from the most basic to complex.

# Access

Students can visit campus student health centers, local hospitals and over 1.2 million providers in
our national network for convenient care.

# Quality

Our tailored offerings — including integrated medical and behavioral health — support students’
whole health.

# Service

We have a dedicated Chief Medical Officer and Student Health Service model serving over 400,000
members and 150 schools.

# Insights

Using data analytics and benchmarking, we can review your claims and utilization trends to help keep
students healthier, and costs lower.

## Customized solutions just for your students

We don’t create solutions for just any student, but your students. And we do this by getting to know
their origins, interests, communities, peers and ambitions better, so we can deliver better support.

Your students get:

* Healthy discounts on fitness, vision, dental care, health coaching and more
* Day-to-day support like the 24/7 health line, open enrollment assistance and an on-campus presence
* Digital plan tools like their Aetna^{® }member website, Aetna Health^{SM} app, digital ID card
and international student resources

## Care that travels with students

With On-Call International, your students can get medical assistance and information anytime around
the world. From finding lost luggage to arranging for family to be there in their time of need.

The program features:

* Core support, like medical evacuation, prescription drug replacement and repatriation services
* Help on the go, like emergency travel arrangements, language translation or help finding lost
luggage or travel documents
* Security assistance during a natural disaster or political evacuation

## An easy, seamless experience

From customer support to simple billing and claims administration, you’ve got support you can count
on.

Our customer service teams educate your students on helpful tools and programs, and how to make the
most of their benefits. And they’re always finding ways to improve, based on survey feedback.

Our claims and administration teams deliver timely determinations of benefits and adherence to
legislative policies. And they’re true specialists, with an average tenure of 15 years.

With our simplified claims process, we offer step-by-step support for an easy billing experience.
We’ll simplify enrollment too, with easier file submission, faster report processing and quicker
access to ID cards, coverage and student services.

## Support for students in need

Though our Guardian Angel Program, we can use claims data to identify those who’ve recently survived
an overdose. Then reach out with the right support.

A caring nurse or clinician will:

* Assess mental and physical wellbeing
* Give information on naloxone and other strategies to reduce harm
* Direct students to in-network resources and providers
* Work with case management to offer ongoing support and follow up, as needed

# Giving back to public school employees

Educators and support staff do so much for our children, their parents and the community. So lets
give them a healthier, more balanced work life.

#### Video transcript for "Caring in action"

(light emotional music)

[Narrator] When you were growing up, who was your favorite teacher?

Chances are, they weren't your favorite just because they helped you learn Math or Grammar.

That's because educators do so much more than just educate.

They're our role models, our coaches, our nurses, and our biggest fans.

They're there to inspire us, to help us grow, and when we struggle, fail, or fall, they're there to
help us up time and time again because they care about us.

But when their long hours and daily demands become too much and the stress of caring for the
classroom switches to the pressures of raising a family, who's there to help them?

We are.

At Aetna, we understand the unique challenges school employees face everyday because we have more
than a million of them as members and when they need us, we'll be there with a solution tailored to
their specific needs.

Our new School Employee Guidance Program is a valuable complement to our A+ for Schools Program.

Designed to reduce turnover, lower claim costs, and increase productivity.

It provides educators with an important source of emotional support.

We're there to support a healthier, more balanced work life.

Offering help in person, on the phone, or online whenever employees need it.

For more in depth support, onsite workshops cover a wide variety of topics including ADHD, ASD,
overcoming compassion fatigue, preventing burnout, and more.

Making the most of technology, we've created online tools including a member website and the
myStrength app so employees can use self-support resources in the formats they're most comfortable
with.

And Aetna is there in case of crisis with crisis support services to help employees recover after
trauma.

Crisis consultants coordinate all services, staying connected, and even offering onsite services if
needed.

## Caring in action

See how we’re there for school employees with day-to-day care and personalized attention to help
boost productivity, lower turnover and improve classroom outcomes.

## We care for them

With the **A+ for Schools^{℠} Program **— an in-depth, data-backed approach to understanding claims
experience — you get a custom solution to build a healthier school system.

**Enhanced care management**

Each employee gets a single, designated clinical team, just like having a nurse in the family.

**Concierge customer service**

We connect them to the right resources at the right time, like a GPS for employee benefits.

**Benchmarking and reporting**

Data-driven insights identify opportunities to lower medical trend and employees’ cost of care.

**Optional programs**

Add behavioral health, maternity management and telemedicine to enhance your health care strategy.

## We’re here for them

With the **School Employee Guidance Program,** your staff gets personal support to manage daily
challenges so they can be strong and balanced — physically and mentally.

**Emotional support**

When employees need help, they choose how to get it, from one-on-one counseling in person, by phone
or through video.

**Onsite workshops**

We’ll deliver courses at your school on your choice of topic, from handling stress to preventing
burnout to addressing ADHD.

**Online tools**

Employees can access self-support, like webinars and videos, to manage daily challenges, classroom
stress, insomnia and chronic pain.

**Crisis support**

Our crisis consultants can coordinate support and offer onsite support to help teachers and staff
recover after tragic events.

## We’ve got your back

With over 1 million public school employees as members, we get their daily challenges. And we’re
helping you help them.

# Helping health care workers feel their best

Your employees give their all. Give back — with care, service and provider network solutions
customized just for the health care industry and its hardest workers.

[Contact an Aetna^{®} rep ][76]

## Meeting the unique needs of health care workers

Health care employees need health care too. So our benefits focus on their unique health needs,
while giving physicians and other care providers the tools to improve costs and outcomes.

### Custom network strategy

You can have up to four provider network tiers with national strength and local presence, along with
experience on your facility’s network needs and trends.

### Clinical care coordination

Our clinical team connects the dots of each employee and dependent’s care journey, and provides
insights into engagement, health risks and network use.

### Dedicated service teams

Our health advocacy team helps employees navigate care and benefits, while our account team guides
your health management strategy to success.

### Analytics and reporting

We keep on top of the trends — in the health care industry and in your employee base — to keep
building and bringing you stronger benefits.

## Custom networks to meet your goals

Our mission? To help you achieve yours. We administer the plan to help you meet your unique
objectives. And our national networks are locally strong, to help you maximize in-house use and
savings.

We’ve built a network strategy for you that includes:

* Flexible, four-tier network design
* Deep understanding of network utilization
* A dedicated network team and actuarial support
* A platform for specific network customization

## High-touch care for healthier members

Heath systems are taking on more and more responsibility for care management. So we offer in-house
capabilities — and flexibility — to support collaborative care management models.

Our clinical care team:

* Spans the care spectrum, from precertification to utilization and case management
* Engages employees in wellness, disease management and in-house pharmacy resources
* Identifies opportunities to support members in improving their health outcomes

You also have the option of your very own nurse case manager or health-care-specific chronic
condition management program. Bottom line: You choose what’s best for your team.

## We're at your service

Explore health care benefits just for health care teams.

# Helping PEOs achieve their goals

Health benefits aren’t your only focus. But they’re likely one of the most complex and costly
services you offer. We can help professional employer organizations (PEOs) build strong benefit
strategies while helping your clients build healthy, productive workforces.

## Why choose Aetna®Service and support set us apart

You’re focused on your clients and their worksite employees. We’re focused on you. We can help
design a benefit plan that best meets your needs, and those of your clients and worksite employees.
We deliver service and support to help meet your growth and retention goals.

### Dedicated team

The Aetna PEO team is your team of trusted advisors. We’re here for you every step of the way, from
developing benefit strategies to analyzing results and planning for the future.

### Expert consultation

We learn all we can about your PEO and the needs of your clients. Our team will be there for you so
you can be there for your clients every day.

### Insights and analytics

We have deep-rooted knowledge of the needs of small and midsize businesses. And we use our solid
expertise in building special benefit solutions to help you meet them.

### Unmatched experience

We were one of the [first national carriers in the PEO business.*][76] And our industry tenure is
over 25 years. We’ll continue to put our experience to work for you.

## Supporting each member’s journey

Members deserve a health care experience that’s meaningful to them. We’ve created personalized
solutions with them in mind.
* ### A national network with local access

We connect members with quality, affordable and local care — at the right place, at the right
time. We’re uniquely positioned to drive engagement and improve health outcomes.
* ### Quality care through innovative solutions

From physical and mental health to chronic condition support and everyday wellness, we create
seamless connections to simplify every journey. And we’re able to maximize support for populations
at highest risk.
* ### Personal support for all members

Your worksite employees want proactive support that’s with them at home and on the go, on their
terms. Our benefit programs not only address whole health, but also offer guidance to help members
find care and use their benefits.

## What is a PEO and how can it help your business?

PEOs help small and midsize businesses by offering human resources (HR) services. This may include
health-related benefits and other HR solutions, such as payroll, tax administration and regulatory
help.

By working with a PEO, businesses can improve productivity and profit through a contractual
agreement to share employee worksite responsibilities.

## Aetna Funding Advantage℠ plansSelf-insured funding built for small businesses

Looking to control rising health care costs? Or want plan features typical for larger groups like
surplus sharing, fewer taxes and high-cost claims protection? You get it all with Aetna Funding
Advantage — health plans designed with your small business in mind.

A monthly payment based on the health trends of your employees, for up to [25 percent savings*][79]
up front.

An online billing and enrollment platform, plus other simple features for you and your employees.

Stop-loss insurance to limit the risk of high-cost claims, with money back when claims are lower.

Plan designs that provide access to the quality, value-based Aetna® network, plus health and
wellness benefits.
* [Explore Aetna Funding Advantage plans ][80]

## A value-added package

You’ve come to the right place to balance health plan costs and quality. You get competitive
benefits, unique funding and cost control. Plus, built-in wellness programs and resources support
employee health long term.

### Savings

Get lower monthly payments based on health trends and low-cost local network options. Even better:
when you renew your plan, we return 50 percent of any surplus to you.

### Stability

Keep your costs predictable and stable with bundled products, funding options, wellness offerings
and stop-loss claims protection.

### Simplicity

Choose from a national portfolio of plan designs with the ease of automated underwriting and one
common support model.

### Speed

Get quick, accurate quoting, auto-case installation, online self-service, fixed national plan
designs and more.

## Everyone saves with health expense funds

As part of a consumer-directed plan, health expense funds benefit employers and employees. You get
tax savings from salary deductions. Employees get access to quality care that encourages smart
spending.

You can also:

* Cut FICA, unemployment and workers’ comp taxes by lowering payroll taxes
* Offer plans to help employees set aside tax-free money, like for dependent care or parking
expenses
* Enhance your company’s benefit package to attract and keep valuable employees

## Discover Aetna Well-Being Essentials

Elevate workplace well-being with this easy-to-implement bundle, customized for your company.
* #### Culture of Well-Being tool

This tool evaluates your programs and policies to create a strategic roadmap that you can track
year after year.
* #### Onsite well-being support

Your designated consultant reviews worksite health needs, designs a well-being strategy and
delivers customized programming to your jobsite.
* #### Care management outreach

Members get one-on-one nurse support to navigate their health journeys, from reaching a health
goal to managing a chronic condition.
* ### Lifestyle coaching

Members get personalized one-on-one phone coaching, and group and self-paced digital coaching, to
keep up healthy changes.*
* ### Well-being allowance

Receive funding for well-being activities, like company-sponsored races and lunch and learns, with
an inclusive allowance.
* ### Digital tools

Get proprietary tools to identify those who need personalized care, drive engagement, track health
programs and more.

## Experience in your corner

Your well-being consultant will work with you on a custom plan to improve health outcomes and cut
medical costs at your company. And track your success along the way.

Your consultant will also:

* Offer short-term and long-term strategies
* Train well-being champions
* Be onsite six times a year for wellness initiatives
* Develop an annual well-being calendar, and more

## Insight into health opportunities

Your consultant uses the proprietary Culture of Well-Being tool to find gaps and opportunities in
your company’s health and wellness.

This tool:

* Analyzes the company culture using the six dimensions of well-being
* Integrates health initiatives with business objectives
* Tracks health improvement and program effectiveness over time
* Helps you implement an evidence-based approach

*Chronic condition coaching is available as a buy-up.

**By clicking on “I Accept”, I acknowledge and accept that:

The Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) Medical Necessity Guide helps determine appropriate (medically
necessary) levels and types of care for patients in need of evaluation and treatment for behavioral
health conditions. The ABA Medical Necessity Guide does not constitute medical advice. Treating
providers are solely responsible for medical advice and treatment of members. Members should discuss
any matters related to their coverage or condition with their treating provider.

Each benefit plan defines which services are covered, which are excluded, and which are subject to
dollar caps or other limits. Members and their providers will need to consult the member's benefit
plan to determine if there are any exclusions or other benefit limitations applicable to this
service or supply.

The conclusion that a particular service or supply is medically necessary does not constitute a
representation or warranty that this service or supply is covered (i.e., will be paid for by Aetna)
for a particular member. The member's benefit plan determines coverage. Some plans exclude coverage
for services or supplies that Aetna considers medically necessary.

Please note also that the ABA Medical Necessity Guide may be updated and are, therefore, subject to
change.

Medical necessity determinations in connection with coverage decisions are made on a case-by-case
basis. In the event that a member disagrees with a coverage determination, member may be eligible
for the right to an internal appeal and/or an independent external appeal in accordance with
applicable federal or state law.

## Get To Know Anthem

At Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield we understand our health connects us to each other. What we all
do impacts those around us. So Anthem is dedicated to delivering better care to our members,
providing greater value to our customers and helping improve the health of our communities.

Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield is the trade name of: In Colorado: Rocky Mountain Hospital and
Medical Service, Inc. HMO products underwritten by HMO Colorado, Inc. In Connecticut: Anthem Health
Plans, Inc. In Indiana: Anthem Insurance Companies, Inc. In Georgia: Blue Cross Blue Shield
Healthcare Plan of Georgia, Inc. and AMGP Georgia Managed Care Company, Inc. In Kentucky: Anthem
Health Plans of Kentucky, Inc. In Maine: Anthem Health Plans of Maine, Inc. In Missouri (excluding
30 counties in the Kansas City area): RightCHOICE® Managed Care, Inc. (RIT), Healthy Alliance® Life
Insurance Company (HALIC), and HMO Missouri, Inc. RIT and certain affiliates administer non-HMO
benefits underwritten by HALIC and HMO benefits underwritten by HMO Missouri, Inc. RIT and certain
affiliates only provide administrative services for self-funded plans and do not underwrite
benefits. In Nevada: Community Care Health Plan of Nevada, Inc. and Rocky Mountain Hospital and
Medical Service, Inc. HMO products underwritten by HMO Colorado, Inc., dba HMO Nevada. In New
Hampshire: Anthem Health Plans of New Hampshire, Inc. HMO plans are administered by Anthem Health
Plans of New Hampshire, Inc. and underwritten by either Matthew Thornton Health Plan, Inc. or Anthem
Health Plans of New Hampshire, Inc. In 17 southeastern counties of New York: Anthem HealthChoice
Assurance, Inc. and Anthem HealthChoice HMO, Inc. In these same counties Anthem Blue Cross and Blue
Shield HP is the trade name of Anthem HP, LLC. In Ohio: Community Insurance Company. In Virginia:
Anthem Health Plans of Virginia, Inc. trades as Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield, and its affiliate
HealthKeepers, Inc. trades as Anthem HealthKeepers providing HMO coverage, and their service area is
all of Virginia except for the City of Fairfax, the Town of Vienna, and the area east of State Route
123. In Wisconsin: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Wisconsin (BCBSWI) underwrites or administers PPO and
indemnity policies and underwrites the out-of-network benefits in POS policies offered by Compcare
Health Services Insurance Corporation. Compcare underwrites or administers HMO or POS policies.

## Get To Know Anthem

At Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield we understand our health connects us to each other. What we all
do impacts those around us. So Anthem is dedicated to delivering better care to our members,
providing greater value to our customers and helping improve the health of our communities.

Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield is the trade name of: In Colorado: Rocky Mountain Hospital and
Medical Service, Inc. HMO products underwritten by HMO Colorado, Inc. In Connecticut: Anthem Health
Plans, Inc. In Indiana: Anthem Insurance Companies, Inc. In Georgia: Blue Cross Blue Shield
Healthcare Plan of Georgia, Inc. and AMGP Georgia Managed Care Company, Inc. In Kentucky: Anthem
Health Plans of Kentucky, Inc. In Maine: Anthem Health Plans of Maine, Inc. In Missouri (excluding
30 counties in the Kansas City area): RightCHOICE® Managed Care, Inc. (RIT), Healthy Alliance® Life
Insurance Company (HALIC), and HMO Missouri, Inc. RIT and certain affiliates administer non-HMO
benefits underwritten by HALIC and HMO benefits underwritten by HMO Missouri, Inc. RIT and certain
affiliates only provide administrative services for self-funded plans and do not underwrite
benefits. In Nevada: Community Care Health Plan of Nevada, Inc. and Rocky Mountain Hospital and
Medical Service, Inc. HMO products underwritten by HMO Colorado, Inc., dba HMO Nevada. In New
Hampshire: Anthem Health Plans of New Hampshire, Inc. HMO plans are administered by Anthem Health
Plans of New Hampshire, Inc. and underwritten by either Matthew Thornton Health Plan, Inc. or Anthem
Health Plans of New Hampshire, Inc. In 17 southeastern counties of New York: Anthem HealthChoice
Assurance, Inc. and Anthem HealthChoice HMO, Inc. In these same counties Anthem Blue Cross and Blue
Shield HP is the trade name of Anthem HP, LLC. In Ohio: Community Insurance Company. In Virginia:
Anthem Health Plans of Virginia, Inc. trades as Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield, and its affiliate
HealthKeepers, Inc. trades as Anthem HealthKeepers providing HMO coverage, and their service area is
all of Virginia except for the City of Fairfax, the Town of Vienna, and the area east of State Route
123. In Wisconsin: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Wisconsin (BCBSWI) underwrites or administers PPO and
indemnity policies and underwrites the out-of-network benefits in POS policies offered by Compcare
Health Services Insurance Corporation. Compcare underwrites or administers HMO or POS policies.
Independent licensees of the Blue Cross and Blue Shield Association. Anthem is a registered
trademark of Anthem Insurance Companies, Inc.

There may be times when we use other companies to give our members and providers certain types of
services, like Utilization Management or Case Management. We would always make sure that it was
approved by law and allowed by our contracts beforehand.

Radiant Services, LLC may be part of the approval process for care you receive. Whether Radiant is
involved or not, the process is the same. Radiant has some staff outside the United States. We want
to help you get access to quality, efficient care that is backed by scientific research. Radiant
shares that goal. If you have questions about Radiant, please contact Member Services.

## Get To Know Anthem

At Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield we understand our health connects us to each other. What we all
do impacts those around us. So Anthem is dedicated to delivering better care to our members,
providing greater value to our customers and helping improve the health of our communities.

Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield is the trade name of: In Colorado: Rocky Mountain Hospital and
Medical Service, Inc. HMO products underwritten by HMO Colorado, Inc. In Connecticut: Anthem Health
Plans, Inc. In Indiana: Anthem Insurance Companies, Inc. In Georgia: Blue Cross Blue Shield
Healthcare Plan of Georgia, Inc. and AMGP Georgia Managed Care Company, Inc. In Kentucky: Anthem
Health Plans of Kentucky, Inc. In Maine: Anthem Health Plans of Maine, Inc. In Missouri (excluding
30 counties in the Kansas City area): RightCHOICE® Managed Care, Inc. (RIT), Healthy Alliance® Life
Insurance Company (HALIC), and HMO Missouri, Inc. RIT and certain affiliates administer non-HMO
benefits underwritten by HALIC and HMO benefits underwritten by HMO Missouri, Inc. RIT and certain
affiliates only provide administrative services for self-funded plans and do not underwrite
benefits. In Nevada: Community Care Health Plan of Nevada, Inc. and Rocky Mountain Hospital and
Medical Service, Inc. HMO products underwritten by HMO Colorado, Inc., dba HMO Nevada. In New
Hampshire: Anthem Health Plans of New Hampshire, Inc. HMO plans are administered by Anthem Health
Plans of New Hampshire, Inc. and underwritten by either Matthew Thornton Health Plan, Inc. or Anthem
Health Plans of New Hampshire, Inc. In 17 southeastern counties of New York: Anthem HealthChoice
Assurance, Inc. and Anthem HealthChoice HMO, Inc. In these same counties Anthem Blue Cross and Blue
Shield HP is the trade name of Anthem HP, LLC. In Ohio: Community Insurance Company. In Virginia:
Anthem Health Plans of Virginia, Inc. trades as Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield, and its affiliate
HealthKeepers, Inc. trades as Anthem HealthKeepers providing HMO coverage, and their service area is
all of Virginia except for the City of Fairfax, the Town of Vienna, and the area east of State Route
123. In Wisconsin: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Wisconsin (BCBSWI) underwrites or administers PPO and
indemnity policies and underwrites the out-of-network benefits in POS policies offered by Compcare
Health Services Insurance Corporation. Compcare underwrites or administers HMO or POS policies.
Independent licensees of the Blue Cross and Blue Shield Association. Anthem is a registered
trademark of Anthem Insurance Companies, Inc.

There may be times when we use other companies to give our members and providers certain types of
services, like Utilization Management or Case Management. We would always make sure that it was
approved by law and allowed by our contracts beforehand.

Radiant Services, LLC may be part of the approval process for care you receive. Whether Radiant is
involved or not, the process is the same. Radiant has some staff outside the United States. We want
to help you get access to quality, efficient care that is backed by scientific research. Radiant
shares that goal. If you have questions about Radiant, please contact Member Services.

## Accredited for quality

Optum programs meet rigorous healthcare industry standards for safety, reliable outcomes and
continuous improvement.

[See all our accreditations][71]
* [ACHC – Infusion Pharmacy gold seal] Learn more
  
  ### ACHC – Infusion Pharmacy
  
  Optum Infusion Pharmacy is accredited by the Accreditation Commission for Health Care (ACHC) for
  pharmacy services backed by rigorous quality standards. This designation recognizes our commitment
  to safety, accuracy and improved health outcomes.
  
  [View infusion services][72]
* [NABP Accredited Digital Pharmacy seal] Learn more
  
  ### NABP – Digital Pharmacy
  
  Optum Pharmacy is proud to be a National Association of Boards of Pharmacy (NABP) Accredited
  Digital Pharmacy. This independent, third-party verification demonstrates how our operations meet
  the highest standards for patients who count on convenient, reliable and safe online pharmacy
  services. 
  
  [View pharmacy services][73]
* [URAC Accreditation for Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) seal] Learn more
  
  ### URAC – Pharmacy Benefit Management
  
  Optum Rx is accredited by URAC for Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM), which reflects our
  dedication to formulary decision-making grounded in safety, efficacy and therapeutic need;
  transparent financial disclosures and continuous quality improvement.
  
  [View PBM solutions][74]
* [NCQA Accredited Utilization Management 3 years seal] Learn more
  
  ### NCQA – Utilization Management
  
  Optum Rx is accredited for Utilization Management by the National Committee for Quality Assurance
  (NCQA). This distinction reflects our commitment to fair, timely and evidence-based
  decision-making by utilization professionals, built on a framework of continuous quality
  improvement. 
  
  [View PBM solutions][75]
* [NCQA – Population Health Program seal] Learn more
  
  ### NCQA – Population Health Program
  
  The Optum Health Population Health Program accreditation from the National Committee for Quality
  Assurance (NCQA) validates that our approach to managing defined populations follows industry best
  practices — helping keep members healthier while reducing unnecessary costs.
  
  [View solutions][76]
* [NCQA – Wellness and Health Promotion seal] Learn more
  
  ### NCQA – Wellness and Health Promotion
  
  Optum Health earned the National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) Certification in Wellness
  and Health Promotion for Health Appraisal and Self-Management Tools — independent validation that
  our wellness programs use evidence-based methods proven to support health and improve outcomes.
  
  [View solutions][77]

# About Cigna Healthcare

We are an advocate for better health through every stage of life. Guiding customers through the
health care system, we empower them with the information and insight they need to make the best
choices for improving their health and vitality. As the health benefits provider of The Cigna
Group^{®}, we serve customers and clients through our U.S. Employer and International Health
businesses and engage with employers and their employees, as well as with consumers, brokers,
consultants, and health care providers.

#### $274.9 billion

total revenues

#### ~1.7 million

relationships with health care providers, clinics, and facilities

#### 185 million+

customer relationships

#### ~67,700

colleagues

#### 30+

markets and jurisdictions

As of December 31, 2025¹

## U.S. Employer

Our U.S. Employer business serves the health care needs of more than 15M medical and more than 16M
dental customers from over 37K public and private employer relationships.

### [ Medical][24]

Comprehensive, cost-efficient health care options with a wide array of benefits, including access to
a large, national network of providers, mental health and wellness programs, spending accounts, and
pharmacy coverage.

### [ Pharmacy][25]

Safe and convenient drug plans that provide access to specialty drugs and medications as well as
home delivery, specialty medication care and support, and a network of thousands of retail
pharmacies.

### [ Behavioral Health and Wellness][26]

Focusing on the whole person, mental health and wellness benefits provide access and referrals to
licensed mental health providers, services, and resources within an extensive Behavioral Health
Network.

### [ Vision][27]

Comprehensive vision plan offerings supported by one of the largest specialty networks of routine
vision care professionals in the nation1.

### [ Dental][28]

Going beyond excellent dental coverage, over 17 million customers² choose from Cigna Healthcare
dental plans because of lower deductibles, higher benefits, and coverage options that include vision
and hearing all in one.

### [ Savings and Spending Accounts (HRA/HSA/FSA)][29]

Convenient employer-based spending accounts that help employees plan and save money for a wide
variety of health care expenses.

## International Health

We're the leader in serving needs of the globally mobile. Our workforce of over 13K employees serve
around 9K employer and ~17M customer relationships.

### [ Individual and Family Plans][30]

Specializing in worldwide health insurance plans for globally mobile individuals that includes
health care coverage, well-being services, and international travel support in over 200 countries
and jurisdictions worldwide.

### [ Employer Plans][31]

Offering plans to small-sized enterprises, medium-sized enterprises, and large corporations for
employees sent abroad or employers located abroad who are insuring their employees back home and
want to provide them with personalized features like 24/7 multilingual support, whole-person health
programs, and advanced digital tools.

### [ IGO and NGO Health][32]

Providing vital support to intergovernmental organizations (IGOs), non-government organizations
(NGOs), and government employees in areas of conflict or countries with limited infrastructure
during times of crisis, as well as during illness or injury.

# About Cigna Healthcare

We are an advocate for better health through every stage of life. Guiding customers through the
health care system, we empower them with the information and insight they need to make the best
choices for improving their health and vitality. As the health benefits provider of The Cigna
Group^{®}, we serve customers and clients through our U.S. Employer and International Health
businesses and engage with employers and their employees, as well as with consumers, brokers,
consultants, and health care providers.

#### $274.9 billion

total revenues

#### ~1.7 million

relationships with health care providers, clinics, and facilities

#### 185 million+

customer relationships

#### ~67,700

colleagues

#### 30+

markets and jurisdictions

As of December 31, 2025¹

## U.S. Employer

Our U.S. Employer business serves the health care needs of more than 15M medical and more than 16M
dental customers from over 37K public and private employer relationships.

### [ Medical][24]

Comprehensive, cost-efficient health care options with a wide array of benefits, including access to
a large, national network of providers, mental health and wellness programs, spending accounts, and
pharmacy coverage.

### [ Pharmacy][25]

Safe and convenient drug plans that provide access to specialty drugs and medications as well as
home delivery, specialty medication care and support, and a network of thousands of retail
pharmacies.

### [ Behavioral Health and Wellness][26]

Focusing on the whole person, mental health and wellness benefits provide access and referrals to
licensed mental health providers, services, and resources within an extensive Behavioral Health
Network.

### [ Vision][27]

Comprehensive vision plan offerings supported by one of the largest specialty networks of routine
vision care professionals in the nation1.

### [ Dental][28]

Going beyond excellent dental coverage, over 17 million customers² choose from Cigna Healthcare
dental plans because of lower deductibles, higher benefits, and coverage options that include vision
and hearing all in one.

### [ Savings and Spending Accounts (HRA/HSA/FSA)][29]

Convenient employer-based spending accounts that help employees plan and save money for a wide
variety of health care expenses.

## International Health

We're the leader in serving needs of the globally mobile. Our workforce of over 13K employees serve
around 9K employer and ~17M customer relationships.

### [ Individual and Family Plans][30]

Specializing in worldwide health insurance plans for globally mobile individuals that includes
health care coverage, well-being services, and international travel support in over 200 countries
and jurisdictions worldwide.

### [ Employer Plans][31]

Offering plans to small-sized enterprises, medium-sized enterprises, and large corporations for
employees sent abroad or employers located abroad who are insuring their employees back home and
want to provide them with personalized features like 24/7 multilingual support, whole-person health
programs, and advanced digital tools.

### [ IGO and NGO Health][32]

Providing vital support to intergovernmental organizations (IGOs), non-government organizations
(NGOs), and government employees in areas of conflict or countries with limited infrastructure
during times of crisis, as well as during illness or injury.

products.name: Medical Insurance
products.description: Comprehensive, cost-efficient health care options with a wide array of benefits, including access to a large, national network of providers, mental health and wellness programs, spending accounts, and pharmacy coverage.
features: Access to a large network of providers

products.name: Pharmacy Plans
products.description: Safe and convenient drug plans that provide access to specialty drugs and medications as well as home delivery, specialty medication care and support, and a network of thousands of retail pharmacies.

products.name: Behavioral Health and Wellness
products.description: Mental health and wellness benefits provide access and referrals to licensed mental health providers, services, and resources within an extensive Behavioral Health Network.
features: Access to licensed mental health providers

products.name: Vision Insurance
products.description: Comprehensive vision plan offerings supported by one of the largest specialty networks of routine vision care professionals in the nation.
features: Access to a large network of vision care professionals

products.name: Dental Insurance
products.description: Dental plans that offer lower deductibles, higher benefits, and coverage options that include vision and hearing all in one.

products.name: International Health Plans
products.description: Worldwide health insurance plans for globally mobile individuals that includes health care coverage, well-being services, and international travel support in over 200 countries and jurisdictions worldwide.

# OUR VALUES ARE AT THE CORE OF EVERYTHING WE DO

#### [Unity][67]
* We will put the team first, knowing our success is collective. When the team wins we all win.
* We will never put our individual success ahead or at the expense of the team.
* We will unanimously support collective decisions.
* We will build positive lasting partnerships.

#### [Integrity][68]
* We will do the right thing.
* We will deliver on our commitments.
* We will make decisions that incorporate the needs of our clients, colleagues, communities,
patients, physicians, and members.
* We will treat every dollar as if it were our own.

#### [Service][69]
* We will enable the missions of our clients.
* We will focus on opportunities rather than obstacles.
* We will provide solutions, not just information.
* We will pioneer new processes and technology.
* We will commit to increasing member value.

#### [Respect][70]
* We will value and encourage the sharing of new ideas.
* We will listen, actively seek input, and value the opinions of others.
* We will assume positive intent.
* We will recognize the efforts and achievements of others.

## Our culture is rooted in the communities we serve

#### Service is at the heart of Conifer Health’s values and our company’s culture. Our team members
#### are dedicated to making a positive impact in the places where they live and work. Together, we
#### commit to foster good health, combat hunger and connect humanity. The power of local
#### volunteerism combined with charitable giving helps build the strong, healthy communities we
#### want for ourselves and our clients.

## We deliver better business outcomes for clients

#### Consumers are demanding greater transparency on cost and quality, and healthcare organizations
#### and self-insured employers are focusing more on wellness and prevention. Achieving market
#### leadership requires excelling at reimbursement competencies and risk-based capabilities.
#### Aligning with a proven partner with deep expertise in health system reimbursement and
#### risk-based administration can accelerate success and improve your patient, operational and
#### financial outcomes.

## Real people and real lives inspire us to serve for better

#### We’re experts at the business of healthcare. But what truly sets us apart is how we deliver
#### revenue cycle management and value-based care services.

#### Serve for Better is a simple, but powerful mindset for how all of our team members act toward
#### any patient, client, or fellow team member. Serve for Better means we are focused on Empathy,
#### Quality, Completeness and Experience.

## We own and live a culture of ethics and compliance

#### We challenge our team members to understand and comply with applicable laws and policies; and
#### to adhere to the highest standards of ethics and integrity on behalf of our clients and Conifer
#### Health. Our Culture of Ethics and Compliance makes us a valuable business partner and employer.

#### Our compliance program is managed by our Ethics and Compliance Department, including more than
#### 100 compliance professionals, in accordance with [**Conifer’s Ethics and Compliance Program
#### Charter**][71].

**IRVING, Texas, June 24, 2026 -- **McKesson Corporation (NYSE: MCK) will release its first quarter
fiscal 2027 financial results after market close on Wednesday, August 5, 2026. The company will host
a live webcast of the earnings conference call for investors at 4:30 PM Eastern Time to review its
financial results.

The live and archived audio webcast will be available on McKesson’s Investor Relations website.

**About McKesson Corporation**

McKesson Corporation is a diversified healthcare services leader dedicated to advancing health
outcomes for patients everywhere. Our teams partner with biopharma companies, care providers,
pharmacies, manufacturers, governments, and others to deliver insights, products and services to
help make quality care more accessible and affordable. Learn more about how McKesson is impacting
virtually every aspect of healthcare at [McKesson.com][133] and read [Stories & Insights. ][134]

We routinely use our website, [investor.mckesson.com][135], to post information that may be material
to investors, such as business developments, earnings, and financial performance, as well as
presentation materials and details for upcoming and past events.

# McKesson Corporation Completes Divestiture of Norwegian Operations

January 30, 2026

**IRVING, Texas, January 30, 2026** – McKesson Corporation (NYSE: MCK) announced today that it has
closed the transaction to sell its retail and distribution businesses in Norway to NorgesGruppen, a
privately owned retail group.

McKesson announced on August 4, 2025, that it planned to divest Norway, included within the Other
segment. The transaction represents the final step in McKesson’s commitment to fully exit its
European operations.

This transaction will enable McKesson to focus strategy and capital allocation on expanding and
accelerating its growth platforms within Oncology and Multispecialty and Biopharma Services.

Additional details related to the divestiture will be provided on the Company’s Fiscal Third Quarter
Earnings call, Wednesday, February 4, 2026, and on the company’s Investor Relations website.

**IRVING, Texas, February 4, 2026 -** McKesson Corporation (NYSE:MCK) today announced results for
the third quarter ended December 31, 2025.

**Third**** Quarter Highlights: **
* Quarterly consolidated revenues of $106.2 billion increased 11%.
* Earnings per diluted share of $9.59 increased $2.64.
* Adjusted Earnings per Diluted Share of $9.34 increased 16%.
* Generated $1.2 billion of cash flow from operations and $1.1 billion of Free Cash Flow.
* McKesson closed the transaction to sell its Norwegian retail and distribution businesses to
NorgesGruppen on January 30, 2026.

**Fiscal 2026 Full Year Outlook:**
* Raised and narrowed Adjusted Earnings per Diluted Share guidance range to $38.80 to $39.20, from
the previous range of $38.35 to $38.85.
* Fiscal 2026 Adjusted Earnings per Diluted Share guidance range indicates 17% to 19% growth
compared to the prior year.
* The Company does not forecast GAAP earnings per diluted share¹.

“McKesson delivered another strong quarter, extending the momentum we’ve built across the enterprise
and demonstrating the impact of our disciplined execution,” said Brian Tyler, chief executive
officer. “Our results highlight the strength of our core distribution businesses and the meaningful
progress we are making against our strategic priorities.”

“Our oncology and multispecialty platforms, together with our expanding suite of biopharma services
programs, continue to create differentiated value and deepen the impact for our customers, partners,
and patients. The completion of the divestiture of our Norwegian businesses fulfills our commitment
to exit Europe. We remain focused on advancing a strategy to continue delivering sustainable growth
and long-term value creation.”

“As a result of our third quarter performance and operating momentum, we are raising and narrowing
our guidance range for fiscal 2026 Adjusted Earnings per Diluted Share to $38.80 to $39.20. These
strong outcomes reflect the power of our platforms and the dedication and commitment of Team
McKesson, whose focus enables us to execute consistently and deliver high‑quality results.”

**Fiscal 2026 Third Quarter Result Summary**

Third quarter revenues were $106.2 billion, an increase of 11% from a year ago, driven by growth in
the North American Pharmaceutical segment due to increased prescription volumes from retail national
account customers and growth in the distribution of oncology and multispecialty products, including
contributions from acquisitions in the Oncology & Multispecialty segment.

Third quarter earnings per diluted share was $9.59 compared to $6.95 a year ago, an increase of
$2.64, which includes a pre-tax credit within the North American Pharmaceutical segment related to
the Rite Aid bankruptcy.

Third quarter Adjusted Earnings per Diluted Share was $9.34 compared to $8.03 a year ago, an
increase of 16%, driven by strong operational growth, including contributions from acquisitions in
the Oncology & Multispecialty segment.

During the three months ended December 31, 2025, McKesson generated cash flow from operations of
$1.2 billion, and invested $175 million in capital expenditures, resulting in Free Cash Flow of $1.1
billion. During the first nine months of the fiscal year, McKesson generated cash from operations of
$2.7 billion, and invested $560 million in capital expenditures, resulting in Free Cash Flow of $2.2
billion.

For the first nine months of the fiscal year, McKesson returned $2.4 billion of cash to
shareholders, which included $2.1 billion of common stock repurchases and $280 million of dividend
payments.

**Business Highlights**
* On January 1, 2026, McKesson advanced its planned separation of the Medical-Surgical Solutions
segment by implementing transition service agreements to support the business as it prepares to be
an independent company.
* On January 30, 2026, McKesson closed the transaction to sell its retail and distribution
businesses in Norway, representing the final phase to fully exit its European operations.
* In January, McKesson’s Health Mart was honored with the prestigious H.A.B. Dunning Award from the
American Pharmacists Association, recognizing outstanding contributions to advancing the
profession and supporting community pharmacies nationwide.

**North American Pharmaceutical Segment**
* Revenues were $88.3 billion, an increase of 9%, driven by increased prescription transaction
volumes, including higher volumes from retail national account customers and specialty products.
* Segment Operating Profit was $1.1 billion. Adjusted Segment Operating Profit was $872 million, an
increase of 6%, driven by growth in the distribution of specialty products to health systems.

**Oncology & Multispecialty Segment**
* Revenues were $13.0 billion, an increase of 37%, driven by growth in provider solutions and
specialty distribution, including contributions from acquisitions.
* Segment Operating Profit was $304 million. Adjusted Segment Operating Profit was $366 million, an
increase of 57%, driven by growth in provider solutions and specialty distribution, including
contributions from acquisitions.

**Prescription Technology Solutions Segment**
* Revenues were $1.5 billion, an increase of 9%, driven by increased prescription volumes in the
third-party logistics and technology services business

#### A decade of CMS recognition: Practice Insights continues to simplify Merit-based Incentive
#### Payment System reporting for providers

**IRVING, Texas, Jan. 20, 2026** — For the tenth consecutive year, the Centers for Medicare &
Medicaid Services (CMS) has named [McKesson][133] a Qualified Clinical Data Registry (QCDR) approved
to participate in the Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS).

As a CMS-approved QCDR, McKesson’s Practice Insights — a performance analytics tool powered
by [Ontada^{®}][134], McKesson’s real-world oncology data and insights business — collects and
reports clinical data for clinicians using the[ IKnowMed][135]® electronic health record. The
designation allows practices and providers to efficiently submit data for both MIPS and custom QCDR
quality measures directly to CMS, eliminating the need for a separate registry vendor and reducing
administrative burdens.

“McKesson is focused on empowering community oncology practices with insights that support patient
care,” said Jason Hammonds, president, Oncology & Multispecialty, McKesson. “With a single,
integrated pathway for submitting quality measures and action‑oriented analytics, our QCDR helps
providers strengthen care delivery, track performance and enhance operations.”

McKesson’s Practice Insights offers nine oncology-specific QCDR measures to drive improvements in
quality and cost of care. Seven of these measures were developed in collaboration with physicians
in [The US Oncology Network][136], an organization of community-based providers supported by
McKesson:
* Screening and Achieving Resolution or Improvement of Distress for Cancer Care
* Advance Care Planning in Metastatic Cancer Patients
* Patient-Reported Pain Improvement
* Supportive Care Drug Utilization in Last 14 Days of Life
* Hepatitis B Serology Testing and Prophylactic Treatment Prior to Receiving Anti-CD20 Targeting
Drugs
* Mutation Testing for Stage IV Lung Cancer Completed Prior to the Start of Targeted Therapy
* Utilization of Prophylactic GCSF for Cancer Patients Receiving Low-Risk Chemotherapy

Two additional measures were developed by the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) and have
been approved for the fourth year:
* Antiemetic Therapy for Low- and Minimal-Emetic-Risk Antineoplastic — Avoidance of Overuse
* Appropriate Antiemetic Therapy for High- and Moderate-Emetic-Risk Antineoplastic Agents

Additionally, CMS retained two Practice Insights QCDR measures for inclusion in the 2026 Advancing
Cancer Care MIPS Value Pathways: Mutation Testing for Stage IV Lung Cancer and Utilization of
Prophylactic GCSF for Patients Receiving Low-Risk Chemotherapy. This recognition underscores the
value of McKesson’s quality measures for improving cancer care.

New for 2026 is a patient-reported outcome measure that tracks whether distress screening and
follow-up interventions lead to meaningful improvement or resolution within six months. Distress
includes physical, emotional, social, practical and spiritual concerns — key factors that affect
patient well-being and treatment outcomes. By tracking this measure through McKesson’s Practice
Insights’ QCDR, practices can gain insights into the effectiveness of psychosocial care, helping
deliver timely interventions and enhanced patient support.

“This designation reflects our dedication to oncology-focused quality improvement,” explained Erin
Crum, senior director, Quality Strategy and Innovation, McKesson and The US Oncology Network. “For
10 consecutive years, we’ve empowered practices with integrated tools to track performance, reduce
reporting burdens and align with value-based care programs. Through efforts such as these, we
continue to advance patient-centered, outcome-driven care.”

**IRVING, TX, March 19, 2026—**Registration is now open for [McKesson ideaShare 2026][133], a
