## How We Streamline Gynecology Billing and Coding For Your Practice

We are home to OB/GYN coding specialists certified in COBGC and billers recognized by AAPC and AMA.
We streamline your entire billing process by leveraging well-defined processes and the latest
OB/GYN-specific billing software. Our services offer billing support to gynecology providers,
offering antepartum care, delivery services, postpartum care, infertility services, routine
gynecological exams, screenings (such as Pap smears), and surgical procedures, among others. Here's
how we optimize your billing operations:
* Integrate digital systems such as electronic medical records (EMR), electronic health records
(EHR), and electronic data interchange (EDI) into gynecology-specific billing software to
modernize and streamline billing processes, replacing manual tasks with efficient electronic
claims processing workflows.
* Collate all patient information, including demographics, medical history, and referrals, and
thoroughly verify insurance details such as coverage type, prior authorization status with
effective dates and expiration dates, and claims address to ensure accurate claims documentation.
* Confirm if pre-authorization is required for any gynecology services rendered and request approval
from payers if necessary.
* Ensure code specificity and compliance with regulatory guidelines when managing various OB/GYN
billing models, including value-based care, fee-for-service, capitation, and global billing.
* Align claims documentation with the latest CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS level II code ranges.
* Leverage digital workflows to ensure OB/GYN code precision (56405 – 58999 CPT code range) while
creating claims documentation to capture diagnosis, services, and equipment accurately.
* Stay on top of fee schedules and claims submission guidelines for all payers (Medicare, Medicaid,
Marketplace plans, Tricare, VHA, and private insurers like Blue Cross Blue Shield, Cigna, etc.) to
minimize claims denials and maximize reimbursements.
* Review claims against Explanation of Benefits (EOB) provided by payers to pinpoint causes of
claims denials. Resolve discrepancies and initiate the appeals process as necessary.
* Communicate with payers to generate patients' benefits and gain clarity on deductibles,
copayments, and coinsurance. Inform patients on their patient responsibilities to prevent unpaid
bills.
* Assign certified patient accounts representatives to ensure precise processing of electronic
payments for each patient account from the payers.

## How We Streamline Neurology Billing for Your Practice

Our certified professional coders (CPC) and certified professional billers (CPB) have the knowledge
required for addressing complex neurology billing processes. They are proficient in current coding
guidelines (CPT codes for common neurology conditions, neuromuscular procedures, and 26 and 69
modifiers) and regulations. Here is how we will do it for you:
* Use neurology-specific billing software integrated with technologies such as electronic data
interchange (EDI), electronic health records (EHR), and electronic medical records (EMR) to
facilitate electronic claims submissions and electronic payments.
* Capture accurate patient information (patient demographics, physician referral data, Medicare,
Medicaid or social security number, medical history) and insurance information (provider
information, coverage type, prior authorization details, claims address, effective date,
expiration date, etc.) to reduce errors and claims denials.
* Check whether any of the required neurology practices need preauthorization and apply for
approval.
* Designate experts with specialized skills to manage the complete process of value-based billing,
telemedicine billing, capitation billing, episode-of-care billing, and other related tasks from
start to finish.
* Manage several billing types for our clients, including Evaluation and Management (E/M) Billing,
Procedure-Based Billing (e.g., EEG, EMG, nerve conduction studies), Ancillary Services Billing
(e.g., imaging studies, laboratory tests), Long-Term Monitoring Billing (e.g., for continuous EEG
or ambulatory EEG), and Neurophysiology Testing Billing (e.g., sleep studies, evoked potentials)
more.
* Ensure billing accuracy by complying with American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC)- mandated
code specificity (ICD-10 Codes, 95700-96020 CPT code range, evaluation and management (E/M) codes,
HCPCS codes, diagnostic testing codes for EEGs, EMGs, nerve conduction studies, etc.,
neurostimulator programming codes, codes specifying medical necessity, place of service (POS)
codes, among others).
* Offer accurate billing and coding solutions to neurology medical practices specializing in
epilepsy and seizure disorders, multiple sclerosis (MS), Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's disease,
and more.
* File claims while adhering to the varying fee schedules and payment regulations of Medicare,
Medicaid, workers' compensation insurance, Tricare, and other private insurance payers, such as
Blue Cross Blue Shield Association and Humana.
* Implement a dedicated claims status specialist to manage patient inquiries and liaise with payers,
ensuring timely claims adjudication.
* Receive EOBs from payers to manage transparent and detailed reports outlining charges, approved
amounts, deductibles, copayments, and coinsurance for each patient. Notify patients about their
payment responsibilities for out-of-pocket expenses.

## Streamline Outsourced Physical Therapy Billing Services with Invensis

Physical therapy billing is the complex process of coding, submitting, and following up on insurance
claims for services rendered by physical therapists. The billing process requires in-depth knowledge
of therapy-specific coding guidelines, such as CPT codes for physical therapy exercises, manual
therapy, and neuromuscular reeducation, and understanding the unique documentation requirements for
each. Additionally, physical therapy billing must address payer-specific regulations, including
Medicare's 8-minute rule, which determines how units of timed procedures are billed, and therapy cap
limits restricting the amount of therapy services covered.

Failing to justify the medical necessity of a therapeutic exercise in progress notes results in
reimbursement issues. Moreover, physical therapy providers often face payer audits scrutinising
compliance with treatment duration rules, such as time-based and service-based billing distinctions.
These audits can trigger costly penalties if discrepancies are found. Managing multiple payer rules
and navigating frequent changes in insurance policies also complicates timely claim submissions and
revenue cycle efficiency. These administrative burdens detract from the time available for patient
care and can disrupt cash flow if billing inefficiencies arise.

Invensis, as among the leading physical therapy billing service providers, ensures specialized
support that addresses the unique challenges faced by physical therapy practices and enhances
revenue cycle management by:
* Collecting and verifying patient demographics, insurance coverage, and benefits and confirming
therapy-specific coverage, including limitations, patient co-pays, deductibles, and authorization
requirements.
* Obtaining prior authorization for physical therapy services, confirming the number of approved
visits and validating coverage details to ensure compliance with payer requirements.
* Applying relevant CPT codes (e.g., 97110 for therapeutic exercises, 97140 for manual therapy
techniques, 97530 for therapeutic activities), utilizing appropriate ICD-10 codes to indicate the
medical necessity for therapy claims, such as M54.5 for low back pain or R26.2 for difficulty in
walking and adding correct modifiers (e.g., GP for services delivered under a physical therapy
plan of care, 59 for distinct procedural services) to differentiate services and avoid claim
rejections.
* Preparing and submitting clean claims electronically, ensuring compliance with payer-specific
guidelines, including the 8-minute rule for time-based codes.
* Identifying claim denials and conducting root-cause analysis (e.g., missing modifiers, medical
necessity issues).
* Resubmitting corrected claims with appropriate documentation and appeal denials when necessary.
* Posting insurance payments and reconciling Explanation of Benefits (EOBs) for therapy services
with claims.
* Identifying underpayments or overpayments and taking corrective action.
* Generating patient statements for outstanding balances after insurance payments.
* Managing collections for unpaid balances, including follow-up with patients.
* Providing detailed financial reports, including Accounts Receivable (AR) ageing, denial patterns,
and physical therapy reimbursement rates.
* Monitoring KPIs, such as Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) and clean claim rates, to optimize revenue
cycle efficiency.

## How We Streamline Anesthesia Medical Billing for Your Practice

Our AAPA and AMA-certified professionals have wide experience in providing accurate billing and
coding services for anesthesia practices. Their understanding of the common to complex challenges in
anesthesia billing makes them adept at addressing the needs of diverse medical entities. These
entities include hospitals, anesthetic groups, urgent care centers, independent anesthetists, and
doctors specializing in general anesthesia, regional anesthesia, local anesthesia, ambulatory
anesthesia, and monitored anesthesia care. Here is how we deliver our anesthesia billing services to
our clients:
* Leverage billing software integrated with systems such as EHR, EDI, EMR, PCS, and other tools to
minimize the need for manual data entry and paperwork.

## Streamline Outsourced Chiropractic Medical Billing Services with Invensis

Chiropractic billing is the structured process of submitting and following up on claims to secure
reimbursement for chiropractic services rendered by practitioners. This billing process is vital for
chiropractic clinics to ensure accurate and timely payments for various services, including
Chiropractic Manipulative Treatment (CMT), physical therapy modalities, diagnostic imaging, and
rehabilitative services.

The foundation of chiropractic billing relies on the precise use of codes to classify services,
including CPT codes, ICD-10-CM codes, HCPCS codes, etc. These codes must be accurately assigned to
match the services provided, ensuring that insurance companies recognize the procedures and offer
appropriate reimbursement.

Implementing a structured billing approach allows chiropractic practices to reduce errors, prevent
revenue loss, and ensure timely payment, ultimately enhancing cash flow. Nevertheless, chiropractic
practices often face various challenges in their billing processes. These challenges include the
intricacies of insurance coverage, frequent updates to chiropractic billing codes, and potential
inaccuracies in patient information or treatment documentation. The evolving landscape of insurance
policies can also lead to misunderstandings regarding coverage limitations and copayments,
complicating the billing process and potentially delaying payments.

Invensis provides expert chiropractic billing services to help practices navigate these challenges
by offering tailored solutions that streamline operations, enhance revenue capture, and ensure
compliance with the latest industry standards. Our chiropractic billing consultants focus on
empowering chiropractic clinics and optimizing their billing processes in the following ways:
* Gathering essential patient demographics, medical history, physician referral information, and
complete insurance details, including coverage type, prior authorization status (with effective
and expiration dates), and claims address for accurate electronic claims processing.
* Handling the complex process of obtaining pre-authorization for necessary treatments and
procedures, ensuring the services are covered by insurance before they are performed, preventing
unexpected patient costs, and optimizing revenue capture.
* Integrating digital capabilities such as Electronic Health Records (EHR), Electronic Medical
Records (EMR), and Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) into chiropractic-specific billing software
to digitize processes from electronic billing to receiving electronic payments.
* Adhering to coding guidelines, documentation standards, and payer policies by managing diverse
chiropractic billing models, such as membership or subscription-based billing, cash-based or
direct pay billing, etc.
* Staying updated with changes in CMT, CPT, and ICD-10-CM codebooks, as well as E/M codes and HCPCS,
to avoid costly coding errors and ensure the assignment of correct codes for chiropractic CPT
codes (98940-98942), Chiropractic Manipulative Treatment (CMT), ICD-10-CM diagnoses, and modifiers
25 and 59.
* Deploying accurate billing and coding for various chiropractic techniques—such as diversified
techniques, activator methods, Gonstead techniques, etc. to treat conditions like back pain, neck
pain, headaches, joint pain, etc.
* Ensuring compliance with evolving regulations and reimbursement structures for all payers,
including Medicare, Medicare Advantage Plans, Medicaid, Workers' Compensation, and private
insurers like Aetna.
* Streamlining claims submission through automated systems, ensuring timely and accurate electronic
claims filing, and continuously tracking the submitted claims for prompt follow-up on unpaid or
denied claims.
* Analyzing denial reasons, verifying claims for services rendered, gathering necessary
documentation, and resubmitting claims to maximize reimbursement.
* Providing a detailed breakdown of out-of-pocket expenses, including deductibles, copayments, and
coinsurance for each service, to help patients understand their financial responsibilities and
prevent unpaid claims.
* Generating detailed financial reports that offer insights into billing performance, collections,
and revenue trends to identify opportunities for improvement and strategic growth.

FAQ

## Frequently asked questions

What is a pharmacy benefit manager?

A Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) is an administrator who processes prescription drug claims on
behalf of payers, such as employers and health plans.

[The role of a PBM][32] also includes handling numerous other behind-the-scenes processes, from plan
design to real-time data exchange, payments, eligibility, card printing, formulary management, and
much more.

Is Capital Rx a transparent PBM?

Yes! Capital Rx is a [transparent PBM][33] in all aspects of pharmacy benefits management. We never
earn revenue on drug spend, pass through 100% of manufacturer rebates to employers, and leverage a
public pricing benchmark – National Average Drug Acquisition Cost (NADAC) - to offer trustworthy and
reliable visibility into drug pricing.

What is NADAC and why does Capital Rx use it?

[NADAC is a public benchmark][34] calculated by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS)
that reflects the average amount pharmacies pay wholesalers for medications. As opposed to Average
Wholesale Price (AWP), which is based on wholesale pricing data that private companies collect from
drug manufacturers, and does not include rebates or discounts, NADAC offers a fair and transparent
view into real drug costs. Capital Rx uses NADAC to provide fair and transparent pricing for clients
and transparent reimbursement to pharmacies. Additionally, NADAC’s public availability allows
clients to hold us accountable for our transparency as a PBM.

How does implementation work with Capital Rx?

Capital Rx delivers a [seamless and efficient implementation experience][35]. Our dedicated team
guides clients through every step, facilitating smooth data migration and integration with existing
systems, minimizing member disruption by addressing concerns promptly, enabling continuity of care,
and helping maintain existing pharmacy relationships where possible.

How does Capital Rx handle rebates from drug manufacturers?

Capital Rx passes 100% of [drug manufacturer rebates][36] through to clients, eliminating hidden
fees and redirecting all financial benefits to them.

Anthony J. Loiacono

Anthony J. Loiacono
Chief Executive Officer

AJ is a serial entrepreneur with over 20 years of experience in pharmacy benefits, finance, and
software development. As the CEO of Capital Rx, his mission is to upgrade America’s healthcare
infrastructure to deliver the highest level of client service and patient engagement while reducing
total cost of care. AJ has spent his career studying the pharmaceutical supply chain and developing
solutions that have continually redefined the pharmacy benefit industry to achieve this goal. Before
Capital Rx, AJ was a co-founder of Truveris, where he served for eight years as CEO, CIO, and a
board member, leading the company to record growth (Deloitte FAST 500 and Crain’s Fast 50). Prior to
Truveris, AJ co-founded SMS Partners, a joint venture with Realogy (RLGY), and in 2010 exited the
partnership with a buyout. In his first venture, AJ started Victrix, a pharmaceutical supply chain
consultancy, which was successfully sold to Chrysalis Solutions in 2007.

Plan in NY, and President of Medco’s Employer Account division, where he also served as an Executive

leadership positions at Signify Health, Empire Blue Cross Blue Shield, and Oxford Health Plans.

Cotiviti.

# Building the infrastructure we need to revolutionize healthcare for all

Judi Health™ started out as Capital Rx with a mission to solve the inefficiencies and transparency
issues prevalent in the traditional PBM model.

## We set out to change the way prescriptions are priced and patients are cared for to deliver
## enduring social change.
## We quickly realized that to accomplish this lofty goal, health benefits administration must be
## simplified, transparent, and connected.

##### If you're not involved with the actual plan administration or claim adjudication, you can't
##### change much. So, to fix the problem, I felt like we had to become the problem - become the
##### PBM. And that's exactly what we did.

AJ Loiacono

## Frequently asked questions

What is Judi Health?

[Judi Health][35] is the industry’s first unified claim processing platform that seamlessly
administers both pharmacy and medical claims on one platform. Designed for employer plan sponsors,
health systems, and health plans, Judi operates on a single, integrated platform to simplify
benefits management and improve care coordination.

Is Judi Health a secure platform for managing healthcare benefits?

Yes. [Judi Health is built with security at its core][36], following FISMA NIST 800-53 controls -
among the most rigorous in the industry. Its serverless architecture and use of fully-managed AWS
services reduce vulnerabilities and minimize ransomware risks. Judi also provides:

* Real-time monitoring for threats and anomalies
* Advanced malware and vulnerability detection
* Extensive content filtering to protect end users

Is Judi Health a plug-and-play solution for payers and health plans?

Easily integrate your choice of best-in-class point solutions, such as telemedicine, disease
management or women's health directly into Judi Health to continue providing uninterrupted benefits
to your members.

How does Judi Health help with regulatory compliance?

Judi Health streamlines annual compliance by:

* Validating SBCs with Phia to ensure accuracy
* Managing timely and accurate 5500 filings
* Supporting full ERISA documentation and disclosures
* Handling state-specific reporting like NY’s HCRA

How does Judi Health support the transition to value-based care?

Judi Health™ supports the shift to [value-based care ][37]by integrating medical and pharmacy claims
into a single platform. This unified system enables real-time data sharing, centralized services,
and innovative pricing models, which help reduce administrative burden and improve care
coordination.

While the healthcare system is still fragmented, with providers, payers, pharma, and PBMs often
working independently, Judi Health helps bridge these gaps. By offering comprehensive data
collection and analysis, the platform empowers all stakeholders to collaborate more effectively,
align incentives, and advance toward better outcomes in quality, equity, and cost.

## Frequently asked questions

What is* *Capital Rx’s *Never Move Again™*, and how does it work?

[*Never Move Again™* ][30] is a health benefit administration solution that offers larger employer
groups (more than 10,000 employees) a stable, scalable foundation for their health benefits program.

It includes Judi®, Capital Rx’s AI-powered [enterprise health platform for claim adjudication][31]
and data storage/access, and an award-winning customer contact center for member service.

Plan sponsors also have the flexibility to evaluate fulfillment and other “commodity” services
individually, if they’d like.

What are the advantages of unbundling PBM services compared to traditional bundled services?

Plan sponsors can see the cost of the individual services in an [unbundled model][32] and can tailor
their plan to meet the specific needs of their populations.

There is also assurance that any mistakes made whereby a member may receive more of a medication
than is needed, or a relatively more expensive medication vs. a cheaper alternative are not the
result of misaligned incentives that harm the plan.

How will unbundling affect the member experience?

With *Never Move Again™*, plan’s members have a more stable experience. There’s no need to change ID
cards, contact center numbers, or other resources.

And there’s no disruption due to claim history access issues, since everything is stored in one
place.

There should also be more benefits due to customization and the ability for the plan sponsor to add
or remove services that may be or are not providing a positive ROI or good experience.

What is Judi and how does it support unbundling?

Judi is Capital Rx’s AI-powered enterprise health platform, often referred to as “the brains” of our
organization.

It houses member data, plan design, prior authorization, and other tools and workflows that are
required to administer a health benefit program, all in one easy-to-use system.

Can Judi integrate with any point solution?

Yes. Any vendor leveraging API technology can connect to and share data or information with Capital
Rx.

Defined Monthly Rx Plan Premium Cost

## What is a level-funded pharmacy benefit plan?

A level-funded plan combines the security of defined monthly payments with the opportunity to
benefit if the overall experience is better than expected.

Your monthly rate covers claims, admin fees, and stop-loss protection. Capital Equilibrium stands
apart by offering a fair pricing structure that eliminates the traditional PBM gameplay around
discounts and rebates, which often results in overstated, unachievable savings expectations.

## Aligned with industry-leading partners

An A-Rated stop-loss carrier for reinsurance to back claims exceeding monthly amounts means cost
control for claims covered by the policy.

Equilibrium to bend the curve for plan sponsors through its unique features across all 50 states.

What is a level-funded pharmacy benefit plan?

A [level-funded pharmacy benefit plan][31] offers a defined monthly premium rate covering expected

Who should choose Capital Equilibrium?

Municipalities and employers looking for a combination of cost savings, flexibility, and budgeting

Capital Equilibrium leverages the financial value offered by Capital Rx, a 100% passthrough PBM, to

# Rolling out your own discount card solution is easy

Leverage the Advantage program as is or white label your own solution to bring consistent, low
pricing to your underinsured populations.

Talk to Our Experts
Talk to Our Experts

## Affordable. Transparent. Reliable.

One Flat Fee

A simple $0.99 flat fee per adjudicated claim, eliminating hidden costs.

Data Privacy

Consumer data is never sold, safeguarding personal information.

Fair Pricing Models

Transparent, consistent pricing that puts pharmacies and consumers first.

No Hidden Fees

Traditional cards use spread pricing, we don’t. Enjoy straightforward, honest pricing.

## Flexible solutions for diverse needs

From Fortune 100 companies to municipalities, whether you’re looking to support underinsured
populations or engage members with branded features, Capital Rx’s Discount Card adapts to your
needs.

## Your brand. Our backend.

Launch your own prescription savings card powered by Capital Rx’s proven infrastructure.

With full white label capabilities you control the branding while we handle the heavy lifting
including pricing claims processing and pharmacy access. Deliver real savings and measurable impact
all under your name.

FAQ

## Frequently asked questions

Who is eligible to use a discount card?

Everyone. While this is not health insurance, your members and their families can use the card for
significant prescription savings.

Everyone is eligible to use the [Capital Rx Advantage Card][30]. While this is not a health
insurance program, presenting this prescription savings card to the pharmacist can help you and your
family get discounts on your prescriptions.

Can members use the card alongside insurance?

No, discount cards cannot be combined with insurance such as Medicare or Medicaid but are ideal for
out-of-pocket expenses.

Can this program be white-labeled?

Absolutely. Capital Rx enables full branding customization for organizations looking to offer
prescription savings while enhancing their brand’s visibility and trust.

What are the fees associated with the program?

We offer flexible implementation options tailored to client needs, including some programs with no
implementation fees. Premium options include advanced features and monthly fees.

## Ready to launch your own discount card?

White label your own program with fast setup and transparent pricing.

messages claiming to be from someone at Capital Rx that include suspicious attachments or URLs or
request sensitive information (e.g., social security number, bank account information, etc.)

# All-Inclusive Turn-Key Solutions
# for Small to Big Practices

MAVA Care is a leading medical billing company that offers a wide range of medical billing services
in USA to help you increase your revenue. We incorporate up-to-date technology and current industry
trends in the processing of your claims. Practicing medicine is one of the most difficult careers.
Hence, we strive to assist our clients in receiving credible billing and coding services.

Our team of experts ensures that you receive quality medical billing services while ensuring that
all the medical billing is done following the law as set under HIPAA and other state and national
laws. You can reach out to our team today for a consultation and find out how we can assist you in
developing your practice to the next level.

[ Book a Free Consultation ][35]

## Services Offered by MAVA Care

As a medical billing company, we understand that each healthcare practice is unique. Our
comprehensive services enable you to improve the cash flow of your practice, increase patient
satisfaction, and efficiently streamline the operations.

### Medical Billing Services

We offer full medical billing services in USA such as claims processing, revenue cycle management,
and payment collection. Our skilled team indicates that insurance claims are processed accurately
and efficiently. We seek to maximize revenue while minimizing administrative costs for healthcare
providers.

[ Explore More   ][36]

### Medical Coding Services

We offer medical coding services to ensure accurate and efficient coding of medical procedures and
diagnoses. Our team adheres to the latest coding standards and guidelines. We help healthcare
providers improve reimbursement rates and reduce claim denials.

[ Explore More   ][37]

### Medical Credentialing Services

Our medical billing company provides medical credentialing services to verify and validate the
qualifications of healthcare providers. Our team handles the entire credentialing process, ensuring
compliance with industry standards. We streamline the approval process to enhance provider
efficiency and access to insurance networks.

[ Explore More   ][38]

### Virtual Medical Staff

We provide virtual medical staff services, offering skilled professionals for remote healthcare
support. Our virtual team includes physicians, nurses, and administrative staff who work efficiently
from any location. We enhance patient care and operational efficiency through flexible, remote
solutions.

[ Explore More   ][39]

### Patient Eligibility Verification

Our dedicated team of AR and eligibility verification focuses on simplifying the insurance process
so that your healthcare work runs smoothly. We’ll take your revenue management to the next level
through our unique verification process.

[ Explore More   ][40]

### Denial Management Services

We provide denial management services to address and resolve denied insurance claims. Our team
identifies the root causes of denials and implements corrective actions. We work to optimize
reimbursement rates and improve the overall claims process.

[Dhinesh R - Digital Marketing Manager of MBW RCM]

In his current role as a Digital Marketing Manager and Creative Technologist, Dhineh specializes in

outcomes. His technology-driven approach enables organizations to strengthen their online presence,
enhance audience engagement, and achieve sustainable digital growth.

Puducherry, which laid the foundation for his analytical thinking and problem-solving approach.
Further strengthening his expertise, he has earned dual certifications in Artificial Intelligence
and Digital Marketing, enabling him to combine technological innovation with strategic marketing
practices. These academic achievements highlight his commitment to continuous learning and
professional growth, empowering him to leverage AI-driven insights and modern marketing strategies
to deliver measurable business impact.

# Bakiyalakshmi R, Service Delivery Manager - Medical Coding

Dec 31
Written By [MBW RCM][205]
[Bakiyalakshmi]

Bakiyalakshmi is a Service Delivery Manager at MBW RCM, where her 14 years of extensive experience
in medical coding shine through her exemplary leadership and management skills. Her keen eye for
detail and meticulous approach empower her to effectively manage 23 projects, with a particular
focus on efficiently resolving coding-related denials and appeals. She is also actively involved in
client communications and process coordination, leveraging her rich background from senior roles at
AdvantEdge Healthcare Solutions and Visionary RCM Infotech. In these positions, she not only led
significant projects but also played a crucial role in training denial management teams, upholding
stringent quality standards.

Previously, as a Manager of Operations, Bakiyalakshmi demonstrated her unwavering commitment to
excellence, skillfully overseeing 12 HIM projects and leading a dedicated team of 40 members. Her
academic credentials, including a degree in Physiotherapy (BPT) from Sree Balaji College of
Physiotherapy in Chennai with specializations in Orthopaedics, Neurology, and Cardiology, reflect
her deep-rooted dedication to the healthcare field. She further augmented her expertise with a
Diploma in Yoga Therapy from the University of Madras.

Bakiyalakshmi also holds a Six Sigma Black Belt certification, a testament to her dedication to
quality and continuous process improvement. This impressive combination of educational and
professional achievements exemplifies her multifaceted expertise and commitment to the healthcare
management industry.

Chinna has over 11 years of experience working in information technology focused on managing the
healthcare system environment. His expertise spans multiple domains of information technology and
security. Chinna believes that technology plays an important role in supporting organizational
processes and enhancing value. He possesses strong knowledge of budgeting, analytics, IT policies
and methodologies, flexibility, and a high level of customer service.

As an enterprise IT manager, Chinna is responsible for the following essential IT elements and
services - Asset lifecycle, Capacity monitoring/planning, Storage and Network utilization, Energy
consumption, Environmental issues, Facilities (including data center infrastructure management),

leadership to our IT team and is engaged in building a high-performance IT team by hiring, training,
and mentoring personnel. He has excellent organizational skills and can clearly convey information
to the entire Team to maintain a professional and collegial environment.

Prior to MBW RCM, Chinna is worked with companies such as Suntronics, and Visionary RCM Infotech. He
holds a bachelor’s degree in computer applications and is passionate about launching, building, and
sustaining technology infrastructure.

# Mike O’Connell - CFO

Apr 13
Written By [MBW RCM][205]

**Chief Financial Officer – MBW RCM **

Mike O’Connell is an accomplished financial executive and licensed CPA with deep expertise in
corporate finance, accounting operations, and strategic consulting. He currently serves as Chief
Financial Officer of MBW RCM, where he oversees financial strategy, compliance, and operational
performance to support sustainable growth in the healthcare revenue cycle management sector.

In addition to his role at MBW RCM, Michael is the Managing Partner of Moca CPA Group, a
Chicago-based firm providing outsourced accounting, tax consultation, and financial advisory
services to small and mid-sized businesses. Under his leadership, the firm has built a reputation
for delivering high-quality, cost-effective solutions that empower clients to scale effectively and
make data-driven decisions.

Previously, Michael held senior leadership roles at PBG Financial Services, serving as Partner and
Principal in Consulting Services, as well as working as a Fractional CFO and Controller for a range
of clients. His career also includes financial leadership at Howe Corporation, where he managed
global accounting operations and HR functions, and technical accounting roles with Vantage Specialty
Chemicals and ViskoTeepak, where he specialized in cost accounting, inventory management, and ERP
system optimization.

Michael brings a track record of success in full-cycle financial management, including P&L
ownership, audits, forecasting, tax compliance, internal controls, and process improvement. He is
recognized for building strong cross-functional teams, implementing innovative business intelligence
tools, and aligning finance with long-term organizational strategy.

Michael holds a Bachelor’s Degree in Economics and French from Davidson College and earned his CPA
certification through the College of Lake County. Fluent in French and skilled in leveraging ERP and
accounting technologies, he combines technical expertise with strategic vision to drive results.

# Satish Chandar (Melvin Miller), COO

Apr 11
Written By [MBW RCM][205]

An experienced Chief Operating Officer with a demonstrated history of working in the healthcare
industry for over 15 years, Satish, a.k.a. Melvin, has experience in team building, business
development, Healthcare Information Technology (HIT), revenue cycle process training, US. Health
Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), and Healthcare Management.

Satish (Melvin) joined MBW RCM in late 2010 when it was a small company of around ten people. He has
been part of the core team. Along with Vinod, he has helped grow the Company to over 300 employees
with multiple locations in Chennai and Bangalore and numerous clients (US medical billing companies
& EMR companies). Along with increasing the Company – he has personally grown from a Senior Manager
to the Chief Operating Officer & a Director in the Company.

Before joining MBW RCM, he worked with other healthcare outsourcing firms in India, including
Visionary RCM, Perot Systems, and Omega Healthcare. He started his RCM career as a caller (the
reason for the name Melvin, which has stayed on with our customers) and then transitioned into a
trainer and a manager before he moved to MBW.

Satish holds an engineering degree from Bharath University.

# Vinod Sankaran, Founder & CEO

Apr 10
Written By [MBW RCM][205]

Vinod is consumed by the need to eliminate inefficiencies from the healthcare sector. He brings over
15 years of experience in operations, financial analysis, strategy, growth, corporate development,
strategic planning, and marketing. At MBW RCM, he is involved in applying experience to optimize
revenue cycle process flows to improve our clients' profitability and performance.

As a member of the founding team of MBW RCM, Vinod has helped MBW RCM grow from 5 employees in 2010
to over 300 employees with multiple locations in Chennai and Bangalore, supporting numerous medical
billing companies, revenue cycle software providers, and EMR companies. As the CEO, he is tasked
with developing the company, new client acquisition, and applying new generation technology to drive
revenue and profitability.

Before starting MBW RCM, Vinod served as Director of Operations at One World United (OWU), an
organization offering healthcare solutions to corporations and individuals seeking medical treatment
abroad. Earlier, he worked as a Senior Financial Analyst for Sprint Telecom, where he was honored
with the "2005 Sprint Excellence Award" and earned the distinction of "Most Effective Employee."

The dual master's degrees in quantitative finance and Industrial Engineering that he received from
Oklahoma State University and extensive experience and achievements within the healthcare arena
allow him to offer demonstrable economic benefit, enhancing medical practices' revenue cycle
management and profitability.

# About MBW RCM

Founded by medical billers, coders, and healthcare subject matter experts,[ MBW RCM][206] is today
the trusted back office partner for some of the top medical billing companies, physician practices,
healthcare systems, revenue cycle, and EHR system providers in the United States. We have a team
of over 700 medical billers, coders, and accounts receivable professionals, who support over 40
customers, MBW RCM was conceptualized with the view of providing technology-enabled differentiation
to our clients. Over the years, we have not only acquired competence across multiple specialties,
we have also built an array of technology solutions to support our operations. These technologies
include:
* [Robotic Process Automation Solutions ][207]
* Workflow automation solution
* [Enabling technologies for people management and performance improvement][208]
* Analytical tools that shift focus to collections

### We lead with technology and automation to help you do more with your revenue cycle.

Consumed by our purpose of being **the most agile healthcare services company** in the world, we
have created a strong delivery model combining the knowledge of our people with market-leading
technologies to deliver great revenue cycle outcomes to our customers.

[Who We Serve- Healthcare Revenue Cycle]

### Who we serve

When you work with MBW RCM, you join over 50 clients who rely on us to achieve financial success
through their revenue cycle.

Our clients include medical billing companies, hospital billing service providers, focused physician
credentialing companies, medical coding companies, healthcare automation services providers,
physician practices and hospital systems.

We are focused on solving some of the most complex problems of the revenue cycle business by
applying technology and process automation.

[Revenue Cycle Services]

### How we add value

When you work with MBW RCM, you gain from the expertise of over 700 qualified revenue cycle
professionals who can not only provide your processing support but also industry leading advisory
services. We infuse energy into your revenue cycle by helping your streamline processes, providing
your great reporting, and ensure that you are able to collect every dollar possible. Our processes
are engineered to help you achieve compliance while achieving the financial outcomes you seek.

We apply technology to make the complex work of revenue cycle simple. enabling you to take an
integrated view into your revenue cycle.

[Revenue Cycle Partnership]

### Partner in Progress

We are your partner in progress. Working with MBW RCM, you get a dedicated account partner who is
focused on helping you improve your financial outcomes. Along with a strong, knowledgeable workforce
and process automation, you get the benefit of HIPAA compliance and best-in-class information
security.

Let us help you navigate through the challenges of your revenue cycle.

# About us

Healthcare is the second largest expenditure in the United States with totals of 4 Trillion dollars
in 2020. Healthcare institutions and providers average 10% of charges in accounts receivables
equating to about 400 Billion dollars at any given time.

These claims are the toughest to collect and most ultimately age past timely filing allowing for
tremendous insurance company windfalls. MedFeeTree helps providers recapture their portion of that
400 Billion and disperses it to the hard working providers that earned it and to the most qualified
and skilled medical billers that worked it.

The backbone of MedFeeTree is our team of highly skilled billing professionals. This team of revenue
cycle management experts maintains and supports the secure and confidential structure of this unique
application allowing it to service providers and billers with the highest degree of Privacy and
Security.

[Watch Video][41] [Go to FAQ][42]

## MedFeeTree Leadership

#### Cory M. Boyle, MHSA

President and Member

Cory M. Boyle graduated from Kansas State University with a Bachelor of Science degree in Health
Information Management in 2000 and received a Masters in Health Care Administration from the
University of Kansas School of Medicine in 2003. Cory leads the Revenue Cycle Management services
for Medical Care Associates, L.L.C., and is a founding member of MedFeeTree.

#### Brennan P. Fagan

Legal Counsel and Member

Brennan graduated from the University of Kansas School of Law in 2001 and was admitted to the Kansas
Bar in 2001 and to the Missouri Bar in 2002. Brennan is a member of the Douglas County Bar
Association, the Kansas Bar Association, the Missouri Bar Association, and the American Bar
Association. His legal practice at Fagan Emert & Davis, L.L.C. focuses on the areas of Commercial
Litigation, Personal Injury, and General Civil Litigation.

#### Michele Hammann

CPA and Controller

Michele C. Hammann, CPA, CVA is Vice President of Healthcare for Summers, Spencer & Company, P.A.
and currently serves as Controller for Medical Care Associates L.L.C and MedFeeTree.

#### Julie Schill

Chief Marketing Officer

Julie brings 15 years of healthcare industry knowledge with expertise in systems implementations,
brand development, copywriting, and content creation. Julie is responsible for overseeing the
planning, development, and execution of MedFeeTree’s marketing and advertising initiatives.

# About us

Healthcare is the second largest expenditure in the United States with totals of 4 Trillion dollars
in 2020. Healthcare institutions and providers average 10% of charges in accounts receivables
equating to about 400 Billion dollars at any given time.

These claims are the toughest to collect and most ultimately age past timely filing allowing for
tremendous insurance company windfalls. MedFeeTree helps providers recapture their portion of that
400 Billion and disperses it to the hard working providers that earned it and to the most qualified
and skilled medical billers that worked it.

The backbone of MedFeeTree is our team of highly skilled billing professionals. This team of revenue
cycle management experts maintains and supports the secure and confidential structure of this unique
application allowing it to service providers and billers with the highest degree of Privacy and
Security.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

### [ How does MedFeeTree handle claims denied multiple times?][42]

Each denial is reviewed for the specific reason, corrected with clinical documentation or coding
adjustments, and resubmitted with required information to overturn the payer decision. Recoverable
claims are not written off.

### [ Can MedFeeTree process claims for practices offering both in-office and telemedicine
### visits?][43]

Telehealth modifiers, POS codes, and payer-specific rules are applied accurately to ensure
consistent revenue management for mixed care models.

### [ How long does onboarding take?][44]

Most practices are operationally onboarded within a few business days. Once payer
credentials, fee schedules, and system access are confirmed, accounts are reviewed and claims
processing begins promptly.

### [ Does MedFeeTree handle patient responsibility billing?][45]

Yes. Full-cycle claims processing includes patient balance identification, statement generation, and
follow-up on copays and deductibles.

### [ What coding standards are followed for chiropractic practices?][46]

CPT coding for spinal manipulation, AT modifier for active care, and recurring visit authorization
tracking are applied to reduce denials and improve collections.

### [ How is provider credentialing and payer enrollment handled?][47]

Provider enrollment and payer credentialing are part of onboarding. Correct enrollment ensures
claims are submitted under the proper NPI and taxonomy codes, improving first-pass claim acceptance.

Accurate claim creation is the foundation of a healthy revenue cycle. We prepare and submit therapy
claims using structured workflows designed to support accurate billing submissions, organized

**Insurance Eligibility & Benefits Verification**

One of the most common causes of claim denials is billing for services before confirming a patient's
active coverage and benefit details. Our team verifies patient insurance coverage, therapy benefits,
authorization requirements, and eligibility details before claim submission to help reduce billing
issues and minimize claim denials.

**Therapy Coding & Documentation Review**

Coding accuracy is critical in therapy billing, where a single incorrect CPT or diagnosis code can
result in a claim denial, audit flag, or reimbursement reduction. We support accurate coding
workflows and review therapy documentation to help ensure claims align with payer-specific billing
requirements, treatment documentation standards, and reimbursement guidelines.

Navigating prior authorization and referral requirements is one of the most time-consuming
administrative burdens for therapy practices. Many therapy services require referrals or prior
authorization approvals before treatment begins, and failing to secure these in advance can result
in claim denials and delayed reimbursements.

directly impacts your practice's cash flow. Denied or delayed therapy claims are reviewed,
corrected, and resubmitted through organized workflows designed to improve claim resolution
efficiency and reimbursement follow-up processes.

**Account Receivable (AR) Follow-up Services**

Outstanding receivables represent revenue your practice has already earned but not yet collected and
aging AR can quickly become a financial drain if not actively managed. We monitor unpaid claims,
track reimbursement status, and perform timely follow-up activities to help therapy providers
maintain better visibility into outstanding balances and claim activity.

Accurate payment posting is essential for maintaining clean financial records, identifying
underpayments, and tracking the true performance of your billing operation. Our billing

## **Our Medicare Claims Processing Services**

Medicare billing follows strict CMS rules, payer-specific edits, and detailed documentation
standards that differ from commercial insurance. In-house teams often struggle with delayed
submissions, incomplete records, and unresolved denials that affect cash flow. MedFeeTree’s
outsourced Medicare claims processing services manage each stage with accuracy, consistency, and
accountability

**Medicare Claim Preparation and Coding Review**

Before submission, our team reviews ICD-10 diagnosis codes, CPT procedure codes, modifiers, Advance
Beneficiary Notice (ABN) requirements, and place-of-service details. We also validate medical
necessity documentation against Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) and National Coverage
Determinations (NCDs), ensuring every claim aligns with Medicare guidelines. This reduces front-end
rejections, improves claim accuracy, and supports smoother acceptance at the Medicare Administrative
Contractor (MAC) level.

**Electronic Claims Submission and Clearinghouse Management**

Claims are submitted electronically through approved clearinghouses using Medicare 837P and 837I
transaction standards. We monitor acknowledgments, track claim status via MAC portals, and resolve
clearinghouse rejections promptly. Each claim is also tracked for timely filing compliance,
preventing delays and ensuring submissions move efficiently through the adjudication process without
backlog accumulation.

**Medicare Denial Management and Appeals**

Medicare denials include reason and remark codes that require structured handling. Our team performs
root cause analysis, corrects documentation or coding issues, and resubmits claims with supporting
records. For complex cases, we prepare redetermination requests and Qualified Independent
Contractors (QIC) reconsiderations, following Medicare’s multi-level appeal process to maximize
recovery of eligible reimbursements.

**Secondary and Crossover Claim Processing**

For Medicare-primary patients with secondary insurance or Medigap coverage, we manage coordination
of benefits accurately. This includes crossover claim submission, verification of supplemental payer
details, and resolution of payment discrepancies. Our process ensures the full patient liability is
addressed and prevents revenue leakage due to incomplete secondary reimbursements.

**Medicare Claims Billing and Follow-Up Services**

We conduct regular AR reviews, track pending claims, and follow up with MAC representatives when
processing delays occur. Each aged claim is actively pursued until payment, adjustment, or formal
closure. This structured follow-up prevents revenue loss, reduces aging balances, and improves
overall reimbursement consistency across the billing cycle.

## **Our Commercial Insurance Claim Processing** **Services**

Handling commercial insurance claims requires payer-specific knowledge, clean claim submission, and
consistent follow-up across multiple plan types and adjudication timelines. MedFeeTree provides
comprehensive Commercial Insurance Claims Processing Services designed to help healthcare
organizations manage claims efficiently while improving processing accuracy and revenue performance.
* **Eligibility Verification & Pre-Authorization Management** We verify patient insurance
eligibility, active coverage, benefits, co-pay structures, and prior authorization requirements
before submission to eliminate preventable rejections and reduce front-end claim errors across all
commercial payer plans.
* **Clean Claim Submission & Coding Review** Our team reviews CPT, ICD-10, and modifier usage
against payer-specific guidelines before submission. Every claim is validated for completeness,
accuracy, and format compliance to maximize first-pass acceptance rates and minimize rework across
commercial billing cycles.
* **Payer Follow-Up & Claim Status Tracking** We actively monitor submitted claims through payer
portals, clearinghouse data, and direct communication channels. Every outstanding claim is tracked
through adjudication, ensuring no commercial claim is left without resolution or timely escalation
when processing delays occur.
* **Denial Management & Claim Resubmission** Denied claims are reviewed against payer-specific
denial codes, medical necessity criteria, and documentation requirements. We correct coding
errors, resolve authorization gaps, update supporting records as needed, and resubmit claims
systematically to recover revenue and reduce recurring denial patterns.
* **Underpayment Detection & Fee Schedule Reconciliation** We compare all reimbursed amounts against
contracted fee schedules and commercial payer allowable rates to identify underpayments and
billing shortfalls. Each discrepancy is documented and escalated through formal appeals or
correction requests, ensuring full contracted reimbursement is captured across all commercial
accounts.
* **Compliance Monitoring & Reporting Support** All claims workflows follow HIPAA-aligned processing
standards and payer-specific compliance requirements. We provide regular reporting on claim
status, denial trends, payer performance, and reimbursement activity to support financial
visibility and informed revenue cycle decision-making.

# What services does Medigo offer?

## We are tech-driven TPA based in Berlin. We help insurers across the globe to manage policies and
## claims with our secure platform. Our award-winning customer support and case management team
## provides a consistently professional service.

## Select a service to learn more:
* [Our technological edge][6]
* [Claims management][7]
* [Cost containment][8]
* [Second medical opinions][9]
* [Medical concierge][10]

## Our technological edge

As a tech company, we pride ourselves in using Agile principles to build user-friendly technology.
Our partners can choose from a range of useful products and services:

* MediClaim: Our custom-built platform for managing policies, processing claims, tracking benefit
utilisation, measuring cost containment, and producing reports for our partners
* Seamless white-label integrations: Allow your members to submit claims or questions through your
app or website directly into our platform
* Custom web pages: We offer branded landing pages where a user can submit a claim or other requests
* Communications: Our tools link up with Zendesk, a helpdesk tool that we use for calls and emails
* We have dedicated Security and Compliance Managers who make sure that everything we do is GDPR
compliant and our data is encrypted and secure

## Claims management

We partner with insurance companies worldwide and manage thousands of policies within our secure
platform:
* Reimbursements, GOPs, and direct billing agreements with in-network hospitals
* Cost containment at every step: pre-existing conditions checks, invoice validation and creative
billing prevention, international currency accounts, and in-network preferential rates
* Experienced, award-winning multilingual case managers and medical billing team
* Technological edge with time and cost-saving automations and plug and play features to fit your
needs: landing pages, submission portals, white-label solutions, ie. our software, your branding
* SLA reports tailored to your needs

## Cost containment

We have a dedicated cost containment team, including doctors, nurses, and pharmacists, who ensure
that our partners are not overpaying for healthcare. Our cost containment procedures include:

* Procedure cost database for benchmarking
* Pre-existing condition checks
* Pre-admission treatment plan checks: is it necessary and is the cost fair?
* Large loss claim (LLC) treatment monitoring
* Invoice validation and creative billing prevention
* Preferential rates at in-network hospitals
* Cost-saving international currency accounts through Kantox, our licensed payment provider

## Second medical opinions

**What is a second medical opinion (SMO)?****
**A second medical opinion is when a leading doctor checks a patient’s medical history, test
results, diagnosis and treatment plan. They will either confirm the diagnosis, or suggest further
tests or a different diagnosis. They may recommend a different treatment, such as a less invasive
option or a cutting-edge treatment that is only available in certain countries.

**Why offer second medical opinions to health insurance policyholders ?**
A US study found that up to 62% of patients had a change in diagnosis, treatment, or prognosis after
their second medical opinion (Mayo Clinic, 2016). A second medical opinion can help to prevent
unnecessary interventions, and gives patients, and their insurers, peace of mind that they’re
following the best treatment plan.

**Why choose Medigo for second medical opinions? ****
**Our network connects Medigo and its partners with some of the world’s leading experts in critical
illnesses, including very rare conditions. Through our network, Medigo can provide second medical
opinions from top specialists in Switzerland, Germany, the US, and the UK among others.

## Medical concierge

**What is Medigo’s medical concierge service?****
**Medigo has helped thousands of people find healthcare abroad. We assist people in seeking
innovative treatments for rare conditions as well as finding affordable options for expats or
patients who want to get treatment fast. Here’s how we help:
* Providing insights on the healthcare market globally – for example which countries offer which
innovative cancer therapies
* Collecting treatment plans with cost quotes from different providers
* Appointment booking and assistance with travel logistics

**Why choose Medigo for medical concierge?
**We have a database of healthcare costs across the globe plus expert knowledge in the requirements
for admission to different hospitals, the visa requirements, and any other important considerations
you might not have thought of. We also have lots of positive reviews from our medical travel
business.**

As a Microsoft Solutions Partner and ISO-certified organization with a growing international presence, we bring proven technology expertise and trusted partnerships to complex, regulated environments.

Health Insurance Operations
Reduce claims workload and processing time without adding headcount

MYclaim helps health insurance providers process claims faster, more accurately, and at lower
operational cost. By automating manual checks and document handling, it enables claims teams to
scale operations while maintaining control, compliance, and service quality.

It supports the full claims lifecycle by reducing manual effort, improving processing speed, and
ensuring consistent, auditable decision-making across high volumes of complex claims. Built to fit
into existing insurer ecosystems, MYclaim helps claims teams work faster and more efficiently
without disrupting established processes.

#### **The operational reality**

Claims departments face increasing volumes, growing document complexity, and constant regulatory
pressure. Manual processing creates bottlenecks, higher error rates, and forces teams to spend time
on repetitive checks instead of value-adding work. These challenges directly affect operational
cost, staff workload, and customer satisfaction.

#### **What MYclaim changes**

MYclaim automates the most time-consuming parts of claims processing, from document intake to
rule-based validation and decision support. Claims are processed consistently, while complex or
exceptional cases are clearly flagged for human review.

#### **Measurable impact**
* **Up to 85% reduction in manual workload** for claims teams
* **10x faster claims processing**, even during peak volumes
* **Lower operational costs** without increasing headcount
* More **predictable processing timelines** and fewer backlogs

MYclaim can integrate with existing systems, allowing organizations to modernize claims operations
without operational disruption.

Patient Support Platform
Manage patient support programs in one platform

MYCare PSP is a patient support platform designed to help companies plan, run, and scale patient
support programs with consistency and control. It centralizes all PSP activities in one system,
making it easier to manage patient pathways, monitor adherence, and generate reliable program
insights.

From patient enrollment to adherence monitoring and reporting, MYCare PSP simplifies execution while
giving teams a clear view of what is happening across programs, partners, and markets.

#### **What MYCare PSP does**

MYCare PSP brings structure to patient support operations that are often fragmented across teams,
vendors, and tools. It allows organizations to configure patient pathways, track participation and
outcomes, and oversee program performance in real time.

Patient data, program rules, and reporting logic are managed in a single environment, reducing
manual work, improving visibility, and enabling more predictable program execution across regions.

The platform is designed to support real-world program demands while remaining flexible enough to
adapt to different therapeutic areas and market requirements.

#### **Who MYCare PSP is for **

MYCare PSP is used by organizations running or overseeing patient support programs, including:
* **Pharmaceutical and life sciences companies** running or overseeing patient support programs
* **Healthcare providers and care organizations** delivering patient education, coordination, and
follow-up
* **Specialized PSP service providers** managing day-to-day program operations on behalf of sponsors

### **Business value**
* **Improved program efficiency** through standardized workflows and centralized oversight
* **Higher patient adherence and retention,** enabled by consistent monitoring and follow-up
* **Faster insight into program performance** with structured data and reporting
* **Scalable operations** without increasing administrative overhead

### **Results**
* In-depth patient data improves **therapy retention** by 49%
* **Time-to-treatment initiation **reduced by 53%
* Increased **patient retention** by 32%

### **Compliance & trust**

MYCare PSP is built to operate in strongly regulated environments. The platform supports strict data
protection, traceability, and audit requirements, allowing organizations to meet local and
international regulatory standards.

HomeCare & Supported Living
One platform to run, scale, and control home healthcare operations

HomeCare is a unified digital platform for managing home care and supported living services. It
connects care planning, daily service delivery, workforce coordination, and reporting into one
coherent operational view.

By centralising real-time data and automating key workflows, it reduces administrative overhead
while giving leadership teams the visibility they need to manage performance, quality, and risk with
confidence

### **Who can benefit from using HomeCare?**
* **Homecare & Home Healthcare Providers** – Standardize operations, improve care quality, and scale
home care services efficiently
* **Supported Living & Non-Medical Care Providers** – Professionalize and manage supported living
services with visibility, consistency, and control
* **Healthcare Groups & Hospitals Extending Care Into the Home** – Extend clinical care beyond
facilities while improving continuity, outcomes, and efficiency
* **Government & Semi-Government Health Authorities** – Gain oversight, data, and quality assurance
across home-based care services.

The platform provides a comprehensive set of core functionalities that digitise and automate care
operations, including real-time care plans, automated progress reporting, incident and risk
tracking, shift and staff management, and KPI-driven dashboards.

Built on a secure, scalable platform, it delivers role-based access, full audit trails, and
automated workflows that improve compliance, operational efficiency, and the quality of care
delivery.

Vaccine data aggregator
Vaccine research and surveillance, built on real-world data

MYCare V is an enterprise-grade vaccine data aggregation and analytics platform that enables
research organizations and vaccine manufacturers to monitor, evaluate, and quantify vaccine
performance using standardized, real-world evidence.

It centralizes fragmented vaccination data into a secure, interoperable environment, supporting
faster research, regulatory confidence, and evidence-based decision-making across the vaccine
lifecycle.

#### **The challenge MYCare V solves**

Vaccine research and monitoring rely on large volumes of real-world data that are often fragmented,
inconsistent, and difficult to standardize across populations, regions, and studies. This slows
evidence generation, complicates regulatory engagement, and limits the ability to reliably evaluate
vaccine efficiency, safety, and population impact.

#### **What MYCare V does**

MYCare V provides a unified platform that collects, standardizes, and analyzes vaccination data
across populations and programs. It enables vaccine producers and research teams to convert
real-world vaccination data into structured, analyzable evidence that supports research,
surveillance, and data-driven decision-making.

#### **Core functionality of MYCare V**

The platform monitors all active vaccination pathways by securely storing patient health data and
vaccination records, including enrollment, vaccine details, dosage, and pre- and post-vaccination
tests to assess immune response. Its modular architecture enables seamless expansion with advanced
data analytics, delivering customized insights aligned with research and regulatory requirements.

#### **Who can benefit from using MYCare V**
* **Research Organizations – **Uniform real-world evidence provision leading to quick and reliable
vaccine evaluation
* **Pharmaceutical Companies** – Improved chance of government vaccination approval due to
verifiable data on vaccine efficiency
* **Healthcare Professionals – **Vastly improved management and execution of vaccination programs
* **Government Agencies** – Vaccination monitoring of control groups, evaluation of vaccine outcomes

#### **Compliance & trust**

MYCare V is built to operate in strongly regulated environments. The platform supports strict data
protection, traceability, and audit requirements, allowing organizations to meet local and
international regulatory standards.

MY Automation Hub

MYS offers to its clients software that builds the connection between non-connected systems - ERP
system Microsoft Dynamics 365 LS Central and N number of Interactive systems designed specifically
for the hotel industry. The systems which the ERP solution can communicate with are: interactive TV
system, Telephone system, Remote control and card system.

The ERP system comprehensively stores and processes all information pertaining to hotel guests The
interactive systems, on the other hand, serve as the visual representation of specific,
individualized details on the television in the room, phone commands, call charges within the room,
and the accurate configuration and control of access cards. The software features defined commands
divided into different functional windows that will display the required information before it is
sent from the one system to the other.

To facilitate smooth data exchange between these systems, we have developed a universal protocol
known as FIAS (Flexible Interface Adaptation Specification). FIAS allows the systems to communicate
effectively by defining specific data records using a comprehensive list of available record types
and fields. This ensures that the desired functionality is fully supported within the interface. By
leveraging predefined definitions, the interface intelligently transfers data and logic between the
individual systems. The ERP solution will then be able to provide the vendor with the relevant
information for each action. Experience the power of our integrated software solution, enabling
efficient communication and streamlined processes across your hotel's diverse systems.

Standard functionalities:

Guest Data: Includes the process of transferring and verifying the following data between systems:
* Guest Check-in
* Guest Check-out
* Modification of Guest Data

These records are used for the transfer of data related to guests: all necessary information for
entering or updating guest data will be included in these records. The records may contain
information in the same fields, but the type of record determines the subsequent action to be taken.
Extended Guest Information: Involves the process of transferring and verifying the following data
between the two systems:

Text messages/requests/details/deletion of messages/bills/balance/remote guest departure – also used
for creating communication messages to the ERP system.

These types of records provide a mechanism for requesting and transmitting guest-specific
information with an extended nature. Room Data: Includes the process of transferring and verifying
the following data between the two systems: -Status of devices in the room Records for the status of
devices in the room are used to control each device in it (e.g., Television, Phone). These records
are configured in the ERP system and visualized on the screen of the device in the room. Card
Devices: Involves the process of transferring and verifying the following data between the two
systems: -Request/response/change of data/key reading Records with a key request are used to execute
various requests to the key system. Different types of keys (e.g., new key or key duplication) are
defined in different fields in the records.

In summary, our software solution offers hotels a comprehensive platform to optimize guest
experiences, streamline operations, and improve overall efficiency. By integrating Microsoft
Dynamics 365 LS Central with tailored interactive systems, we empower hotels to deliver personalized
services, leverage data insights, and enhance guest satisfaction.

Contact us today to learn more about how our solution can transform your hotel's operations.

Our Story
People, technology, and healthcare in Synergy

Every great company name has a story. Ours just happens to begin in a hospital, evolve through
sleepless nights of improving IT systems, and grow into a vision to make healthcare better through
technology. Trust and professionalism – these were the two pillars that defined Mladen and Yordan’s
friendship when they set out to create MY Synergy in 2019.

The two co-founders first met at the National Oncology Hospital, but it was not until they got
separated briefly that they realized their potential grew stronger when they worked together.

Reunited again at the National Social Security Institute (NSSI), the pair embarked on an ambitious
journey to modernize and expand the institution’s IT capabilities. A restructuring project of
unprecedented scale in their careers, the experience there shaped their common values, which later
became the foundation of MY Synergy.

“Mladen and I were working 16-hour shifts at the NSSI. We were 100% committed to upgrading their IT
capacity because we felt it was not up to modern standards. The NSSI is an institution of strategic
importance, and it has considerable resources, so we focused mainly on establishing protocols,
improving processes, and training core skills”, Yordan recounts.

The challenge was enough to prove that the two shared a common work ethic – set simple goals, but
approach them with selfless commitment and personal responsibility. On the day they founded the
company, Mladen and Yordan promised each other 2 things: that they will approach any challenge with
the same vigor that bonded them before, and that they will build a team of professionals with the
same worldview.

Culture & Values

The principles that guide how we work, collaborate, and create value
* RESPECT
* GROWTH
* PROFESSIONALISM
* MOTIVATION

## RESPECT
* We treat all people with dignity, listen and value their feedback
* We listen carefully and do not interrupt when someone is speaking
* We appropriately question actions inconsistent with our core values
* We demonstrate high regard for all individuals and appreciate their contributions

## GROWTH
* We are inquisitive and we lust for learning & developing
* We support the growth and development of all members of the team
* We dedicate special time to additional courses that improve our professional and personal lives,
as well
* We believe that friendly and clarifying questions can bring new knowledge

## PROFESSIONALISM
* We take pride in professional appearance, language, and behavior
* We personally commit to continuous improvement and professional growth
* We respect others, express sincere appreciation, and positively influence those around us
* We are diligent in delivering high quality work and providing exceptional service to both internal
and external clients

## MOTIVATION
* We communicate openly, our actions mirror our words, and we keep our promises
* We attract self-motivated, highly capable, results-oriented people and invest heavily in their
development
* We believe our employee motivation is most powerful when we follow our core values and behave
according to our company culture
* We inspire ourselves and others to step out of comfort zones, play a bigger game, and choose
empowering contexts which lead to new actions and new results

Our Story
People, technology, and healthcare in Synergy

Every great company name has a story. Ours just happens to begin in a hospital, evolve through
sleepless nights of improving IT systems, and grow into a vision to make healthcare better through
technology. Trust and professionalism – these were the two pillars that defined Mladen and Yordan’s
friendship when they set out to create MY Synergy in 2019.

The two co-founders first met at the National Oncology Hospital, but it was not until they got
separated briefly that they realized their potential grew stronger when they worked together.

Reunited again at the National Social Security Institute (NSSI), the pair embarked on an ambitious
journey to modernize and expand the institution’s IT capabilities. A restructuring project of
unprecedented scale in their careers, the experience there shaped their common values, which later
became the foundation of MY Synergy.

“Mladen and I were working 16-hour shifts at the NSSI. We were 100% committed to upgrading their IT
capacity because we felt it was not up to modern standards. The NSSI is an institution of strategic
importance, and it has considerable resources, so we focused mainly on establishing protocols,
improving processes, and training core skills”, Yordan recounts.

The challenge was enough to prove that the two shared a common work ethic – set simple goals, but
approach them with selfless commitment and personal responsibility. On the day they founded the
company, Mladen and Yordan promised each other 2 things: that they will approach any challenge with
the same vigor that bonded them before, and that they will build a team of professionals with the
same worldview.

Culture & Values

The principles that guide how we work, collaborate, and create value
* RESPECT
* GROWTH
* PROFESSIONALISM
* MOTIVATION

## RESPECT
* We treat all people with dignity, listen and value their feedback
* We listen carefully and do not interrupt when someone is speaking
* We appropriately question actions inconsistent with our core values
* We demonstrate high regard for all individuals and appreciate their contributions

## GROWTH
* We are inquisitive and we lust for learning & developing
* We support the growth and development of all members of the team
* We dedicate special time to additional courses that improve our professional and personal lives,
as well
* We believe that friendly and clarifying questions can bring new knowledge

## PROFESSIONALISM
* We take pride in professional appearance, language, and behavior
* We personally commit to continuous improvement and professional growth
* We respect others, express sincere appreciation, and positively influence those around us
* We are diligent in delivering high quality work and providing exceptional service to both internal
and external clients

## MOTIVATION
* We communicate openly, our actions mirror our words, and we keep our promises
* We attract self-motivated, highly capable, results-oriented people and invest heavily in their
development
* We believe our employee motivation is most powerful when we follow our core values and behave
according to our company culture
* We inspire ourselves and others to step out of comfort zones, play a bigger game, and choose
empowering contexts which lead to new actions and new results

NABH

NABH (National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers) is an organization in India that sets standards for quality healthcare services in various healthcare settings such as hospitals, clinics, and nursing homes. NABH accreditation is the recognition that a healthcare facility has met these quality standards and is committed to providing safe, effective, and patient-centered care.

A NABH consultant is a professional who provides guidance and assistance to healthcare facilities seeking NABH accreditation. Their role is to help healthcare facilities understand the NABH standards and requirements, assess their current practices and procedures, identify areas for improvement, and develop and implement a plan to meet the NABH standards.

Supervising and managing a team of claims processors and administrators to ensure timely and accurate processing of health insurance claims.
Reviewing and verifying the accuracy and completeness of claim submissions, including medical records, bills, and other supporting documents.
Adjudicating claims by established policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and contractual obligations.
Negotiating with healthcare providers to resolve disputed claims, including fees and reimbursement amounts.
Analyzing claim data and identifying trends or patterns that may indicate fraudulent or abusive billing practices.
Developing and implementing strategies to improve claims processing efficiency and accuracy, and reduce claims costs.
Collaborating with other departments, such as customer service, network management, and medical management, to ensure seamless and coordinated delivery of health benefits to members.
