# Definitive Healthcare wins silver in the 2023 Stevie Awards for Great Employers

### Share this post

**Framingham, MA – December 20, 2023 –** [Definitive Healthcare][57] (Nasdaq:[ DH][58]), an industry
leader in healthcare commercial intelligence, has been named the winner of a Silver Stevie Award® in
the category for Employer of the Year – Health Products and Services. Definitive Healthcare has now
won this award two years in a row.

Now in its 8th year, the Stevie Awards for Great Employers recognize the world’s best employers and
the human resources professionals who help to create and drive great places to work. More than 1,000
nominations from organizations of all sizes in 28 countries were submitted this year for
consideration in a wide range of HR-related categories. Winners in the Employer of the Year
categories were determined by a unique blending of the ratings of professional judges and more than
107,000 public votes.

“We pride ourselves on building a culture rooted in collaboration, inclusivity, and passion for
improving the healthcare industry,” said Robert Musslewhite, Chief Executive Officer of Definitive
Healthcare. “This award is a testament to that passion, and we are incredibly thankful for the
recognition of our team’s continued efforts over the last year.”

Definitive Healthcare is committed to putting its employees first by creating a collaborative work
culture centered around employee engagement. With more than 1,000 employees across three continents,
the company strives to build a culture that allows every employee to feel valued and flourish in
their respective role.

This award reaffirms Definitive Healthcare’s commitment to excellence in company culture, as the
company has been recognized as a top workplace numerous times by the [Boston Globe][59], the [Boston
Business Journal][60], and [Energage][61]. Definitive Healthcare was also recently recognized with a
Gold Stevie Award® at the [2023 American Business Awards®][62].

Details about the Stevie Awards for Great Employers and the list of 2023 Stevie winners are
available at [http://www.StevieAwards.com/HR][63].

**About Definitive Healthcare**

At Definitive Healthcare, our passion is to transform data, analytics, and expertise into healthcare
commercial intelligence. We help clients uncover the right markets, opportunities, and people, so
they can shape tomorrow’s healthcare industry. Our SaaS platform creates new paths to commercial
success in the healthcare market, so companies can identify where to go next. Learn more at
[definitivehc.com][64].

**About the Stevie® Awards**

Stevie Awards are conferred in eight programs: the Asia-Pacific Stevie Awards, the German Stevie
Awards, the Middle East & North Africa Stevie Awards, The American Business Awards®, The
International Business Awards®, the Stevie Awards for Women in Business, the Stevie Awards for Great
Employers, and the Stevie Awards for Sales & Customer Service. Stevie Awards competitions receive
more than 12,000 entries each year from organizations in more than 70 nations. Honoring
organizations of all types and sizes and the people behind them, the Stevie’s recognize outstanding
performances in the workplace worldwide. Learn more about the Stevie Awards at
[http://www.StevieAwards.com][65].

# Definitive Healthcare Announces Launch of Commercial Medical Claims

### Share this post

*Leading healthcare data provider will offer integrated commercial medical claims intelligence on
210 million patients*

Framingham, MA – August 28, 2018 – [Definitive Healthcare][57], the leading supplier of data,
intelligence, and analytics on the healthcare provider market, announced the upcoming launch of
all-payer medical claims into its industry-leading database. This powerful data asset will be fully
integrated into Definitive’s existing platform of proprietary intelligence and will reaffirm the
company’s position as the premier provider of affiliations, financial performance, and quality data
on the U.S. Healthcare market.

With this cutting-edge launch, Definitive Healthcare’s clients will now be able to leverage near
real-time analytics on approximately 210 million de-identified patients through an easy-to-use
interface, making this data more accessible than ever. The new commercial medical claims offering
will increase users’ ability to glean actionable and relevant insights from a vast and comprehensive
set of clinical information.

“The impact this investment is going to have on our clients and on the industry as a whole cannot be
overstated,” said Jason Krantz, CEO of Definitive Healthcare. “By combining billions of commercial
medical claims with our existing proprietary data, we can empower our clients to analyze market
trends, develop segmentation strategies, evaluate brand loyalty and behavioral patterns and much
more. We look forward to helping our clients leverage this brand-new solution to revolutionize their
market strategies.”

The addition of commercial claims to Definitive’s existing product suite will deliver to clients a
comprehensive view of the entire healthcare market. Definitive Healthcare is constantly identifying
new ways to enhance its product suite to strengthen its standing as the most reliable, accurate, and
up-to-date source for healthcare intelligence and analytics. The company’s decision to invest in
commercial claims results from continual research, including client feedback, to understand what
healthcare market insights best benefit its growing client base.

This revolutionary update to the company’s database is slated for release in the summer of 2018.
Subscribe to the company’s [email updates][58] to stay up-to-date on the launch. To learn more about
Definitive Healthcare’s innovative product suite, request a [free trial][59] today!

**About Definitive Healthcare**

Definitive Healthcare is the leading provider of data and intelligence on hospitals, physicians and
other healthcare providers. Its product suite provides the most comprehensive and highest quality
data available anywhere on 8,800 hospitals and IDNs, 10,000 ambulatory surgery centers, 14,000
imaging centers, 50,000 long-term care facilities, 1,400 ACOs and HIEs, 188,000 physician groups,
1.6 million physicians, nurses, and allied health professionals, and 900 Canadian hospitals. The
company’s data provides clients with the analytics and insight needed to effectively segment and
research the healthcare provider market. Definitive Healthcare is backed by Spectrum Equity. For
more information or to trial the service, visit [www.definitivehc.com][60].

# Definitive Healthcare announces CEO transition

### Share this post

*Jason Krantz, Founder and Executive Chairman, to Serve as Interim CEO*

*Company Reaffirms Fourth Quarter 2023 Guidance and Issues Preliminary Guidance for 2024*

**FRAMINGHAM, Mass., Jan. 16, 2024** (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Definitive Healthcare (Nasdaq: DH) (the
“Company”), an industry leader in healthcare commercial intelligence, today announced that Robert
Musslewhite has stepped down as Chief Executive Officer and as a member of the Board of Directors to
transition to a new phase of leadership for the Company. Jason Krantz, Founder and Executive
Chairman of Definitive Healthcare, has been appointed interim Chief Executive Officer. The Board has
engaged a leading global executive search firm to commence a process to identify a permanent CEO.

“Over the last several months, Definitive Healthcare has taken decisive, strategic steps designed to
better position our organization to capture opportunities, deliver world-class products to our
customers and create value for our shareholders over the long term,” said Mr. Krantz. “We believe
these changes – combined with our proprietary data, powerful tools and deep subject matter expertise
– provide us with a solid foundation to drive further growth. While we look for the next leader to
propel Definitive Healthcare’s next chapter, I am excited to work even more closely with our
talented team to ensure we continue to drive excellence and performance in this
transitional period.”

Mr. Krantz founded Definitive Healthcare in 2011. He served as CEO of the Company for more than a
decade, scaling the business into a leading data-as-a-service provider to the U.S. healthcare
industry. Under his leadership, Definitive Healthcare expanded to over 2,500 customers, reached over
$200 million in annual revenue and executed an IPO in September 2021. In August 2022, Mr. Krantz
transitioned to the role of Executive Chairman and since then has continued to play an active role
in the Company.

Mr. Krantz continued, “We sincerely thank Robert for his contributions to Definitive Healthcare and
for laying the foundation for the next phase of growth for the business. The Board remains focused
on Definitive Healthcare reaching its full potential and will work to ensure this transition is
smooth while we undertake the search process.”

Mr. Musslewhite commented, “It has been a been a privilege to lead a company as exceptional as
Definitive Healthcare. I look forward to closely following the future success of Definitive
Healthcare and wish Jason, the Board and the entire team all the best.”

Prior to founding Definitive Healthcare, Mr. Krantz founded and served as CEO of Infinata, a SaaS
based provider of intelligence to the pharmaceutical industry under the brand BioPharm Insight. In
addition, he has co-founded and helped build several intelligence and analytics companies, including
Energy Acuity, a privately held provider of intelligence on the alternative energy market, and
Xtelligent Media, a privately held integrated marketing company focused on the healthcare industry.
Mr. Krantz holds a B.S. in Finance and Computer Science from Boston College and an M.B.A. from
Harvard Business School.

**Financial Update**
In addition to announcing the leadership transition, the Company is reaffirming its financial
guidance for Q4 2023, as provided on November 3, 2023, and is issuing preliminary guidance for 2024:
* Full year 2024 Revenue is expected to grow 5-7% compared to full year 2023 guidance; and
* Full year 2024 Adjusted EBITDA margin is expected to increase approximately 200 basis points
compared to full year 2023 guidance.

The Company will release its fourth quarter and full year 2023 financial results on Wednesday,
February 28, 2024 after market close.

*A reconciliation Adjusted EBITDA to net loss is not available on a forward-looking basis without
unreasonable effort due to the uncertainty regarding, and the potential variability of, expenses
that may be incurred in the future. For example, stock-based compensation expense-related charges
are impacted by the timing of employee stock transactions, the future fair market value of our
common stock, and our future hiring and retention needs, all of which are difficult to predict and
subject to constant change. Accordingly, a reconciliation is not available without unreasonable
effort and the Company is unable to assess the probable significance of the unavailable information,
although it is important to note that these factors could be material to its results computed in
accordance with GAAP.*

**About Definitive Healthcare**
At Definitive Healthcare, our passion is to transform data, analytics, and expertise into healthcare
commercial intelligence. We help clients uncover the right markets, opportunities, and people, so
they can shape tomorrow’s healthcare industry. Our SaaS platform creates new paths to commercial
success in the healthcare market, so companies can identify where to go next. Learn more at
[**definitivehc.com**][57].

# Definitive Healthcare Named 5th Best Place to Work in Massachusetts

### Share this post

*Career development opportunities, community service, and supportive work environment drive
employee satisfaction*

Framingham, MA – June 26, 2018 – [Definitive Healthcare][57], the leading provider of data,
intelligence, and analytics on the healthcare provider market, has been ranked the 5th Best Place to
Work by the Boston Business Journal. The publication recognized Definitive Healthcare and other
winners during an awards ceremony on June 20. This is the second year in a row the company, which
recently hired it’s 250^{th} employee, was recognized as one of the top five places to work in the
state. Definitive was also named the 3^{rd} best place to work in last year’s Boston Globe ranking.

Each year the Boston Business Journal honors Massachusetts companies that offer supportive and
progressive work environments for employees. Winners are selected based on an employee survey that
asked recipients to rate their company on job satisfaction, work-life balance, company management,
and other criteria. Some of the comments made by Definitive’s employees include:
* “The company is very focused on giving back to the community and it actively encourages its
employees to find worthy causes and get out and help!”
* “Everyone is approachable, especially the CEO.”
* “The team members are beyond helpful, hardworking, collaborative and make you feel welcomed.”
* “Employees have the ability to take control of their own path and get the skills and experiences
they want.”

“It’s an incredible feeling to be recognized as a Best Place to Work for the second year in a row,”
said Jason Krantz, CEO of Definitive Healthcare. “That we have ranked so highly in a city full of
innovative businesses is truly a tribute to our employees. Our ability to hire the most talented,
most creative people in Boston ensures not only that Definitive remains a great place to work, but
also ensures that we continue to develop the highest quality, most innovative products for
our clients.”

The Boston Business Journal also recently listed Definitive Healthcare as the 11^{th}
[fastest-growing company in Massachusetts][58], citing its strong revenue growth over the past
three years.

“Receiving these two awards in such a short time, and also for the second year in a row, is a
testament to the dedication and affability of our employees,” Krantz added. “To achieve continuous
positive growth without sacrificing our culture is outstanding.”

Definitive Healthcare is growing rapidly and is seeking talented additions to its award-winning
team. For information on current openings at Definitive Healthcare, visit our [career page][59].

**About Definitive Healthcare**

Definitive Healthcare is the leading provider of data and intelligence on hospitals, physicians and
other healthcare providers. Their product suite provides the most comprehensive and highest quality
data available anywhere on 8,800 hospitals and IDNs, 10,000 ambulatory surgery centers, 14,000
imaging centers, 50,000 long-term care facilities, 1,400 ACOs and HIEs, 188,000 physician groups,
1.6 million physicians & allied care professionals, and 900 Canadian hospitals. The company’s data
provides clients with the analytics and insight needed to effectively segment and research the
healthcare provider market. Definitive Healthcare is backed by Spectrum Equity. For more
information or to trial the service, visit [www.definitivehc.com][60].

# Definitive Healthcare Ranked 11th Fastest-Growing Company in Massachusetts by Boston Business
# Journal

### Share this post

*Recognition and award based on extreme 3-year growth rate*

Framingham, MA (June 5, 2018) – [Definitive Healthcare][57], the leading provider of data,
intelligence, and analytics on the healthcare provider market, was named the 11^{th} fastest-growing
company in Massachusetts by the *Boston Business Journal*. This is the second year in a row
Definitive has been recognized as a Fast 50 company*.*

During the annual Fast 50 awards ceremony, the *Boston Business Journal* honored Massachusetts-based
companies with the highest revenue growth over the previous three years. Definitive’s revenue grew
more than 510% between 2014 and 2017, earning it the number 11 spot.

“We are honored to be recognized as one of the fastest-growing businesses in Massachusetts,” said
Jason Krantz, founder and CEO of Definitive Healthcare. “Being named to this list two years in a row
is truly a testament to the hard work of our team, and our continued commitment to the success of
our clients in understanding the healthcare market. I am so proud of all our employees putting in
the work that made this possible.”

Definitive’s continued success is the result of both new business and an uncommonly high renewal
rate. The company added nearly 500 new clients in 2017 and now services over 1,600 clients.
Prominent clients include most of the top pharmaceutical, medical device, healthcare technology and
healthcare consulting firms as well as many of the largest healthcare systems in the country.

The *Boston Business Journal* also just recognized Definitive Healthcare as a Best Place to Work for
the second year in a row. Definitive’s ranking in this list, determined by an online survey of
employees, is expected to be announced later this month.

For more information or for a free trial of Definitive’s award-winning database, visit
[www.definitivehc.com][58].

**About Definitive Healthcare**

Definitive Healthcare is the leading provider of data and intelligence on hospitals, physicians, and
other healthcare providers. Its product suite provides the most comprehensive and highest quality
data available anywhere on 8,800 hospitals and IDNs; 220,000 physician groups; 1.6 million
physicians; 10,000 ambulatory surgery centers; 14,000 imaging centers; 86,000 long-term care
facilities; 40,000 clinics; 2,600 ACOs and HIEs; and 900 Canadian hospitals. The company’s data
provides clients with the analytics and insight needed to effectively segment and research the
healthcare provider market. Definitive Healthcare is backed by Spectrum Equity.

# Healthcare is complex. We make it make sense.

Founded in 2011, Definitive Healthcare is a global organization with offices in the U.S., Sweden,
and India. We work with every industry that touches healthcare, from life sciences and providers to
software & IT, consulting, financial services, medical supply, construction, staffing, and more. Our
data delivers trusted intelligence on healthcare organizations, clinicians, claims, consumers, and
experts—giving you the context you need to make smarter decisions and drive real impact in
healthcare.

[ Explore our data ][58]
[We know healthcare inside and out]

## Our mission

Our mission is simple: To connect with the real people who make healthcare happen. With real data on
real people, our customers get the definitive picture of the healthcare market to move their
businesses and organizations forward.

## Our vision

We are committed to delivering the industry's most reliable, actionable, and differentiated
insights. Our vision is to lead in healthcare market data and analytics, empowering our customers to
succeed and improve patient lives. As we grow, our focus remains clear: to support the innovators,
teams, and organizations transforming healthcare. Because when our customers succeed, healthcare
improves—for everyone.

## Our culture

We work with purpose—innovating, collaborating, and delivering insights that our customers can't
find anywhere else. We also give back through our DefinitiveCares program, volunteering in the
communities where we live and work. DH is a place where smart teams, big ideas, and meaningful
impact come together.

## More about our data

[Our core data types][66]

Definitive Healthcare delivers detailed data on health systems, hospitals, physicians, physician
groups, surgery centers, imaging centers, long-term care facilities, and clinics. We consolidate
affiliations, referrals, quality metrics, financials, clinical metrics, and more. Additionally, we
offer consumer data, all-payor medical and prescription claims data, as well as insights into
medical and scientific experts, including key opinion leaders.

[Additional ways we can help][67]

Definitive Healthcare offers strategic services through our team of data scientists, advanced
analytics experts, and consultants. We help organizations integrate our insights into their
day-to-day workflows and operations. We also provide activation services for digital advertising
campaigns, empowering clients to engage effectively with the healthcare market.

[Our consumer data][68]

Definitive Healthcare offers HIPAA-compliant consumer data, including insights related to healthcare
consumer behavior. Organizations can leverage this data to power their digital advertising efforts
and make more informed growth decisions within the healthcare market.

# Healthcare is complex. We make it make sense.

Founded in 2011, Definitive Healthcare is a global organization with offices in the U.S., Sweden,
and India. We work with every industry that touches healthcare, from life sciences and providers to
software & IT, consulting, financial services, medical supply, construction, staffing, and more. Our
data delivers trusted intelligence on healthcare organizations, clinicians, claims, consumers, and
experts—giving you the context you need to make smarter decisions and drive real impact in
healthcare.

[ Explore our data ][58]
[We know healthcare inside and out]

## Our mission

Our mission is simple: To connect with the real people who make healthcare happen. With real data on
real people, our customers get the definitive picture of the healthcare market to move their
businesses and organizations forward.

## Trusted by industry leaders

## Our vision

We are committed to delivering the industry's most reliable, actionable, and differentiated
insights. Our vision is to lead in healthcare market data and analytics, empowering our customers to
succeed and improve patient lives. As we grow, our focus remains clear: to support the innovators,
teams, and organizations transforming healthcare. Because when our customers succeed, healthcare
improves—for everyone.

## Our culture

We work with purpose—innovating, collaborating, and delivering insights that our customers can't
find anywhere else. We also give back through our DefinitiveCares program, volunteering in the
communities where we live and work. DH is a place where smart teams, big ideas, and meaningful
impact come together.

## More about our data

[Our core data types][66]

Definitive Healthcare delivers detailed data on health systems, hospitals, physicians, physician
groups, surgery centers, imaging centers, long-term care facilities, and clinics. We consolidate
affiliations, referrals, quality metrics, financials, clinical metrics, and more. Additionally, we
offer consumer data, all-payor medical and prescription claims data, as well as insights into
medical and scientific experts, including key opinion leaders.

[Additional ways we can help][67]

Definitive Healthcare offers strategic services through our team of data scientists, advanced
analytics experts, and consultants. We help organizations integrate our insights into their
day-to-day workflows and operations. We also provide activation services for digital advertising
campaigns, empowering clients to engage effectively with the healthcare market.

[Our consumer data][68]

Definitive Healthcare offers HIPAA-compliant consumer data, including insights related to healthcare
consumer behavior. Organizations can leverage this data to power their digital advertising efforts
and make more informed growth decisions within the healthcare market.

We focus on developing
solutions for:

STARTUPS AND SCALE-UPS

We deliver products and solutions to help startups focus on the essential things: finding the proper product-market fit and scaling their business. We craft software products that have the power to attract customers, be successfully presented to investors, and are ready for scaling.

MIDSIZE BUSINESSES

We get deeply involved in our clients’ business processes and only use advanced technologies to build unique solutions that help healthcare, AgeTech, real estate, logistics, and other companies operate more efficiently.

Industries that benefit
from our IT solutions

Our IT products span multiple industries. Here are the four sectors of our expertise.

Healthcare

Our experience includes custom software development for healthtech startups and healthcare facilities. We built products for seniors, a staffing platform for healthcare workers, mHealth apps, and patient engagement platforms. Demigos’ portfolio covers easily scalable, secure solutions that are compliant with HIPAA and GDPR.

Learn More

Age Tech

The Demigos team knows the problems and challenges faced by senior living communities, in-home care businesses, and individual caregivers. Our scalable and flexible custom software solutions help streamline operations, payments, and scheduling, ensuring exceptional customer service.
We design and build neat, easy-to-use web and mobile apps catering to the needs of senior living facilities, senior people, and giving their family members peace of mind.

Learn More

Real estate

We built several platforms, including a real estate investment analyzer and a unique auction system for purchasing real estate. Working with MLS, integration with DocuSign, instant recalculation of large data sets for amortization—we’ve got them and much more under our belt.

Logistics

Our software engineers built a series of mobile-driven Uber-like platforms providing logistics operators with access to the driver labor pool. Additionally, we designed and coded custom ERP solutions for a coaching bus company in Canada.

OUR PROJECTS

Corporate Wellness Platform

A mobile app for employees and a web dashboard for employers

The mobile app we built for the client lets employees track their health vitals, either by entering them manually or through integrated wearables. Meanwhile, employers can see aggregated, anonymized data on team well-being on the dashboard, which helps them improve wellness programs.

READ MORE

MSHFA Telemedicine Platform

A telemedicine and EMR solution for a Kuwaiti clinic

MSHFA is a telemedicine and EMR solution integrated with a pharmacy ecommerce store. It enables video conferencing between doctors and patients, stores history of patients’ symptoms, lab tests, diagnoses, referrals, etc, and allows to order medicine through the app.

READ MORE

plumBid Real Estate Auction Platform

An algorithm-based auction platform

plumBid platform provides an easy and transparent process to buy and sell real estate which results in the best price and terms. The revolutionary and patent-pending technology removes the guesswork and puts seller, buyer and agent in control of the entire process, maximizing the outcome for everyone.

READ MORE

Third-Party Administrator Platform

A robust web platform for a licensed US-based TPA company

The platform automates processes for a third-party benefits administration service. It provides client companies "Best-in-Breed" core, ancillary, supplemental, and voluntary benefit & insurance products, plans, programs, & services at the lowest possible costs from insurance carriers throughout the country.

READ MORE

GapNurse

Healthcare matchmaking platform for nurses

GapNurse is a healthcare matchmaking platform that seamlessly connects healthcare workers with organizations that value their skills and knowledge. We built a mobile application for nurses, a web platform for facility managers, and an administrators' platform.

READ MORE

Wendy's Team

Tech platform for a home care agency in the US

Wendy's Team service helps to pair householders and caregivers for elderly people. We have commenced working together on the early stages of online development for the company, including service to automate major manual processes that streamline efficiency of applications.

READ MORE

Aliro

Platform tailored to agro-commodity traders

Aliro is an international marketplace and trading platform for verified buyers and sellers of agricultural products. It connects producers, brokers, distributors, wholesalers, brand name manufacturers, and government trading houses from all over the world on a wide range of product categories including grains, oils, spices, cereals, sugars, seeds, flour, fruits & vegetables, and many others.

READ MORE

YVRSkylynx

Website and analytics

We created a website to sell bus tickets online, measured UX and made improvements to design, analysed effectiveness of different advertising channels.

READ MORE

Successfilly

Enriching online courses

Successfilly brings online education to a new level by allowing teachers to use embedded pages in online course services like Udemy or Teachable to greatly enrich course content and add interaction.

READ MORE

Portl

A go-to platform for finding freelancers

Freelancers and employers alike usually hit a roadblock - how to find each other. Existing marketplaces are more like job search website and don't offer much room for freelancers to market their skills. And if you don't have connections to refer you to good specialists, you'll end up spending more money than expected.
READ MORE

UCL System

ERP system for bus company in Canada

ERP system for bus company in Canada. Universal Coach Line provides quality bus charters to all travel destinations in North America. The company previously utilized outdated enterprise resource planning software, which was local for all 3 divisions across Canada.

READ MORE

Ofinta

Order and delivery system for e-commerce

Ofinta is an e-commerce platform for the East African region that provides payment integration with MPesa, a Vodafone's wallet-based service accessed through a mobile account.

READ MORE

Mobilism

Mobile marketplace for popular forum in the US

Mobilism is a large US website for sharing books, games and apps with 94,000 + unique users per day. We have designed and build an Android app and API for an app & website integration, which provides the ability for users to access the forum with Android app in a convenient way.

READ MORE

Why Demigos?

We create custom solutions for startups
that clients love. Here’s how:

Laser focus on value

We know how important it is to build IT solutions that bring measurable value to your startup or company. We begin by asking the right questions, analyzing, and figuring out what solutions will have the most significant impact on your business.

Flexibility

Flexibility is our top priority when developing software solutions. Requirements can change mid-flight, and we’re ready to optimize and accommodate even last-minute changes. This is a major advantage of custom software development for your startup or company over off-the-shelf solutions.

Scalability

Some solutions are expected to be successful, while the success of others leaves their creators surprised. But in both scenarios, scalability is critical. The architecture of our software solutions is designed to scale to one million daily active users and even more.

[Let's talk][22]

### HOW WE WORK

Working processes determine product quality.
See below how it is applied to us.

### Research

Research phase determines the product development and promotion strategies.

We want every product we create to be successful - that is why we work closely with founders.

We do customer development, talk to potential users about the product, determine their real
"weaknesses".

We research existing products in the market and key competitors, we conduct traffic analysis.

Based on the research, we provide recommendations for further product look & feel and Internet
promotion using social media, SEO and inbound marketing.

### Design & Development

We start with design analysis and come up with the first vision of the product.

Making prototypes, we see what solutions will work better, discuss them with product owners and
potential users.

System architecture is also developed at this stage, simultaneously.

Technologies stack is chosen corresponding to projects needs.

We plan work schedule in a way to provide the fastest delivery.

Our quality assurance team starts working right after the project beginning and with the help of
automated and performance testing, helps to provide further product scalability and smooth features
extension.

### Product support

Product launch is only the start of the journey.

We stay on the line and help founders to move products forward - we come up with new features based
on user feedback, improve marketing strategy, help with Internet promotion.

that clients love. Here’s how:

Laser focus on value

We know how important it is to build IT solutions that bring measurable value to your startup or company. We begin by asking the right questions, analyzing, and figuring out what solutions will have the most significant impact on your business.

Flexibility

Flexibility is our top priority when developing software solutions. Requirements can change mid-flight, and we’re ready to optimize and accommodate even last-minute changes. This is a major advantage of custom software development for your startup or company over off-the-shelf solutions.

Scalability

Some solutions are expected to be successful, while the success of others leaves their creators surprised. But in both scenarios, scalability is critical. The architecture of our software solutions is designed to scale to one million daily active users and even more.

Design

When users love a product, they’re eager to recommend it. In that case, the design is just as important for us as product functionality. We know how to build IT solutions for startups that are robust, beautiful, easy-to-use, and, most importantly, loved by users.

Security

Data security is essential, especially in healthcare or financial services. As a software provider, Demigos takes the security of our solutions for startups and companies very seriously. We follow best practices for pinpointing vulnerabilities, architectural risk analysis, penetration testing, and examining how a system behaves under attack. Security requirements and operations are at the top of our list.

Quality

When it comes to startup product development, we raise the bar on quality. Our testing process covers automation, performance, and unit testing—all it takes to make sure we deliver exceptional products.

4 Steps to Building Successful
IT Solutions for Your Business

Analyzing business needs and goals

Tasked with developing custom software development for startups and established companies, we start by identifying the client’s business objectives. We’ll work together with you to understand your pain points and how our IT solutions can help.

Developing a product vision and roadmap

We create a compelling product vision and a clear roadmap after detailed business analysis and product prototyping.

Building the product

At Demigos, we strongly believe custom software development is most successful when it’s agile. That is why we work according to the Scrum methodology and deliver results once every two weeks.

Getting feedback and optimizing

We always listen to the feedback our clients and their customers provide to fine-tune the product and help it match your business goals.

The Problem With Analysts

They're slow. They're expensive.
And they're keeping your data hostage.

They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself — just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a lot of confident language.

The data doesn't get better in the meantime. A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."

By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later. You've already missed the window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."

And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the contract ends. The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

"A black box isn't analysis. It's dependency."

The data analysts use
to make their calls?
It's right here.

DrugPatentWatch pulls directly from primary sources — the USPTO, FDA Orange Book, ANDA filings, litigation records, patent registers across 134 countries. Every source an analyst would use. Updated daily. No middleman.

You form your own view. You run your own queries. You export everything and it's yours — permanently. When the contract ends, the data doesn't disappear.

See the raw data →

Export everything, keep it forever

Download full datasets in clean, structured formats. Your exports belong to you — not to a subscription you might cancel.

Updated while you sleep

Every drug profile is refreshed from primary sources daily. No editorial lag. No publication cycle. Just the current state of the data.

Ask your own questions

Don't inherit someone else's analytical frame. Query the raw data however your strategy demands — and change your query tomorrow if you need to.

A fraction of the cost

Boutique pharma intelligence firms charge $20,000–$100,000+ per engagement. DrugPatentWatch offers affordable monthly subscriptions to scale with your needs.

#### [What is Health Insurance?][50]

Health Insurance is protection against medical costs. A health insurance policy is a contract
between an insurer and an individual/group in which the insurer agrees to provide specified health
insurance cover at a particular premium. The health insurer usually provides either direct payment
or reimburses the expenses associated with illnesses and injuries

#### [What is Cashless Facility?][51]

Ericson Insurance TPA Pvt. Ltd as a TPA has entered into agreements with a set of hospitals (called
Network Service Providers) where the member can avail hospitalization services on the basis of an
authorization provided by Ericson TPA. The member does not pay for his treatment up to the limit
authorized provided it is covered by the policy and only pays the non covered expenses and any
excess over the authorized limit. This saves the need for the member to arrange for cash to pay to
the hospital.

FlowForma empowers enterprises with AI-driven process automation and workflow tools that streamline

## About FlowForma

FlowForma empowers enterprise organizations to **scale automation securely and globally**, helping
business teams work smarter, faster, and more efficiently. Our AI-powered platform reduces
administrative overhead, streamlines complex processes, and drives productivity across departments.

With **AI and intelligent agents at its core**, FlowForma supports smarter decision-making,
automates repetitive tasks, and enables teams to focus on what really matters. We’re dedicated to
helping enterprises **digitize, transform, and optimize** processes at scale, delivering measurable
efficiency, compliance, and business impact.

Trusted by 300,000+ users globally, FlowForma was founded in 2012, the company is an award-winning
Microsoft Gold Partner recognized by analysts and Fortune 500 companies for delivering world-class
automation platforms and tools.

operations, helping teams reduce administrative overhead, make smarter decisions, and scale work
securely.

## About FlowForma

FlowForma empowers enterprise organizations to **scale automation securely and globally**, helping
business teams work smarter, faster, and more efficiently. Our AI-powered platform reduces
administrative overhead, streamlines complex processes, and drives productivity across departments.

With **AI and intelligent agents at its core**, FlowForma supports smarter decision-making,
automates repetitive tasks, and enables teams to focus on what really matters. We’re dedicated to
helping enterprises **digitize, transform, and optimize** processes at scale, delivering measurable
efficiency, compliance, and business impact.

Trusted by 300,000+ users globally, FlowForma was founded in 2012, the company is an award-winning
Microsoft Gold Partner recognized by analysts and Fortune 500 companies for delivering world-class
automation platforms and tools.

Since 1999, Financial Recovery Group (FRG) has helped health plans and physician groups create transparency in risk contracting, improve financial performance of service funds and recover millions of dollars in overpayments through online analytical reporting and expert claims audit services. Trusted by health plans and provider organizations nationwide, FRG brings industry leading medical economics capabilities to your healthcare enterprise.

Get Started Today!

Unlock Revenue Potential

Are unseen risks in revenue alignment causing financial strain on your healthcare organization?

FRG’s RAMP reports and dashboards highlight opportunities to recapture historically documented chronic revenue to ensure revenue alignment in active payment years. Our conservative and quantitatively rich approach to analysis and reporting delivers actionable findings to help you plan member outreach, close coding gaps and match medical expense budgets to real panel acuity.

Revenue Audit and Monitoring Program (RAMP) service provides analytics down to the member level, to identify and improve revenue alignment and support chart audit initiatives.

Our Story

## From Statistics Platform to AI-Verified Research Company

Gitnux was founded in 2021 with a simple mission: make quality market data accessible to everyone —
from Fortune 500 strategists to solo entrepreneurs.

What started as a curated statistics platform quickly revealed a deeper problem: the internet is
full of statistics that cite other statistics that cite other statistics, with no one checking the
original source. In 2023, we built our AI verification pipeline to solve this — a system that
independently reproduces, cross-references, and validates the claims made by primary research before
we publish anything.

Today, Gitnux serves thousands of businesses worldwide with AI-verified industry reports, custom
research projects, and on-demand data analysis. Our research has been referenced in over 3,000
articles across 500+ publications including Microsoft, Adobe, Harvard Business Review, and The
Guardian.

What Makes Us Different

## Verification, Not Just Aggregation

### AI-Verified Primary Research

We don't just collect statistics — we independently verify them. Our AI systems reproduce results,
cross-reference claims, and simulate survey populations to ensure accuracy before publication.

### Named Analysts, Real Credentials

Every report is written by a named researcher with verifiable academic credentials and professional
background. No anonymous editorial team — real people stand behind every data point.

### Source Traceability

Every published statistic links to its originating primary source. We never cite secondary
aggregators — if we can't trace it to the original research, we don't publish it.

### Human Editorial Authority

AI verifies. Humans decide. No statistic or product ranking is published without a human editor's
explicit approval, regardless of what the automated system recommends.

Our Process

## Five Steps from Source to Publication

Every piece of content follows the same pipeline. Humans lead editorial decisions. AI handles
verification at scale.

#### Research Collection

Human-led aggregation from primary sources

#### Editorial Curation

Human editors decide what enters the pipeline

#### AI Verification

Independent reproduction, cross-referencing, simulation

#### Human Cross-Check

Editor reviews AI results, makes final decision

#### Human Writing

Analysts write content; AI handles SEO & tech only

## Large Volume Provider Enrollment and Credentialing Services

Every medical care provider is subject to undergo credentialing services at some point in their
career. Medical credentialing services involve verifying practitioners are legally certified to
render the care they offer and have all the necessary training to do so. This process is a
requirement set forth by organizations including the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services
(CMS) and the Joint Commission on Accreditation of Healthcare Organizations. Without the proper
credentials, a medical provider is ineligible for reimbursement from Medicaid and Medicare.

Provider credentialing is a time-consuming process with serious consequences to your bottom line if
handled improperly. Let Global verify the skills, training, licensing, and qualifications of medical
professionals so you can focus on business growth.

[Schedule a Meeting][51]

## Our Provider Credentialing Services

For most businesses, outsourced credentialing services are the best method of verifying information.
Every medical practice has enough to focus on with running the day-to-day operations, and while
credentialing is important, it can easily get swept to the side in favor of patient care.

That is where Global Healthcare Resource comes in. Global works on large-volume projects to verify
the following provider credentials:

schools where the practitioner received their undergraduate, graduate, and medical degrees and
confirm they took and passed all necessary courses.

information about their studies and ensure the information on their record is correct.

[emails][emails]

#### Licensing

Our staff will contact any licensing agencies the provider is associated with and confirm their
license is valid and in date.

[contract][contract]

#### Specialty Certificates

If the practitioner has any certifications or additional educational experiences, we will verify

[profile-user][profile-user]

If there are any other qualifications, we will contact the proper authorities to determine their
validity.

[resume-and-cv][resume-and-cv]

Finally, we will go over individual resumes to explore past places of employment, confirming their
career path up to the present day.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What are medical record services, and why are they essential for healthcare providers?

Medical record services involve the management, storage, and retrieval of patient health
information, including medical histories, treatment plans, and diagnostic results. These services
are essential for healthcare providers because they:
* Ensure Compliance: Help maintain compliance with healthcare regulations, such as HIPAA, by
safeguarding patient information.
* Facilitate Continuity of Care: Provide accurate and up-to-date patient information, enabling
healthcare providers to make informed decisions and deliver coordinated care.
* Enhance Operational Efficiency: Streamline administrative processes, reducing the time spent on
record management and allowing staff to focus on patient care.

How can accurate medical record management improve patient care?

Accurate medical record management can improve patient care by:
* Enhancing Communication: Ensures that all healthcare providers involved in a patient’s care have
access to the same information, reducing the risk of errors and miscommunication.
* Supporting Clinical Decision-Making: Provides healthcare professionals with comprehensive patient
histories, enabling them to make informed treatment decisions.
* Facilitating Timely Interventions: Allows for quick access to critical patient information,
ensuring timely interventions and improving patient outcomes.
* Improving Patient Safety: Reduces the likelihood of medication errors and adverse events by
maintaining accurate and complete records.

What are the benefits of outsourcing medical record services?

Outsourcing medical record services offers several benefits, including:
* Cost Savings: Reduces overhead costs associated with maintaining in-house record management staff
and infrastructure.
* Access to Expertise: Leverages specialized knowledge and technology from third-party vendors to
ensure accurate and efficient record management.
* Improved Compliance: Ensures adherence to regulatory requirements and best practices in medical
record handling.
* Scalability: Allows healthcare organizations to easily adjust services based on patient volume and
changing needs.
* Enhanced Focus on Patient Care: Frees up healthcare staff to concentrate on direct patient care
rather than administrative tasks.

What types of medical records does Global Healthcare Resource handle?

Global Healthcare Resource handles various types of medical records, including:
* Patient Health Records: Comprehensive records that include medical histories, treatment plans, and
progress notes.
* Radiology Reports: Imaging studies and interpretations, including X-rays, MRIs, and CT scans.
* Laboratory Results: Test results from blood work, biopsies, and other diagnostic tests.
* Billing and Insurance Records: Documentation related to patient billing, insurance claims, and
payment histories.
* Specialty Records: Records specific to certain medical specialties, such as mental health,
pediatrics, or geriatrics.

What is the typical turnaround time for processing and delivering medical record requests?

The typical turnaround time for processing and delivering medical record requests can vary based on
several factors, including the complexity of the request and the volume of records involved.
Generally, it can take anywhere from 3 to 15 business days to fulfill requests. However, urgent
requests may be expedited, while more complex requests may require additional time for thorough
processing and verification.

allowing providers to allocate resources more effectively.
* Access to Expertise: Specialized billing companies have in-depth knowledge of healthcare billing
practices, ensuring accuracy and compliance with regulations.
* Improved Collection Rates: Outsourcing can lead to higher collection rates and faster payments due
to the expertise and resources of dedicated billing professionals.
* Enhanced Focus on Patient Care: By delegating billing tasks, healthcare providers can concentrate
on delivering quality patient care rather than administrative duties.
* Scalability: Outsourcing allows organizations to easily adjust billing services based on patient
volume and changing needs without the burden of hiring and training new staff.

How can outsourcing medical billing improve the efficiency of a healthcare organization?

Outsourcing medical billing can improve the efficiency of a healthcare organization by:
* Streamlining Processes: Specialized billing companies often have established processes and
advanced technology that enhance the efficiency of billing and collections.
* Reducing Administrative Burden: Delegating billing tasks frees up internal staff to focus on core
functions, improving overall operational efficiency.
* Minimizing Errors: Experienced billing professionals are less likely to make errors in coding and
billing, leading to fewer claim denials and faster payments.
* Providing Real-Time Reporting: Outsourcing partners typically offer detailed reporting and
analytics, allowing organizations to monitor performance and make informed decisions.
* Enhancing Compliance: Outsourcing partners stay updated on regulatory changes, helping
organizations maintain compliance and reduce the risk of audits.

What factors should healthcare providers consider when selecting a medical billing outsourcing
partner?

Healthcare providers should consider the following factors when selecting a medical billing
outsourcing partner:
* Experience and Expertise: Look for a partner with a proven track record in healthcare billing and
a deep understanding of the specific needs of the provider’s specialty.
* Technology and Integration: Evaluate the technology used by the outsourcing partner and their
ability to integrate with existing systems seamlessly.
* Reputation and References: Research the partner’s reputation in the industry and seek references
from other healthcare providers to gauge their reliability and performance.
* Compliance and Security: Ensure that the partner adheres to industry regulations, such as HIPAA,
and has robust data security measures in place to protect patient information.
* Customer Support: Assess the level of customer support offered, including responsiveness and
availability for addressing concerns or issues.

How does the outsourcing process work, and what can clients expect during onboarding?

The outsourcing process typically involves the following steps:
* Initial Consultation: The healthcare provider meets with the outsourcing partner to discuss needs,
expectations, and specific requirements.
* Contract Agreement: Both parties agree on the terms of the partnership, including pricing,
services provided, and performance metrics.

Security and compliance embedded in every process

## HITRUST

Global Healthcare Resource attained a HITRUST i1 certification. Our commitment to security and
compliance is embedded in every layer of our infrastructure. Through rigorous standards, continuous
monitoring and audits, and industry recognized certifications, Global maintains a secure environment
our partners can rely on.

## SOC 2 Type 2

SOC 2 Type 2 audits determine how well an organization safeguards customer data and how those
controls operate over a 9-month (minimum) time frame. Reports are issued by third party auditors who
review the following principles: Security, Confidentiality & Availability. Global Healthcare
Resource is proudly SOC 2 Type 2 compliant.

[cyber-security][cyber-security]

#### Security

The security principle addresses whether an organization’s system is protected (both physically and
logically) against unauthorized access.

[availability][availability]

#### Availability

The availability principle addresses whether the services an organization provides is operating with
the type of availability that client’s expect.

[confidential-information][confidential-information]

#### Confidentiality

The confidentiality principle addresses the agreements made with clients in regard to how their
information is used, who has access to it and how it’s protected.

[H_Global-RCM_19][H_Global-RCM_19]

## ISO 9001: 2025

Our ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management system reinforces standardized processes, continuous
improvement, and operational consistency across the organization. This framework ensures that our
services are delivered with defined controls, measurable performance, and a focus on quality at
every stage.

## HIPAA

We maintain strict adherence to HIPAA requirements across all operations, supported by structured
employee training, role-based access controls, and ongoing monitoring. All employees complete HIPAA
training during onboarding and participate in annual refresher courses with required assessments to
ensure continued compliance and accountability.

## Insurance Eligibility Verification Solutions

Accurate eligibility verification is essential to a high-performing revenue cycle, yet it remains
one of the most error-prone processes for healthcare organizations. Experienced eligibility
verification partners help streamline these workflows, improve accuracy, and support timely
reimbursement.

Global Healthcare Resource manages the eligibility verification process by collecting critical
patient benefit information prior to service delivery. Our skilled eligibility verification team
performs comprehensive benefit checks to determine the following:
* Co-pays and coinsurance
* Dates of insurance coverage
* Deductible amounts
* Other vital benefit information
* Plan type and policy number

[Schedule A Meeting][51]

[H_Global-RCM_11][H_Global-RCM_11]

## Our Patient Eligibility Verification Process

Properly verifying patient eligibility prior to an appointment can prevent claim denials and promote
smooth cash flow. To ensure accuracy, Global Healthcare Resource’s insurance eligibility
verification services include the following steps:
1. **Confirm activity:** We start by checking the status of a patient’s insurance plan and ensuring
it is active. If so, we confirm what it covers and whether benefit limitations exist.
2. **Determine plan coverage: **We will determine whether the patient has coverage through multiple
plans. If this exists, we will verify which ones are applicable and identify primary versus
secondary coverage.
3. **Verify plan approvals:** Before the appointment, our team will check whether the patient’s
insurance plan approves procedures, tests, and consultations. This verification will provide
insight into possible treatment options under coverage.
4. **Identify co-pays and/or deductibles:** Finally, we identify any co-pays or deductibles the
patient may be responsible for upon their appointment. This way, your team and the patient can be
prepared for possible appointment costs.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is patient eligibility verification?

Patient eligibility verification is the process of confirming a patient’s insurance coverage and
benefits before providing medical services. This crucial step ensures that healthcare providers
receive reimbursement for services rendered. It involves checking the patient’s insurance status,
coverage limits, and any applicable co-pays or deductibles. By conducting eligibility verification,
healthcare organizations can minimize claim denials and streamline the billing process.

Why is prior authorization necessary in patient eligibility verification?

Prior authorization is necessary in patient eligibility verification to ensure that specific medical
services or procedures are covered by the patient’s insurance plan. This process requires healthcare
providers to obtain approval from the insurance company before delivering certain treatments,
medications, or tests. Prior authorization helps control healthcare costs, prevents unnecessary
procedures, and ensures that patients receive appropriate care based on their insurance benefits.

How does Global Healthcare Resource ensure HIPAA compliance?

How does Global Healthcare Resource ensure HIPAA compliance?

What types of insurance does Global Healthcare Resource verify?

Global Healthcare Resource verifies a wide range of insurance types, including private health
insurance, government programs such as Medicare and Medicaid, and managed care plans. They work with
various insurance providers to ensure comprehensive eligibility verification for patients, allowing
healthcare organizations to efficiently manage their billing processes and reduce claim denials.

How long does the eligibility verification process take?

The eligibility verification process typically takes anywhere from a few minutes to a couple of
days, depending on the complexity of the patient’s insurance plan and the efficiency of the
verification system used. Automated systems can expedite the process, allowing healthcare providers
to receive real-time updates on patient eligibility. However, manual verifications may take longer
due to the need for additional documentation or communication with insurance companies.

What are the benefits of outsourcing eligibility verification?

Outsourcing eligibility verification offers several benefits, including:
* Cost Savings: Reduces overhead costs associated with hiring and training in-house staff.
* Increased Efficiency: Streamlines the verification process, allowing healthcare providers to focus
on patient care.
* Access to Expertise: Leverages specialized knowledge and technology from third-party vendors to
ensure accurate and timely verifications.
* Improved Cash Flow: Minimizes claim denials and accelerates reimbursement cycles, enhancing the
financial health of healthcare organizations.
* Scalability: Allows healthcare providers to easily adjust verification services based on patient
volume and demand.

What is patient eligibility verification?

coverage limits, and any applicable co-pays or deductibles. By conducting eligibility verification,

medications, or tests. Prior authorization helps control healthcare costs, prevents unnecessary
procedures, and ensures that patients receive appropriate care based on their insurance benefits.

How does Global Healthcare Resource ensure HIPAA compliance?

to protect patient information. This includes conducting regular training for staff on HIPAA
regulations, utilizing secure electronic systems for data management, and ensuring that all
communications involving patient data are encrypted. Additionally, Global Healthcare Resource
performs regular audits and risk assessments to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities in

## Frequently Asked Questions

How does outsourcing payment posting services impact overall operational efficiency?

Outsourcing payment posting services can significantly enhance overall operational efficiency by:
* Reducing Administrative Burden: Frees up internal staff from time-consuming payment posting tasks,
allowing them to focus on core functions such as patient care and revenue cycle management.
* Improving Accuracy: Specialized outsourcing partners often have advanced technology and trained
personnel, leading to fewer errors in payment posting and reconciliation.
* Accelerating Payment Processing: Streamlined processes and dedicated resources can lead to faster
payment posting, improving cash flow and reducing days in accounts receivable.
* Enhancing Reporting Capabilities: Outsourcing partners typically provide detailed reporting and
analytics, enabling organizations to gain insights into payment trends and performance metrics.

How can healthcare organizations prepare for a transition to outsourced payment posting services?

Healthcare organizations can prepare for a transition to outsourced payment posting services by:
* Assessing Current Processes: Conducting a thorough evaluation of existing payment posting
workflows to identify areas for improvement and potential challenges.
* Selecting the Right Partner: Researching and selecting a reputable outsourcing provider with
experience in healthcare payment posting and a proven track record.
* Establishing Clear Communication: Setting up open lines of communication with the outsourcing
partner to ensure alignment on expectations, processes, and timelines.
* Training Staff: Providing training for internal staff on new processes and how to collaborate
effectively with the outsourcing partner.
* Monitoring Transition Progress: Continuously monitoring the transition process and addressing any
issues that arise to ensure a smooth integration.

How does Global Healthcare Resources payment posting service integrate with existing billing
systems?

Global Healthcare Resources’ payment posting service integrates with existing billing systems by:
* Utilizing APIs: Employing application programming interfaces (APIs) to facilitate seamless data
exchange between the payment posting service and the organization’s billing software.
* Customizable Solutions: Offering customizable integration options to accommodate various billing
systems and workflows, ensuring compatibility and efficiency.
* Real-Time Updates: Providing real-time updates on payment postings and adjustments, allowing
organizations to maintain accurate financial records and improve cash flow management.
* Data Security: Ensuring that all data transfers are secure and compliant with healthcare
regulations, such as HIPAA, to protect patient information.

What should organizations look for when selecting a payment posting service provider?

When selecting a payment posting service provider, organizations should consider the following
factors:
* Experience and Expertise: Look for a provider with a strong background in healthcare payment
posting and a proven track record of success.
* Technology and Integration: Evaluate the technology used by the provider and their ability to
integrate with existing billing systems seamlessly.
* Accuracy and Compliance: Ensure that the provider adheres to industry standards and regulations,
minimizing errors and ensuring compliance with healthcare laws.
* Customer Support: Assess the level of customer support offered, including responsiveness and
availability for addressing concerns or issues.
* Reporting and Analytics: Consider the provider’s ability to deliver detailed reporting and
analytics to help organizations monitor performance and make informed decisions.

What are payment posting services, and why are they important in healthcare?

Payment posting services involve the process of recording and reconciling payments received from
patients and insurance companies for healthcare services rendered. These services are important in
healthcare because they:
* Ensure Accurate Financial Records: Proper payment posting is essential for maintaining accurate
financial records, which are critical for effective revenue cycle management.
* Facilitate Cash Flow Management: Timely and accurate posting of payments helps organizations
manage cash flow and ensure that they have the resources needed to operate effectively.
* Reduce Days in Accounts Receivable: Efficient payment posting processes can lead to faster
collections and reduced days in accounts receivable, improving overall financial health.
* Enhance Patient Satisfaction: Accurate posting of payments helps prevent billing errors and
confusion, leading to a better patient experience.

What types of payments are typically processed through payment posting services?

Payment posting services typically process various types of payments, including:
* Insurance Payments: Payments received from insurance companies for covered services rendered to
patients.
* Patient Payments: Direct payments made by patients for co-pays, deductibles, and out-of-pocket
expenses.
* Secondary Insurance Payments: Payments from secondary insurance providers for services already
billed to primary insurers.
* Adjustments and Write-Offs: Recording adjustments, discounts, and write-offs related to patient
accounts and insurance claims.
* Refunds: Processing refunds to patients or insurance companies for overpayments or billing errors.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is accounts receivable follow-up, and why is it important for healthcare providers?

Accounts receivable follow-up is the process of monitoring and managing outstanding payments owed to
healthcare providers for services rendered. This process is crucial for healthcare providers because
it:
* Ensures Timely Payments: Regular follow-up helps to identify and resolve any issues that may delay
payments, ensuring that providers receive reimbursement promptly.
* Improves Cash Flow: Effective follow-up reduces the days in accounts receivable, enhancing the
organization’s cash flow and financial stability.
* Minimizes Bad Debt: Proactive follow-up can prevent accounts from becoming uncollectible, reducing
the risk of bad debt and improving overall financial health.

How can effective accounts receivable follow-up improve my organization’s financial performance?

Effective accounts receivable follow-up can improve an organization’s financial performance by:
* Increasing Collection Rates: Consistent follow-up increases the likelihood of collecting
outstanding payments, leading to higher revenue.
* Reducing Write-Offs: By addressing issues early, organizations can minimize write-offs and improve
their bottom line.
* Enhancing Operational Efficiency: Streamlined follow-up processes reduce administrative burdens,
allowing staff to focus on patient care and other critical tasks.
* Providing Financial Insights: Regular follow-up generates valuable data on payment trends and
patient behavior, enabling better financial planning and decision-making.

What is the role of accounts receivable services in the healthcare revenue cycle?

Accounts receivable services play a vital role in the healthcare revenue cycle by:
* Managing Billing Processes: Ensuring accurate and timely billing for services rendered, which is
essential for prompt payment.
* Tracking Payments: Monitoring outstanding accounts and following up on unpaid invoices to
facilitate timely collections.
* Resolving Disputes: Addressing any discrepancies or disputes with payers to ensure that claims are
paid correctly.
* Reporting and Analysis: Providing insights into accounts receivable performance, helping
organizations identify trends and areas for improvement.

What factors contribute to delayed payments in accounts receivable?

Several factors can contribute to delayed payments in accounts receivable, including:
* Claim Denials: High rates of claim denials due to coding errors, incomplete documentation, or
eligibility issues can slow down payment processing.
* Inefficient Billing Processes: Outdated or inefficient billing practices can lead to delays in
invoicing and follow-up.
* Patient Payment Responsibility: Increased patient financial responsibility, such as
high-deductible plans, can result in slower payments from patients.
* Payer Delays: Insurance companies may have their own processing delays, impacting the timing of
payments to providers.

What are the benefits of outsourcing accounts receivable services?

Outsourcing accounts receivable services offers several benefits, including:
* Cost Efficiency: Reduces overhead costs associated with maintaining an in-house accounts
receivable team.
* Access to Expertise: Leverages specialized knowledge and technology from third-party vendors to
optimize collections and billing processes.
* Improved Cash Flow: Streamlined processes and dedicated follow-up can lead to faster payments and
improved cash flow.
* Scalability: Allows organizations to easily adjust services based on patient volume and changing
needs.
* Focus on Core Operations: Frees up internal staff to concentrate on patient care and other
essential functions.

What are the long-term financial benefits of maintaining a healthy accounts receivable process?

Maintaining a healthy accounts receivable process can yield long-term financial benefits, including:
* Sustained Revenue Growth: Consistent collections lead to stable revenue streams, supporting
organizational growth and expansion.
* Reduced Bad Debt: Effective management minimizes the risk of uncollectible accounts, improving
overall profitability.
* Enhanced Financial Stability: Improved cash flow and timely payments contribute to a stronger
financial position and better creditworthiness.
* Informed Decision-Making: Accurate accounts receivable data provides insights for strategic
planning and resource allocation.

How do you handle the transition of existing accounts receivable processes to an outsourced model?

Handling the transition of existing accounts receivable processes to an outsourced model involves
several key steps:
* Assessment and Planning: Conduct a thorough assessment of current processes and identify areas for
improvement. Develop a detailed transition plan outlining timelines and responsibilities.
* Communication: Communicate with internal staff and stakeholders about the transition, addressing
any concerns and outlining the benefits of outsourcing.
* Data Transfer: Ensure secure and accurate transfer of all relevant data, including patient
accounts, billing histories, and outstanding invoices, to the outsourcing partner.
* Training and Integration: Collaborate with the outsourcing partner to train staff on new processes
and integrate their systems with existing workflows.
* Monitoring and Evaluation: Continuously monitor the performance of the outsourced accounts
receivable services and evaluate their impact on financial performance, making adjustments as
needed.

healthcare companies desiring offshore solutions. His strengths include BPO, international
operations management, staff and training, market startup, business planning and revenue
forecasting.

Phillip has led countless operational expansion projects throughout the most advantageous markets in

invaluable experience aligning healthcare companies with the right outsource solutions to obtain
maximum revenue growth, specifically in areas of healthcare billing, coding, provider management,
patient self-pay, patient experience and eligibility, provider credentialing, risk adjustment and
medical record services.

whenever possible.

## Vishal Jain

Vishal Jain brings over 25 years of operational and financial expertise to healthcare revenue cycle
companies. He recognized an opportunity to connect American healthcare organizations with
highly-skilled international professionals.

In 1999, Global Healthcare Resource was formed to give U.S.-based businesses a cost-effective way to
manage their reimbursement cycle, aid in growth goals, and build organizational resilience. Vishal
has grown Global to over 6,000 employees across seven offices throughout the U.S., India, and the
Philippines. In 2014, Vishal expanded Global’s service offerings to include two patient call centers
with locations in Manila and Cebu.

Outside of his business achievements, Vishal is committed to corporate social responsibility and
giving back to the community. With a firm belief in education and its ability to transform society,
Vishal has constructed over 100 classrooms, benefiting over 100,000 children in the last decade.

Vishal attended Vivekanada College, Madras University, where he graduated with a Bachelor of
Commerce as a Salutatorian of 100,000 students. He also earned his CPA soon after graduating and was
ranked 27th in the entire country of India. He later attained his Master of Business Administration
from the University of Hull in the United Kingdom.

Vishal is married and enjoys spending time with his two children.

Through its innovative Smart Healthcare Platform, the company offers a range of services including healthcare navigation, cost comparison tools, personalized assistance, and expert negotiation services, catering to health plans, employers, third-party administrators (TPAs), and health sharing organizations. By enhancing member satisfaction and reducing costs, HealthAdmins aims to foster loyalty and improve overall healthcare experiences.

## Questions we hear *on every first call.*

Are your assistants real people or AI? +
Real people. Every time. We're AI-enabled - meaning we use AI to help our agents be better at their
jobs (faster onboarding, knowledge systems, quality monitoring) - but the humans talking to your
patients are exactly that. Humans. Trained for your practice.
Where are your virtual assistants based? +
Primarily the Philippines for patient-facing and front-desk roles, and India for back-office and
billing roles. Our US team in Doylestown, Pennsylvania manages recruitment, training, and the
account relationship.
How do you pre-qualify candidates? +
We built our own proprietary assessment system that scores every candidate on voice clarity,
grammar, spelling, patient support aptitude, and healthcare knowledge. Less than 3% of applicants
clear every dimension - those are the only candidates presented to you for interview.
How do you handle HIPAA compliance? +
We sign the Business Associate Agreement at the company level. All assistants are HIPAA-certified,
work from a secure virtual desktop with no copy or paste of PHI, and have single-user authenticated
logins.
What happens if the assistant doesn't work out? +
We replace them at no cost - no matter how long they've been with you. Because candidates are vetted
and you interview them before they start, this is rare.
What EHR systems do you work with? +
All major systems - Athena, Epic, Modernizing Medicine, Tebra, IntakeQ, eClinicalWorks, and more.
Access runs through a secure virtual desktop we provide.
What are your pricing and minimums? +
$8 to $13 per hour depending on the role. Back office roles like billing and claims start at $8.
Patient-facing roles like scheduling and intake are $10 to $13. No upfront costs. No implementation
fees. Standard minimum is 20 hours per week with a 3-month initial agreement.

# Twenty years of building *better human support.*

HelpSquad did not start as a healthcare BPO. It started as a question: why is it so hard for a real
person to help a real customer when they need it? Two decades, six global delivery and operations
hubs, and one healthcare arm later, we are still answering that question - now with Managed Virtual
Medical Assistants at the center of the work.

[Talk with us →][82] [See the timeline][83]
From our CEO

## Why we started *HelpSquad Health.*

Jason O'Neill on the origin of HelpSquad, the shift into healthcare, and why "embedded, not
outsourced" is more than a tagline for us.

The timeline

## Connecting with patients and customers, *one decade at a time.*
1. [2005 - The foundation.]
2005

### The foundation.

Michael Kansky founded LiveHelpNow, a chat software company built on one idea: give businesses a
better way to talk to their customers. For a decade the team shipped award-winning help desk and
live chat tools still used by thousands of brands today.
2. [2015 - The managed service revolution.]
2015

### The managed service revolution.

Clients had the tools, but not the people to run them. HelpSquad launched to fix that -
introducing 24/7 live chat support and the Six-Squad Structure, an operational model built for
accountability and specialisation that traditional call centers could not match.
3. [2020 - Global resilience.]
2020

### Global resilience.

As demand for 24/7 coverage grew, we opened strategic operations hubs in the Philippines and
South Africa. The expansion meant uninterrupted service for our clients and access to an elite
global talent pool of customer service professionals.
4. [2023 - Healthcare expansion.]
2023

### Healthcare expansion.

Many of our clients were already healthcare practices, so we built a dedicated healthcare arm:
fully managed call center teams, virtual medical assistants, front- and back-office support, and
medical billing. HIPAA-compliant, BAA at the company level.
5. 2025 Today
2025

### Innovation and excellence.

Today HelpSquad is recognised as a Top 15 Global Business Process Outsourcing company by Clutch.
We integrate proprietary AI tools into every workflow so human empathy and machine precision work
together - never the other way around.

## Common questions *before you reach out.*

### Why no contact form on this page?

Forms add friction and funnel you into generic drip campaigns. A Calendly link, a phone number, and
a mailto get you to a real person faster. Pick the channel you prefer.

### Are you HIPAA-compliant?

Yes. HelpSquad signs a Business Associate Agreement at the company level - not with an offshore VA
or agency. Secure virtual desktops, role-based access, and documented procedures are built into
every healthcare engagement.

### How fast can you staff a virtual medical assistant?

About two weeks end-to-end: 30-minute discovery call, role design, candidate pre-qualification, your
interview round, HIPAA onboarding. We have seen it done in seven days for urgent cases.

### What should I bring to the consultation?

Bring the work. The more specific you can be about the tasks you want to offload (EHR name, call
volume, hours of coverage, tools used), the more useful the call. If you only know the pain, that is
enough too.
