# Privacy Policy

HelpSquad, LLC

**HelpSquad, LLC Privacy Policy Statement
**This privacy policy has been compiled to better serve those who are concerned with how their
'Personally identifiable information' (PII) is being used online. PII, as used in US privacy law and
information security, is information that can be used on its own or with other information to
identify, contact, or locate a single person, or to identify an individual in context. Please read
our privacy policy carefully to get a clear understanding of how we collect, use, protect or
otherwise handle your Personally Identifiable Information in accordance with our website.

**What information do we collect, and when do we collect information?
**We collect information from you when you register on our site, place an order or fill out a form.

When ordering or registering on our site, as appropriate, you may be asked to enter your name,
e-mail address, web site address, company name, phone number, credit card information and other
information, to help with your experience. You may, however, visit our site anonymously.

Like most websites and live chat services, we use cookies to enhance your experience, gather general
visitor information, and track visits to our website, software and live chat operator service.
Please refer to the Do we use cookies? Section below for information about cookies and how we use
them.

**What do we use your information for?
**We may use the information we collect from you when you register, make a purchase, sign up for our
newsletter, respond to a survey or marketing communication, surf the website, or use certain other
site features in the following ways:

1. To improve customer service (your information helps us to more effectively respond to your
customer service requests and support needs)

2.To process transactions

3. To send periodic emails regarding your order or other products and services.

4. To send periodic newsletter or email updates that enhance your user experience with HelpSquad.

**How do we protect your information?
**We implement a variety of security measures to maintain the safety of your personal information
when you submit a request, place an order or enter, submit, or access your personal information.

These security measures include password protected directories and databases to safeguard your
information.

We offer the use of a secure server. All supplied sensitive information including credit information
is transmitted via Secure Socket Layer (SSL) technology and encrypted into our payment gateway
provider’s database. It is only accessible by those authorized with special access rights to such
systems, who are required to keep the information confidential.

After a transaction, your private information (credit cards, social security numbers, financials,
etc.) will not be stored on our servers.

**Do we use 'cookies'?
**Yes. Cookies are small files that a site or its service provider transfers to your computer's hard
drive through your Web browser (if you allow) that enables the site's or service provider's systems
to recognize your browser and capture and remember certain information. For instance, we use cookies
to help us remember and process the items in your shopping cart. They are also used to help us
understand your preferences based on previous or current site activity, which enables us to provide
you with improved services. We also use cookies to help us compile aggregate data about site traffic
and site interaction so that we can offer better site experiences and tools in the future.

**We use cookies to:
**§ Understand and save user's preferences for future visits.
§ Compile aggregate data about site traffic and site interactions in order to offer better site
experiences and tools in the future. We may also use trusted third party services that track this
information on our behalf.

You can choose to have your computer warn you each time a cookie is being sent, or you can choose to
turn off all cookies. You do this through your browser (like Internet Explorer) settings. Each
browser is a little different, so look at your browser's Help menu to learn the correct way to
modify your cookies.

If you disable cookies off, some features will be disabled. It won't affect the user’s experience
that makes your site experience more efficient and some of our services will not function properly.

However, you can still place orders.

**Do we disclose any information to outside parties?
**We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer to outside parties your personally identifiable
information. This does not include trusted third parties who assist us in operating our website,
software and live chat operator service, conducting our business, or servicing you, so long as those
parties agree to keep this information confidential. We may also release your information when we
believe it is appropriate for purposes of complying with the law, enforcing our site policies, or
protecting ours or others’ rights, property, or safety. However, non-personally identifiable visitor
information may be provided to other parties for marketing, advertising, or other uses.

**Third-party Links
**Occasionally, at our discretion, we may include or offer third party products or services on our
website. These third party sites have separate and independent privacy policies. We therefore have
no responsibility or liability for the content and activities of these linked sites. Nonetheless, we
seek to protect the integrity of our site and welcome any feedback about these sites.

## Why choose ICICI Lombard?

### Dependable

**You can rely on us at all times.**

Be it during large calamities like Odisha cyclone or minor accidents like a broken tail-light, we
have always stood by our customers in time of need. We have repeatedly introduced industry-leading
practices for nearly two decades . So, in times of trouble, be assured, we’ve got your back. We
stand by our motto: **“Nibhaye Vaade”.**

[image-1]
[image-2]

### Approachable

**You've got a friend in us.**

Value of insurance is realised when you make a claim. In your hour of need, be it a major surgery or
a broken car, you need more than just claim support. Our team comprises highly trained professionals
and functional experts to guide you through the right course of action during emergencies. So, don’t
hesitate. Any questions you have or any help you need - just reach out to us.

#### We are available where you are.
* Call centre
* Chat
* 340+ branches

(As on Mar 31, 2026)

### Transparent

**We give you the power of clarity.**

Insurance products are designed and priced through complicated mathematical models. But we strive to
explain the extent of coverage to you in a simple manner. From policy issuance to claims, you can
count on us for keeping it simple. We have always gone the extra mile to make things clear, right
from pre-sales to claims support.

## Why choose ICICI Lombard?

### Dependable

**You can rely on us at all times.**

Be it during large calamities like Odisha cyclone or minor accidents like a broken tail-light, we
have always stood by our customers in time of need. We have repeatedly introduced industry-leading
practices for nearly two decades . So, in times of trouble, be assured, we’ve got your back. We
stand by our motto: **“Nibhaye Vaade”.**

[image-1]
[image-2]

### Approachable

**You've got a friend in us.**

Value of insurance is realised when you make a claim. In your hour of need, be it a major surgery or
a broken car, you need more than just claim support. Our team comprises highly trained professionals
and functional experts to guide you through the right course of action during emergencies. So, don’t
hesitate. Any questions you have or any help you need - just reach out to us.

#### We are available where you are.
* Call centre
* Chat
* 340+ branches

(As on Mar 31, 2026)

### Transparent

**We give you the power of clarity.**

Insurance products are designed and priced through complicated mathematical models. But we strive to
explain the extent of coverage to you in a simple manner. From policy issuance to claims, you can
count on us for keeping it simple. We have always gone the extra mile to make things clear, right
from pre-sales to claims support.

## PMFBY

The PMFBY was launched in 2016 and replaces all the prevailing yield insurance schemes in India. The
scheme has extended coverage under localized risks, post-harvest losses etc. and aims at adoption of
technology for the purpose of yield estimation. Through increased farmer awareness and low farmer
premium rates the scheme aims at increasing the crop insurance penetration in India.

Dear Policyholders,

case of discrepancy immediately email to [**customersupport@icicilombard.com**][118]

Their core offerings include term insurance plans, critical illness coverage, and customizable policies that provide financial security and peace of mind. Targeting salaried professionals and families, the company emphasizes affordability, instant issuance, and various discounts to enhance accessibility and customer satisfaction.

# About Us

Innovate your approach to claims processing and management with GGA Claims Solutions.

[Let’s Get Started][13]

## Humble Beginnings, Helpful Service

At GGA Claim Solutions, our commitment to integrity drives all of our business initiatives. But
before venturing into the insurance sector, we started as a business process outsourcing company.
Although we’re in a very different industry than our parent company, our values remain the same:
[providing helpful service and a quality client experience][14].

It’s because of our clients that we’ve been able to scale so quickly. With GGA Claim Solutions, you
get more than a third-party administrator—you get a partner committed to helping you reach key
milestones.

We’re not here to make a quick buck. That’s why all of our contracts come with 90-day implementation
and exit phases as a risk-free way to explore the benefits of our comprehensive approach. GGA Claims
Solutions is here to be your long-term partner, but we do it by providing reliable service—not
locking you into lengthy contracts.

## Our Partners

## GGA Claims Solutions: A Multinational Approach to Third-Party Administration

With locations in Dallas, Texas, and Puebla, Mexico, we offer several competitive advantages that
can only be found with a multinational provider.
* **Bilingual Agents:** In the insurance industry, agents who speak multiple languages are a
valuable asset that gives a wider audience access to your company. At GGA, the majority of our
agents can communicate with your clients in their preferred language. Not only does this establish
stronger relationships, but it also increases customer satisfaction, retention rates, and profit
margins.
* **Cost Savings:** If you’re looking for a cost-effective way to source high-quality talent, [GGA’s
nearshore][15] solutions deliver the value you need. We can assemble your entire claims support
team for ~30 to 40% of the price of a U.S.-based administrator. This gives you access to skilled
agents around the clock and cuts costs in the process.
* **Value-Based Approach:** Your business is unique, and a “one-size-fits-all” approach to
[third-party administration][16] simply won’t cut it. Luckily, GGA takes the time to truly
understand not only your current needs, but your long-term goals as well. From there, we’ll align
our solutions with your business objectives, ensuring our services are tailored specifically for
your organization.

“[GGA Claims Solutions] took a personalized approach to our claims handling that made a huge
difference. They took the time to assimilate into our back-office functions and identified key areas
of improvement. OPEX was much lower that quarter. Grateful for the expertise and attention
provided.”

## On-Demand Claim Support Is Just a Click Away

Today’s corporate landscape runs at a cut-throat pace, and the insurance industry is no exception.
When every minute matters, you need reliable claim support at a moment’s notice. And when that time
comes, GGA Claim Solutions will be there to help. Schedule a free consultation with our experts to
get started.

[Schedule My Free Consultation ][17]
**~30 to 40%**

Cheaper than U.S.-based third-party administrators.

**100%**

Of our claim representatives are college-educated.

# Meet Our Leadership Team

We’re innovating the claims processing industry with forward-thinking strategies that put people
first.

[Let’s Get Started][13]

## GGA Claims Solutions: Setting the Standard With People-First Strategies

Our mission is simple: to help both our clients and employees reach their highest potential. That’s
why we adhere to people-first values; when everyone is supported by a solid culture, everything from
real-time collaboration to claims processing happens with less friction.

Our helpful, experienced team members deliver high-quality service, creating a better product for
our clients and laying the groundwork for your long-term success.

## **Valeria Rico**

**Chairman of the Board**

Ms. Rico has over 20 years of leadership experience in outsourcing operations across Mexico. She
also has an established track record of successfully leading, scaling, and consulting startup
operations in the United States that add up to over $500 million in revenue.

## **Daniel Rangel**

**Chief Operating Officer **

Mr. Rangel spearheads all initiatives related to administration and client services. He has over 15
years of experience in director-level roles, including, risk management, quality control, business
development and administration, and acquisitions.

## **Thomas Kohler**

**Chief Executive Officer **

With nearly three decades in the insurance industry, Mr. Kohler is a key part of our short- and
long-term strategies. With a resume that includes everything from branch management and claims
consulting to VP and CCO roles, his insight into policies and best practices is vital to GGA’s
third-party administration.

## **Chris Cybuch**

**Director of Business Development **

## What Can GGA Do for You?

Need a reliable third-party administrator to improve your approach to claims processing? Start a
conversation with the experts. We’ll develop forward-thinking strategies that streamline your
operations.

all_classified.company_summary: Judi Health is a comprehensive health benefit management company dedicated to transforming the healthcare experience through innovative technology and transparent pricing. Its core offerings include a full-service health benefit management platform that integrates pharmacy, medical, dental, and vision benefits, alongside AI-powered care navigation solutions. Targeting self-funded employers, health plans, brokers, and consultants, Judi Health aims to enhance member care and improve health outcomes while ensuring cost control and financial transparency.

FAQ

## Frequently asked questions

What is a pharmacy benefit manager?

A Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) is an administrator who processes prescription drug claims on
behalf of payers, such as employers and health plans.

[The role of a PBM][32] also includes handling numerous other behind-the-scenes processes, from plan
design to real-time data exchange, payments, eligibility, card printing, formulary management, and
much more.

Is Capital Rx a transparent PBM?

Yes! Capital Rx is a [transparent PBM][33] in all aspects of pharmacy benefits management. We never
earn revenue on drug spend, pass through 100% of manufacturer rebates to employers, and leverage a
public pricing benchmark – National Average Drug Acquisition Cost (NADAC) - to offer trustworthy and
reliable visibility into drug pricing.

What is NADAC and why does Capital Rx use it?

[NADAC is a public benchmark][34] calculated by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS)
that reflects the average amount pharmacies pay wholesalers for medications. As opposed to Average
Wholesale Price (AWP), which is based on wholesale pricing data that private companies collect from
drug manufacturers, and does not include rebates or discounts, NADAC offers a fair and transparent
view into real drug costs. Capital Rx uses NADAC to provide fair and transparent pricing for clients
and transparent reimbursement to pharmacies. Additionally, NADAC’s public availability allows
clients to hold us accountable for our transparency as a PBM.

How does implementation work with Capital Rx?

Capital Rx delivers a [seamless and efficient implementation experience][35]. Our dedicated team
guides clients through every step, facilitating smooth data migration and integration with existing
systems, minimizing member disruption by addressing concerns promptly, enabling continuity of care,
and helping maintain existing pharmacy relationships where possible.

How does Capital Rx handle rebates from drug manufacturers?

Capital Rx passes 100% of [drug manufacturer rebates][36] through to clients, eliminating hidden
fees and redirecting all financial benefits to them.

## Frequently asked questions

What is Judi Health?

[Judi Health][35] is the industry’s first unified claim processing platform that seamlessly
administers both pharmacy and medical claims on one platform. Designed for employer plan sponsors,
health systems, and health plans, Judi operates on a single, integrated platform to simplify
benefits management and improve care coordination.

Is Judi Health a secure platform for managing healthcare benefits?

Yes. [Judi Health is built with security at its core][36], following FISMA NIST 800-53 controls -
among the most rigorous in the industry. Its serverless architecture and use of fully-managed AWS
services reduce vulnerabilities and minimize ransomware risks. Judi also provides:

* Real-time monitoring for threats and anomalies
* Advanced malware and vulnerability detection
* Extensive content filtering to protect end users

Is Judi Health a plug-and-play solution for payers and health plans?

Easily integrate your choice of best-in-class point solutions, such as telemedicine, disease
management or women's health directly into Judi Health to continue providing uninterrupted benefits
to your members.

How does Judi Health help with regulatory compliance?

Judi Health streamlines annual compliance by:

* Validating SBCs with Phia to ensure accuracy
* Managing timely and accurate 5500 filings
* Supporting full ERISA documentation and disclosures
* Handling state-specific reporting like NY’s HCRA

How does Judi Health support the transition to value-based care?

Judi Health™ supports the shift to [value-based care ][37]by integrating medical and pharmacy claims
into a single platform. This unified system enables real-time data sharing, centralized services,
and innovative pricing models, which help reduce administrative burden and improve care
coordination.

While the healthcare system is still fragmented, with providers, payers, pharma, and PBMs often
working independently, Judi Health helps bridge these gaps. By offering comprehensive data
collection and analysis, the platform empowers all stakeholders to collaborate more effectively,
align incentives, and advance toward better outcomes in quality, equity, and cost.

What Is Judi Care?

What is Care Navigation?

[Care Navigation][32] is a patient-centered approach that helps individuals access the right
healthcare services at the right time. It involves guiding patients through the healthcare system,
connecting them with appropriate resources, and ensuring they receive the care they need
efficiently.

How does Care Navigation benefit patients?

Care Navigation simplifies and streamlines the healthcare journey, providing easy and efficient
access to services. It enables patients to find the most suitable healthcare professional or
service, avoiding unnecessary appointments and delays.

What types of services can Care Navigation help with?

Care Navigation can assist with a wide range of services, including scheduling appointments, finding
specialists, understanding insurance coverage, accessing community resources, and managing follow-up
care after treatment.

## Never again.

For self-funded plan sponsors with 10,000 members or more, implementing a new PBM isn’t just
inconvenient, it’s disruptive. But what if you could eliminate the disruption altogether? With
Judi®, you’re only bound by your creativity.

## Out with the old PBM, in with the new

It’s time to embody what PBMs were meant to be: straightforward, aligned, and supportive partners.

The old way
PBMs control profit centers, altering utilization to drive revenue.
Entangled contracts enable strategic financial opacity.
Plan sponsors are trapped by inflexible contracts and opaque pricing.
Outdated systems result in disruptions and inefficiencies.
Data is fragmented and lacks comprehensive security.
Custom solutions are difficult to implement and adapt.
The new way
An aligned PBM profit model eliminates conflicts of interest.
Financial transparency empowers better decision-making.
Agility brings greater purchasing power and versatility.
Modern technology offers seamless integration and updates.
Centralized data storage with full control and strong security.
Modular services enable easy customization and flexibility.

FAQ

## Frequently asked questions

What is* *Capital Rx’s *Never Move Again™*, and how does it work?

[*Never Move Again™* ][30] is a health benefit administration solution that offers larger employer
groups (more than 10,000 employees) a stable, scalable foundation for their health benefits program.

It includes Judi®, Capital Rx’s AI-powered [enterprise health platform for claim adjudication][31]
and data storage/access, and an award-winning customer contact center for member service.

Plan sponsors also have the flexibility to evaluate fulfillment and other “commodity” services
individually, if they’d like.

What are the advantages of unbundling PBM services compared to traditional bundled services?

Plan sponsors can see the cost of the individual services in an [unbundled model][32] and can tailor
their plan to meet the specific needs of their populations.

There is also assurance that any mistakes made whereby a member may receive more of a medication
than is needed, or a relatively more expensive medication vs. a cheaper alternative are not the
result of misaligned incentives that harm the plan.

How will unbundling affect the member experience?

With *Never Move Again™*, plan’s members have a more stable experience. There’s no need to change ID
cards, contact center numbers, or other resources.

And there’s no disruption due to claim history access issues, since everything is stored in one
place.

There should also be more benefits due to customization and the ability for the plan sponsor to add
or remove services that may be or are not providing a positive ROI or good experience.

What is Judi and how does it support unbundling?

Judi is Capital Rx’s AI-powered enterprise health platform, often referred to as “the brains” of our
organization.

It houses member data, plan design, prior authorization, and other tools and workflows that are
required to administer a health benefit program, all in one easy-to-use system.

Can Judi integrate with any point solution?

Yes. Any vendor leveraging API technology can connect to and share data or information with Capital
Rx.

# Level-funded pharmacy benefit plans for predictable budgets

Capital Equilibrium is a level-funded pharmacy benefit solution designed for self-funded employers
and municipalities seeking a combination of cost savings, flexibility, and budgeting security.

Talk to Our Experts
Talk to Our Experts
][29]

## Why Capital Equilibrium is the right choice

Defined Monthly Rx Plan Premium Cost

No surprises. Just a consistent PEPM-based premium rate.

True Upside Benefit

If your pharmacy costs come in lower than expected, you get rewarded with refunds or credits.

Renewal Stability

Your entire claims experience, including rebate and non-rebate dollars earned by the plan, is used
to establish your renewal premium.

Award-Winning Member Service

Members love us. We offer 24/7/365, U.S.-based, multilingual support.

## What is a level-funded pharmacy benefit plan?

A level-funded plan combines the security of defined monthly payments with the opportunity to
benefit if the overall experience is better than expected.

Your monthly rate covers claims, admin fees, and stop-loss protection. Capital Equilibrium stands
apart by offering a fair pricing structure that eliminates the traditional PBM gameplay around
discounts and rebates, which often results in overstated, unachievable savings expectations.

## Aligned with industry-leading partners

An A-Rated stop-loss carrier for reinsurance to back claims exceeding monthly amounts means cost
control for claims covered by the policy.

[Capital Rx][30] provides conflict-free pharmacy benefit administration, allowing Capital
Equilibrium to bend the curve for plan sponsors through its unique features across all 50 states.

FAQ

## Frequently asked questions

What is a level-funded pharmacy benefit plan?

A [level-funded pharmacy benefit plan][31] offers a defined monthly premium rate covering expected
claims, admin fees, and stop-loss. There are benefits to a plan sponsor if plan performance is
better than projected.

Who should choose Capital Equilibrium?

Municipalities and employers looking for a combination of cost savings, flexibility, and budgeting
security.

How is Capital Equilibrium different?

Capital Equilibrium leverages the financial value offered by Capital Rx, a 100% passthrough PBM, to
support this product offering.

When developing our premium requirements, we blend both manual rates and experience-based rates.
Capital Rx’s historical performance across its entire book of business is also factored into the
rating methodology.

How do refunds and credits work?

It depends on the performance of the plan. If your actual pharmacy costs are less than expected, you
may receive a refund or rate credit.

healthcare more accessible and affordable. Our teams are strengthened by diverse perspectives
converging to drive meaningful change within our industry.

Important Scam Alert

We’ve been made aware of employment scams fraudulently using Judi, Judi Health and Capital Rx’s
name. More specifically, there has been an increase in scam, spoof, and phishing attempts, and the
correspondence is not from Capital Rx HR/Recruiting professionals.

**Please note:** On average, the interview process can take one to three months from initial
submission to an offer, and we are only recruiting for roles listed on our website.

Financial transactions are never part of the interview process or job onboarding (i.e., you will
NEVER be asked to pay for something).

Emails from Capital Rx employees are from @cap-rx.com email addresses, not from free email accounts
like Yahoo, Hotmail, or Gmail.

For your cyber safety and security, if you suspect fraud, please do not respond to or interact with
messages claiming to be from someone at Capital Rx that include suspicious attachments or URLs or
request sensitive information (e.g., social security number, bank account information, etc.)

Its core offerings include a full-service health benefit management platform that integrates pharmacy, medical, dental, and vision benefits, alongside AI-powered care navigation solutions. Targeting self-funded employers, health plans, brokers, and consultants, Judi Health aims to enhance member care and improve health outcomes while ensuring cost control and financial transparency.

The hospital offers a wide range of services, including advanced transplant procedures, home healthcare, and comprehensive health check-ups, while focusing on personalized patient care and community health needs. With a commitment to innovation, Kumaran Hospitals recently launched an AI-based cath lab, further enhancing its capabilities in delivering exceptional healthcare.

in the year 1989 by Dr. S. Palaniswamy and Dr. P. Manimekalai to provide a wide spectrum of high

KUMARAN Hospital is committed to delivering high quality, personalized care to people of all ages
and in every stage of life.

## OUR VISION

KUMARAN Hospital is firmly centered on a strong tradition of community and patient-focused care. We
will be the first choice for hospital-related services in this area. We will differentiate from
other hospitals by continually evaluating the needs of the communities and patients we serve and

### Patient Experience

[ Malathy.R]

##### Malathy.R

S/o Pramodh Kashyap


The Service has been amazing, we never got the hospital feeling. Staff are very courteous and
helpful- have been undergoing treatment for the last year and the doctors, nurses, and staff
Provided the best service with a personal touch. Apart from round the call clock service they also
provide quality + tasty good
[ Jaganmohan]

##### Jaganmohan

s/o R P Sreenivasan


Hospital is maintained very well. Excellent service rendered by KH covid team. My father is alive
because of the efficiency of the doctors who were constantly monitoring him. ICU nurses took care of
him very well , they were a constant source of encouragement. Special thanks to Dr. Vijay
Chakaravarthy, Dr. Thirupathi and Dr. Praveenath for the outstanding services for monitoring my
father closely.
[ Githa Santhosham ]

##### Githa Santhosham

Attender, Daughter of Patient D. Santhosham


Food service team is excellent at the hospital. It tasted really good. Thanks to ward boys Karthick
and Gautham for their dedicated services. Thanks to Ms. Akhila (insurance) for helping in the
billing. Special mention and thanks to Dr. Joseph Navaseelan for monitoring my father and being a
pillar of support in difficult times. Mr. Vignesh was a good source of encouragement. I really
appreciate the entire team of doctors, nurses for their commitment. Nice gesture by the ER nursing
team and receptionists. Great services offered. Thankyou!

# About Us

### We have taken the leap and we are here to give our best.

## We’re Passionate. We’re Bold.

[Liberty Insurance]

A joint venture between Liberty Citystate holdings PTE Ltd, a group company of US Headquartered
Liberty Mutual Insurance Group, a leading multinational property and casualty group, and Liberty
Industries Limited, Liberty General Insurance commenced operations in 2013 with the aim of providing
comprehensive retail, commercial and industrial insurance solutions.

[Know More][2]

## Mission & Vision

**Mission:** To become the most admired and trusted upon **insurance companies in India**, by
keeping up with all the promises that we make to you, our customers, by providing the most
convenient dealing process, creating sustainable values, and empowering all our employees.

**Vision:** When you think **about Liberty General Insurance**, think of a company which aims to
help people live safer, with more security. To go beyond what other **health insurance companies**
or the **car insurance companies in India** might offer; to become an attentive and empathetic
insurer of choice for the citizens of the country.

[Know More][3]
[Mission & Vision Image]

## Awards & Recognitions

Liberty General Insurance since its launch in India has been instrumental at achieving highest
standards of customer service, technology implementation and industry contribution. The awards and
felicitations received by the organisation bears testimony of the above. Liberty General Insurance
has always kept customers at forefront of its focus. Its employees take immense pride in
contributing to the success of the company and their individual contributions create the desired
differentiation for the brand. Liberty General Insurance has been dedicated towards improving the
lives of individuals and entities with its uniquely designed insurance solutions and hence attempts
to create safer and secure environment for all. These effort paves way for many successful
innovations and targets efficiency in all possible means. We are here to create a responsible and
secure environment and hence also are dedicated to become India’s most admired general insurance
company through our achievements.

[Liberty Secure]

### Asia's Best Emerging Insurance Company Award 2021 | Sept 2021

[Employer of choice Image]

Liberty General Insurance has been awarded the "Employer of Choice" by Excellence Awards, at a
function held in Mumbai in 2014.

## Community Activity

We take pride in undertaking community activities as we at Liberty General Insurance consider it a
part of our civic responsibility towards the people. These activities encourage building
relationships both in the community as well as the work place.

[Know More][4]

## What We Do

[Car Insurance] [Buy Now][5]

### Car Insurance

As one of the top **car insurance companies in India**, we secure one of your most important
possessions. Mandatory by law, there are a lot of benefits which follow when you get your car
insured from Liberty General Insurance.

[Know More][6]
[Health Insurance] [Buy Now][7]

### Health Insurance

As a reputed **health insurance company**, we want you safeguard your health, and get a health
insurance cover that takes care of unexpected expenses at the times you require healthcare.

[Know More][8]
[Two Wheeler Insurance] [Buy Now][9]

### Two Wheeler Insurance

As a premier **two wheeler insurance company** in India, we offer both annual and multi-year
policies. Invest in two-wheeler insurance with Liberty General Insurance, and promptly secure your
asset on two wheels.

[Know More][10]
[Commercial Insurance] [Buy Now][11]

### Commercial Insurance

Insurance does not simply end at a personal level. If you own commercial property or if you have a
business, or so on, there are a lot of assets involved in it. It is best to stay on the safer side
and get yourself some commercial insurance.

[Know More][12]

## Board Of Directors

[Board of Directors Image]

The best part about the Liberty General Insurance Board of Directors is that each and every person
involved is dedicated to the mission of the company, to make long lasting and transparent
relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.

[Know More][13]

## Leadership Team

[Leadership Image]

Comprising of some of the best names in the industry, the leadership of Liberty General Insurance
has been placed in capable hands, sure to take the company to newer heights.

[Know More][14]

spirit, you are all Welcome Aboard!

# Company Profile

[LGI Branches Image]

### 110 Officesall over the India

Liberty General Insurance Ltd. is a joint venture between Liberty Citystate holdings PTE Ltd, a
group company of US Headquartered Liberty Mutual Insurance Group, a leading multinational property
and casualty group, Enam Securities, a privately owned and managed firm that makes long-term
investments in listed companies, as well as backs entrepreneurs building valuable private companies
and DP Jindal Group, an industrial conglomerate. Liberty India General Insurance commenced
operations in 2013 with the aim of providing comprehensive retail, commercial and industrial
insurance solutions. The company has an employee strength of 1200+ over a network of 110 offices in
95 cities across 29 states. Its partner network consists of about 5000+ hospitals and more than
4000+ auto service centres. The company offers health and personal accident insurance, car and
two-wheeler insurance, employee compensation insurance, commercial insurance, fire and engineering
insurance, marine insurance and other miscellaneous insurance products in India.

[Liberty Mutual Insurance]

## About Liberty Mutual Insurance Group

Liberty Mutual’s purpose is to help people embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow. Keeping
this promise means we are there when our policyholders throughout the world need us most. In
business since 1912, and headquartered in Boston, Mass., today we are a leading global insurer with
operations in 30 countries and economies around the world. We are the third largest property and
casualty insurer in the U.S. based on 2017 direct written premium data as reported by the National
Association of Insurance Commissioners. We also rank 68th on the Fortune 100 list of largest

annual consolidated revenue. We employ more than 50,000 people in over 800 offices throughout the
world. We offer a wide range of insurance products and services, including personal automobile,
homeowners, commercial multi-peril, property, general liability, commercial automobile, surety,
workers compensation, specialty lines, and reinsurance.

## About Enam Securities
## Tracing its legacy to 1984, Enam is a privately owned and managed firm that makes long-term
## investments in listed companies, as well as backs entrepreneurs building valuable private
## companies.
## Enam invests unlevered proprietary capital that keeps them free from constraints such as managing
## volatility, benchmark indexing and redemption pressures. This allows Enam to work closely with
## the owners and senior management of invested businesses, staying focused on long-term value
## creation. Over the past three decades, Enam have been fortunate to invest in some of India’s
## leading growth companies through various economic cycles.
## Enam has a value based and relationship oriented culture and investment philosophy. Employing
## fundamental, bottoms-up research to identify companies with sustainable competitive advantages
## and execution capabilities, Enam are extremely focused on the quality of management teams and
## governance frameworks of the companies they invest in.
## As an ethical investment firm, Enam does not invest in businesses that involve intoxication,
## gambling or anything that harms living creatures.

## About DP Jindal Group
## With its strong conviction, the D.P. Jindal Group business conglomerate has reserved its rightful
## position in the market as the largest Seamless & ERW steel pipes and tubes manufacturer of the
## country. Since its very inception, D.P. Jindal Group has pursued an unwavering path of growth
## despite national and international competition. Taking its futuristic approach forward, the Group
## has ventured into the power sector to generate renewable energies such as wind and solar,
## ensuring a cleaner and greener environment and now plan to venture in investment, finance,
## insurance and related areas.
## The D.P. Jindal Group has a highly experienced talented team, contemporary technology,
## efficiency-oriented environment and state-of-the-art production capacity to help foster further
## growth of the organization as well as the economy of the nation.

To help people live safer, with more security. To go beyond what any insurance company might offer
and become the attentive and empathetic insurer of choice for the country, ensuring commitments made
to our customers, being easy to deal with, empowering our employees, and creating sustainable value
for our promoters.

### We believe in

Long lasting customer relationships, maintaining transparency in all interactions, keeping them
fair, and supporting our customers throughout the journey, delivering on every promise made.

Long term relationships with partners, helping them grow with us.

Providing fulfilling and challenging careers to all of our employees, through empowerment and
personal growth.

## Our Identity & Values

A shared identity — belief, purpose, promise — and a single set of values will unite us in our
aspiration to become a top-three global property and casualty company.

Our identity and values are foundational and represent the core of who we are as a company.
Together, no matter what work we do or where we are located, we will share one understanding of what
we stand for, what we believe and what we expect from each other.

These words are the starting point for the work we do — not taglines. In the coming months, you will
learn more about how they connect with our existing work and start to see how they are infused in
communications.

[LGI Value Image]

## Our Identity

Why we do what we do

**Our Belief** - The driving convictions we have about people and the world
**We believe progress happens when people feel secure**

**Our Purpose** - The organizational North Star that defines and guides everything we do
**We exist to help people embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow**

**Our Promise** - The description of what we do and how we do it differently
**We promise protection for the unexpected, delivered with care**

## Our Values

How we do what we do

Our values — how we operate — reflect what makes us unique. They enable us to deliver on our promise
of Protection for the unexpected, delivered with care. Each value has equal weighting, and none is
more important than another.

**Act responsibly: Do what's right and follow through **
Acting responsibly means choosing to do the right thing and following through on our promises.

**Be open: Engage with all people and possibilities**
Be open inspires us to try something new even if it feels uncomfortable. Engaging with all people
and possibilities means embracing new interactions, perspectives and styles because they may lead to
untapped opportunities.

**Keep it simple: Be clear and transparent**
Keep it simple reminds us to simplify what we do. We should always be honest and strive to be clear
when we explain our decisions.

**Make things better: Be proactive and challenge the status quo**
Make things better is about improving and innovating in both big and small ways. Don’t be afraid to
think differently and challenge what’s always been done if there’s a better way.

**Put people first: Act with empathy, dignity and respect**
Putting people first means treating each other — employees, customers and those in our communities —
with empathy, dignity and respect. It is simply who we are.

#### How to register a COVID-19 claim?

[icon] [icon]

to get assistance on your COVID-19 claim, pls get in touch with us on 8657421821

#### Can I avail Cashless facility if tested COVID-19 positive?

[icon] [icon]

You can opt for the cashless facility if the hospital features in [LGI’s Network of cashless
hospital.][58] Similar to regular cashless claim, you can visit any Liberty General Network hospital
to avail pre-authorization. The claim will settled with the hospital once all the formalities are
completed. In case the hospital is not available in LGI network, you may opt for reimbursement
claim.

e. Self-attested copy of final bill with detailed breakup
f. Self-attested copy of pharmacy invoices supported by prescriptions, etc.

at 1800-266-5844 or email us at [health360@libertyinsurance.in.][59]

Claim Process

][61]

Liberty General Insurance offers quick and hassle free claim process through its own dedicated
in-house claims processing unit, Liberty Health 360.

Liberty Health 360, by its innovative and holistic approach towards health claims is determined to
assist you in the need of the hour.

**When To Register Claim?**

You should register your claim before at least 48 hours of planned admission. In case of emergency
hospitalization, please intimate us within 24 hours of admission.

**How do I register a claim?**
* Call us at : 18002665844 (08:00 AM to 08:00 PM all days a week)
* OR
* Mail us at : [Health360@LibertyInsurance.In][62]
* OR
* You may also send a written letter to our in house health claims unit Liberty Health 360 by post
or courier. next to you.

You will get contacted by our claims representative to guide you in further process for claim
adjudication.

**Cashless Claim Procedure**

You can avail cashless at any of Liberty’s network hospitals. You can also take the benefit of
cashless in non-network hospitals of Liberty General Insurance by means of our [CASHLESS
EVERYWHERE][63] facility.
* In case of pre-planned hospitalization, you need to intimate Liberty 48 hours prior to the
hospitalization, and for emergency hospitalization, you need to inform Liberty within 24 hours of
the occurrence.
* You may to choose any of the network hospital of Liberty for your cashless treatment. Please
[click here][64] to check your nearest network hospital.
* Then, you need to show your Mediclaim Card and ask for the cashless facility at bill
desk/insurance desk/TPA desk of the network hospital.
* Fill in the preauth form provided by the hospital with the required details. Submit the duly
filled and signed form at the hospital.
* Hospital should send the claim form and other medical documents on
[preauth@libertyinsurance.in][65]
* If no discrepancy is found, your claim will be given initial authorization within 1 hours of
receipt of complete information and the final discharge authorization will be given within 3 hours
of complete documents submission, as per the regulatory guidelines.
* Please find the link to claim form for registration of the claim: [bit.ly/libertyonlineclaim][66]

**Reimbursement Claim Procedure**

While Liberty General Insurance emphasizes to avail cashless facility by the insured, under
extraordinary circumstances if you choose to avail reimbursement facility, below is the procedure of
claim process.
* Once you get admitted to a hospital, you need to intimate Liberty within 2 days by calling on
[18002665844][67] or writing to [health360@libertyinsurance.in][68]
* Once you intimate the claim, you will get contacted by our claims representative to assist you in
filing the claim.
* You need to submit the claim documents within 30 days from the day of discharge or when you
receive the communication from claims representative on behalf of Liberty.
* If any further documents are required, the company will inform you about the same within 5 days of
submission and you need to submit those within the stipulated time.
* Once receipt of complete documents is done, Liberty will settle the claim within 15 days in line
with guidelines.

**Check Your Claim Status**
* Our retail customers can also avail the facility of [Self help][69] portal for checking the claim
status, uploading the claim discrepancy documents and downloading the health cards.
* All customers can also check the claim status and download the claim letters from [here][70]

Document List

][71]

**Here is an indicative list of documents required for all kinds of claims:**
* **In-patient Treatment/Daycare Procedures**
* Duly filled and signed Claim Form.
* Photocopy of ID card / Photocopy of current year policy.
* Original Detailed Discharge Summary / Day care summary from the hospital. Original consolidated
hospital bill with bill no. and break up of each Item, duly signed by the Insured.
* Original payment Receipt of the hospital bill with receipt number
* First Consultation letter and subsequent Prescriptions. Original bills, original payment
receipts and Reports for investigation supported by the note from the attending Medical
Practitioner/ Surgeon demanding such test.
* Surgeons certificate stating nature of Operation performed and Surgeons Bills and Receipts
* Attending Doctors/ Consultants/ Specialist's/ Anesthetist Bill and receipt and certificate
regarding same
* Original medicine bills and receipts with corresponding Prescriptions.
* Original invoice/bills for Implants (viz. Stent /PHS Mesh/ IOL etc.) with original payment
receipts.
* Hospital Registration Number and PAN details from the Hospital
* Doctors registration Number and Qualification from the doctor
* **Road Traffic Accident**
In addition to the In-patient Treatment documents:
* Copy of the First Information Report from Police Department / Copy of the Medico-Legal
Certificate.
* **In Non-Medico legal cases**
* Treating Doctor’s Certificate giving details of injuries (How, when and where injury sustained)
* **In Accidental Death cases**
* Copy of Post Mortem Report (if conducted) & Death Certificate
* **For Death Cases**
In addition to the In-patient Treatment documents:
* Original Death Summary from the hospital.
* Copy of the Death certificate from treating doctor or the hospital authority.
* Copy of the Legal heir certificate, if the claim is for the death of the principle insured.
* **Pre and Post-hospitalisation expenses**
* Duly filled and signed Claim Form.
* Photocopy of ID card / Photocopy of current year policy.
* Original Medicine bills, original payment receipt with prescriptions.
* Original Investigations bills, original payment receipt with prescriptions and report.
* Original Consultation bills, original payment receipt with prescription.
* Copy of the Discharge Summary of the main claim.
* **Ambulance Benefit**
* Duly filled and signed Claim Form.
* Photocopy of ID card / Photocopy of current year policy.
* Original Bill with Original Payment Receipt.
* Treating Doctor’s consultation prescription indicating Emergency Hospitalization.

### Frequently Asked Questions

#### Q1. Is it mandatory to have car insurance in India?

Answer. Yes, motor insurance is mandatory in India. You have to have at least a third-party car
insurance policy in India. It is a statutory requirement as per the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.

#### Q2. What are the types of car insurance policies?

Answer. At Liberty General, there are two types of car insurance:
**'Liability Only' or Third-Party Car Insurance: **Third-party insurance is essential and mandatory
for every car on the road. It only covers loss or damage suffered by a third party in case of an
accident in an insured vehicle. A 'Liability Only' policy does not cover any loss or damage to the
insured vehicle or the insured.
**Comprehensive Car Insurance:** This policy Includes loss or damage to the insured as well as the
third-party, in case of theft or accident.

#### Q3. What is Car insurance?

It is an insurance policy that protects car against damage or loss resulting from an accident, theft
or any other third-party liability. You can buy car insurance online or by visiting a nearest
Liberty General Insurance branch.

#### Q4. Is it required to renew four-wheeler insurance every year?

Answer. Yes. Insurers generally offer car insurance policies for 12 months. So you will have to
renew your car insurance every year. If you like, you can buy car insurance online. In this way, you
can get benefits like better premiums, minimal paperwork, and much more.

# About Us

### We have taken the leap and we are here to give our best.

## We’re Passionate. We’re Bold.

[Liberty Insurance]

A joint venture between Liberty Citystate holdings PTE Ltd, a group company of US Headquartered
Liberty Mutual Insurance Group, a leading multinational property and casualty group, and Liberty
Industries Limited, Liberty General Insurance commenced operations in 2013 with the aim of providing
comprehensive retail, commercial and industrial insurance solutions.

[Know More][2]

## Mission & Vision

**Mission:** To become the most admired and trusted upon **insurance companies in India**, by
keeping up with all the promises that we make to you, our customers, by providing the most
convenient dealing process, creating sustainable values, and empowering all our employees.

**Vision:** When you think **about Liberty General Insurance**, think of a company which aims to
help people live safer, with more security. To go beyond what other **health insurance companies**
or the **car insurance companies in India** might offer; to become an attentive and empathetic
insurer of choice for the citizens of the country.

[Know More][3]
[Mission & Vision Image]

## Awards & Recognitions

Liberty General Insurance since its launch in India has been instrumental at achieving highest
standards of customer service, technology implementation and industry contribution. The awards and
felicitations received by the organisation bears testimony of the above. Liberty General Insurance
has always kept customers at forefront of its focus. Its employees take immense pride in
contributing to the success of the company and their individual contributions create the desired
differentiation for the brand. Liberty General Insurance has been dedicated towards improving the
lives of individuals and entities with its uniquely designed insurance solutions and hence attempts
to create safer and secure environment for all. These effort paves way for many successful
innovations and targets efficiency in all possible means. We are here to create a responsible and
secure environment and hence also are dedicated to become India’s most admired general insurance
company through our achievements.

With a commitment to customer service and financial security, Licindia aims to support individuals and families in achieving their financial goals and protecting their futures.

With a focus on preventive care, Loophealth aims to create healthier, happier workplaces across India.

# All-Inclusive Turn-Key Solutions
# for Small to Big Practices

MAVA Care is a leading medical billing company that offers a wide range of medical billing services
in USA to help you increase your revenue. We incorporate up-to-date technology and current industry
trends in the processing of your claims. Practicing medicine is one of the most difficult careers.
Hence, we strive to assist our clients in receiving credible billing and coding services.

Our team of experts ensures that you receive quality medical billing services while ensuring that
all the medical billing is done following the law as set under HIPAA and other state and national
laws. You can reach out to our team today for a consultation and find out how we can assist you in
developing your practice to the next level.

[ Book a Free Consultation ][35]

## Services Offered by MAVA Care

As a medical billing company, we understand that each healthcare practice is unique. Our
comprehensive services enable you to improve the cash flow of your practice, increase patient
satisfaction, and efficiently streamline the operations.

### Medical Billing Services

We offer full medical billing services in USA such as claims processing, revenue cycle management,
and payment collection. Our skilled team indicates that insurance claims are processed accurately
and efficiently. We seek to maximize revenue while minimizing administrative costs for healthcare
providers.

[ Explore More   ][36]

### Medical Coding Services

We offer medical coding services to ensure accurate and efficient coding of medical procedures and
diagnoses. Our team adheres to the latest coding standards and guidelines. We help healthcare
providers improve reimbursement rates and reduce claim denials.

[ Explore More   ][37]

### Medical Credentialing Services

Our medical billing company provides medical credentialing services to verify and validate the
qualifications of healthcare providers. Our team handles the entire credentialing process, ensuring
compliance with industry standards. We streamline the approval process to enhance provider
efficiency and access to insurance networks.

[ Explore More   ][38]

### Virtual Medical Staff

We provide virtual medical staff services, offering skilled professionals for remote healthcare
support. Our virtual team includes physicians, nurses, and administrative staff who work efficiently
from any location. We enhance patient care and operational efficiency through flexible, remote
solutions.

[ Explore More   ][39]

### Patient Eligibility Verification

Our dedicated team of AR and eligibility verification focuses on simplifying the insurance process
so that your healthcare work runs smoothly. We’ll take your revenue management to the next level
through our unique verification process.

[ Explore More   ][40]

### Denial Management Services

We provide denial management services to address and resolve denied insurance claims. Our team
identifies the root causes of denials and implements corrective actions. We work to optimize
reimbursement rates and improve the overall claims process.

proficiency in positively impacting diverse recruitment domains.

[Bakiyalakshmi]

Bakiyalakshmi is a Service Delivery Manager at MBW RCM, where her 14 years of extensive experience
in medical coding shine through her exemplary leadership and management skills. Her keen eye for
detail and meticulous approach empower her to effectively manage 23 projects, with a particular
focus on efficiently resolving coding-related denials and appeals. She is also actively involved in
client communications and process coordination, leveraging her rich background from senior roles at
AdvantEdge Healthcare Solutions and Visionary RCM Infotech. In these positions, she not only led

stringent quality standards.

Previously, as a Manager of Operations, Bakiyalakshmi demonstrated her unwavering commitment to
excellence, skillfully overseeing 12 HIM projects and leading a dedicated team of 40 members. Her
academic credentials, including a degree in Physiotherapy (BPT) from Sree Balaji College of
Physiotherapy in Chennai with specializations in Orthopaedics, Neurology, and Cardiology, reflect
her deep-rooted dedication to the healthcare field. She further augmented her expertise with a
Diploma in Yoga Therapy from the University of Madras.

Bakiyalakshmi also holds a Six Sigma Black Belt certification, a testament to her dedication to
quality and continuous process improvement. This impressive combination of educational and
professional achievements exemplifies her multifaceted expertise and commitment to the healthcare
management industry.

expertise and commitment to continuous learning.

# A P Chinna Rose Manager – IT

Apr 13
Written By [MBW RCM][205]
[A+P+Chinna+Rose+Manager+%E2%80%93+IT]

Chinna has over 11 years of experience working in information technology focused on managing the
healthcare system environment. His expertise spans multiple domains of information technology and
security. Chinna believes that technology plays an important role in supporting organizational
processes and enhancing value. He possesses strong knowledge of budgeting, analytics, IT policies
and methodologies, flexibility, and a high level of customer service.

As an enterprise IT manager, Chinna is responsible for the following essential IT elements and
services - Asset lifecycle, Capacity monitoring/planning, Storage and Network utilization, Energy
consumption, Environmental issues, Facilities (including data center infrastructure management),
Physical and virtual assets management, Wireless and wired network operations, Security
(malware/virus protection), Mobile connectivity, and Maintenance/service update. Chinna provides
leadership to our IT team and is engaged in building a high-performance IT team by hiring, training,
and mentoring personnel. He has excellent organizational skills and can clearly convey information
to the entire Team to maintain a professional and collegial environment.

Prior to MBW RCM, Chinna is worked with companies such as Suntronics, and Visionary RCM Infotech. He
holds a bachelor’s degree in computer applications and is passionate about launching, building, and
sustaining technology infrastructure.

# Mike O’Connell - CFO

Apr 13
Written By [MBW RCM][205]

**Chief Financial Officer – MBW RCM **

Mike O’Connell is an accomplished financial executive and licensed CPA with deep expertise in
corporate finance, accounting operations, and strategic consulting. He currently serves as Chief
Financial Officer of MBW RCM, where he oversees financial strategy, compliance, and operational
performance to support sustainable growth in the healthcare revenue cycle management sector.

In addition to his role at MBW RCM, Michael is the Managing Partner of Moca CPA Group, a
Chicago-based firm providing outsourced accounting, tax consultation, and financial advisory
services to small and mid-sized businesses. Under his leadership, the firm has built a reputation
for delivering high-quality, cost-effective solutions that empower clients to scale effectively and
make data-driven decisions.

Previously, Michael held senior leadership roles at PBG Financial Services, serving as Partner and
Principal in Consulting Services, as well as working as a Fractional CFO and Controller for a range
of clients. His career also includes financial leadership at Howe Corporation, where he managed
global accounting operations and HR functions, and technical accounting roles with Vantage Specialty
Chemicals and ViskoTeepak, where he specialized in cost accounting, inventory management, and ERP
system optimization.

Michael brings a track record of success in full-cycle financial management, including P&L
ownership, audits, forecasting, tax compliance, internal controls, and process improvement. He is
recognized for building strong cross-functional teams, implementing innovative business intelligence
tools, and aligning finance with long-term organizational strategy.

Michael holds a Bachelor’s Degree in Economics and French from Davidson College and earned his CPA
certification through the College of Lake County. Fluent in French and skilled in leveraging ERP and
accounting technologies, he combines technical expertise with strategic vision to drive results.

# Satish Chandar (Melvin Miller), COO

Apr 11
Written By [MBW RCM][205]

An experienced Chief Operating Officer with a demonstrated history of working in the healthcare
industry for over 15 years, Satish, a.k.a. Melvin, has experience in team building, business
development, Healthcare Information Technology (HIT), revenue cycle process training, US. Health
Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), and Healthcare Management.

Satish (Melvin) joined MBW RCM in late 2010 when it was a small company of around ten people. He has
been part of the core team. Along with Vinod, he has helped grow the Company to over 300 employees
with multiple locations in Chennai and Bangalore and numerous clients (US medical billing companies
& EMR companies). Along with increasing the Company – he has personally grown from a Senior Manager
to the Chief Operating Officer & a Director in the Company.

Before joining MBW RCM, he worked with other healthcare outsourcing firms in India, including
Visionary RCM, Perot Systems, and Omega Healthcare. He started his RCM career as a caller (the
reason for the name Melvin, which has stayed on with our customers) and then transitioned into a
trainer and a manager before he moved to MBW.

Satish holds an engineering degree from Bharath University.

# Vinod Sankaran, Founder & CEO

Apr 10
Written By [MBW RCM][205]

Vinod is consumed by the need to eliminate inefficiencies from the healthcare sector. He brings over
15 years of experience in operations, financial analysis, strategy, growth, corporate development,
strategic planning, and marketing. At MBW RCM, he is involved in applying experience to optimize
revenue cycle process flows to improve our clients' profitability and performance.

As a member of the founding team of MBW RCM, Vinod has helped MBW RCM grow from 5 employees in 2010
to over 300 employees with multiple locations in Chennai and Bangalore, supporting numerous medical
billing companies, revenue cycle software providers, and EMR companies. As the CEO, he is tasked
with developing the company, new client acquisition, and applying new generation technology to drive
revenue and profitability.

Before starting MBW RCM, Vinod served as Director of Operations at One World United (OWU), an
organization offering healthcare solutions to corporations and individuals seeking medical treatment
abroad. Earlier, he worked as a Senior Financial Analyst for Sprint Telecom, where he was honored
with the "2005 Sprint Excellence Award" and earned the distinction of "Most Effective Employee."

The dual master's degrees in quantitative finance and Industrial Engineering that he received from
Oklahoma State University and extensive experience and achievements within the healthcare arena
allow him to offer demonstrable economic benefit, enhancing medical practices' revenue cycle
management and profitability.

# About MBW RCM

Founded by medical billers, coders, and healthcare subject matter experts,[ MBW RCM][206] is today
the trusted back office partner for some of the top medical billing companies, physician practices,
healthcare systems, revenue cycle, and EHR system providers in the United States. We have a team
of over 700 medical billers, coders, and accounts receivable professionals, who support over 40
customers, MBW RCM was conceptualized with the view of providing technology-enabled differentiation
to our clients. Over the years, we have not only acquired competence across multiple specialties,
we have also built an array of technology solutions to support our operations. These technologies
include:
* [Robotic Process Automation Solutions ][207]
* Workflow automation solution
* [Enabling technologies for people management and performance improvement][208]
* Analytical tools that shift focus to collections

### We lead with technology and automation to help you do more with your revenue cycle.

Consumed by our purpose of being **the most agile healthcare services company** in the world, we
have created a strong delivery model combining the knowledge of our people with market-leading
technologies to deliver great revenue cycle outcomes to our customers.

[Who We Serve- Healthcare Revenue Cycle]

### Who we serve

When you work with MBW RCM, you join over 50 clients who rely on us to achieve financial success
through their revenue cycle.

Our clients include medical billing companies, hospital billing service providers, focused physician
credentialing companies, medical coding companies, healthcare automation services providers,
physician practices and hospital systems.

We are focused on solving some of the most complex problems of the revenue cycle business by
applying technology and process automation.

[Revenue Cycle Services]

### How we add value

When you work with MBW RCM, you gain from the expertise of over 700 qualified revenue cycle
professionals who can not only provide your processing support but also industry leading advisory
services. We infuse energy into your revenue cycle by helping your streamline processes, providing
your great reporting, and ensure that you are able to collect every dollar possible. Our processes
are engineered to help you achieve compliance while achieving the financial outcomes you seek.

We apply technology to make the complex work of revenue cycle simple. enabling you to take an
integrated view into your revenue cycle.

[Revenue Cycle Partnership]

### Partner in Progress

We are your partner in progress. Working with MBW RCM, you get a dedicated account partner who is
focused on helping you improve your financial outcomes. Along with a strong, knowledgeable workforce
and process automation, you get the benefit of HIPAA compliance and best-in-class information
security.

Let us help you navigate through the challenges of your revenue cycle.

# About us

Healthcare is the second largest expenditure in the United States with totals of 4 Trillion dollars
in 2020. Healthcare institutions and providers average 10% of charges in accounts receivables
equating to about 400 Billion dollars at any given time.

These claims are the toughest to collect and most ultimately age past timely filing allowing for
tremendous insurance company windfalls. MedFeeTree helps providers recapture their portion of that
400 Billion and disperses it to the hard working providers that earned it and to the most qualified
and skilled medical billers that worked it.

The backbone of MedFeeTree is our team of highly skilled billing professionals. This team of revenue
cycle management experts maintains and supports the secure and confidential structure of this unique
application allowing it to service providers and billers with the highest degree of Privacy and
Security.

# About us

Healthcare is the second largest expenditure in the United States with totals of 4 Trillion dollars
in 2020. Healthcare institutions and providers average 10% of charges in accounts receivables
equating to about 400 Billion dollars at any given time.

These claims are the toughest to collect and most ultimately age past timely filing allowing for
tremendous insurance company windfalls. MedFeeTree helps providers recapture their portion of that
400 Billion and disperses it to the hard working providers that earned it and to the most qualified
and skilled medical billers that worked it.

The backbone of MedFeeTree is our team of highly skilled billing professionals. This team of revenue
cycle management experts maintains and supports the secure and confidential structure of this unique
application allowing it to service providers and billers with the highest degree of Privacy and
Security.

## **End-to-End Long-Term Care Insurance Claims Services for Faster Reimbursements**

Long-term care providers often face billing challenges due to changing insurance regulations,
extensive documentation requirements, denied claims, and delayed reimbursements. MedFeeTree provides
professional Long-Term Care Insurance Claims Processing Services designed to help healthcare
organizations improve cash flow while reducing the administrative burden associated with LTC
billing.

With our experience in **Long-Term Care billing services**, **LTC claims management**, **Medicare
and Medicaid claims processing**, and **insurance reimbursement support**, we help providers
maintain smoother billing operations and improve overall revenue cycle performance.

## Why Choose MedFeeTree?
* **End-to-End Long-Term Care Claims Management**
* **Accurate LTC Insurance Claims Submission**
* **HIPAA-Compliant Billing Processes**
* **Faster Insurance Verification & Claims Follow-Up**
* **Reduced Claim Denials & Billing Errors**
* **Experienced Long-Term Care Billing Specialists**

## Our Long-Term Care Insurance Claims Services

Long-term care insurance claims involve detailed documentation, policy verification, eligibility
reviews, and ongoing coordination throughout the reimbursement process. MedFeeTree provides
comprehensive Long-Term Care Insurance Claims Processing Services designed to help healthcare
providers, nursing facilities, assisted living centers, and home healthcare agencies manage claims
efficiently while supporting organized billing operations and reimbursement workflows.

✔ **Long-Term Care Claim Creation & Submission**
We prepare and submit long-term care insurance claims using structured workflows designed to support
accurate claim submissions, organized documentation handling, and efficient billing operations.

✔ **Eligibility & Policy Verification**
Our team verifies patient eligibility, insurance coverage details, and policy requirements before
claim submission to help reduce administrative issues and minimize claim processing delays.

✔ **Documentation & Care Record Review**
We review supporting documentation, patient care records, and claim-related information to help
maintain organized submissions aligned with payer requirements and long-term care billing standards.

✔ **Denial Management & Claim Reprocessing**
Denied or delayed long-term care claims are reviewed, corrected, and resubmitted through structured
workflows designed to improve claim resolution efficiency and reimbursement follow-up processes.

✔ **Accounts Receivable (AR) Follow-Up Services**
We monitor unpaid claims, track reimbursement status, and perform timely follow-up activities to
support better revenue cycle visibility and organized claims management operations.

✔ **Payment Posting & Claim Status Tracking**
Our team helps manage payment posting, claim status monitoring, and reimbursement tracking to
support accurate financial reporting and improved operational transparency throughout the billing
cycle.

## **Benefits of Outsourcing Long-Term Care Insurance Claims to MedFeeTree**

At MedFeeTree, we provide specialized Long-Term Care Insurance Claims Services tailored to the
operational needs of long-term care providers. Our goal is to simplify billing workflows, improve
reimbursement timelines, and reduce the stress associated with complex insurance claims management.

**Improved Revenue Collection Efficiency**

Accurate long-term care insurance claims processing and proactive reimbursement follow-up play an
important role in improving overall revenue collection performance. Our structured billing workflows
help healthcare providers reduce revenue leakage caused by denied, delayed, or incomplete claims
while supporting more organized reimbursement management processes.

Reduced Administrative Burden

Managing long-term care billing internally can place significant pressure on administrative teams,
nursing staff, and operational resources. Outsourcing LTC insurance claims processing to MedFeeTree
helps reduce the workload associated with billing management, insurance communication, documentation
handling, and reimbursement follow-up activities.

**Lower Operational Cost**

Maintaining an in-house billing department often involves expenses related to staffing, ongoing
training, billing software systems, compliance management, and operational oversight. Outsourcing
LTC claims processing services can help organizations reduce these operational costs while gaining
access to experienced billing support and established workflow management systems.

**Improved Claim Accuracy**

Accurate coding, complete documentation, and organized claim preparation are essential for efficient
long-term care insurance billing operations. Our experienced billing specialists review claims
carefully to help ensure submissions align with payer-specific guidelines, documentation
requirements, and billing standards.

**Faster Payment Cycles**

Delayed claim submissions and inconsistent follow-up processes can negatively impact reimbursement
timelines and cash flow management. Our streamlined billing workflows, timely claim submissions, and
continuous reimbursement tracking help support faster payment cycles and more organized financial
operations.

**Enhanced Compliance & Reduced Billing Errors**

Long-term care billing operations require ongoing attention to HIPAA compliance, payer regulations,
and evolving billing requirements. MedFeeTree follows compliance-focused workflows and
industry-standard billing practices designed to support secure claim handling, accurate
documentation management, and organized operational procedures.

**Access to LTC Billing Expertise**

Managing complex long-term care insurance claims often requires specialized billing knowledge and
operational experience. By partnering with MedFeeTree, healthcare organizations gain access to
experienced LTC billing professionals familiar with payer workflows, reimbursement processes, and
long-term care documentation requirements.

**Better Financial Visibility & Reporting**

Clear reporting and organized claim tracking are important for maintaining control over billing
operations and reimbursement performance. We provide transparent reporting, reimbursement updates,
and claim activity visibility to help facilities monitor billing performance and financial health
more effectively.

**Scalable Billing Solutions**

Healthcare facilities often experience changing patient volumes, evolving operational needs, and
varying billing demands. Our flexible LTC billing services are designed to scale according to your
facility size, patient population, claim volume, and organizational requirements. Whether supporting
a single facility or a growing healthcare network, our scalable billing solutions help maintain
efficient claims processing operations and consistent reimbursement management workflows.

## **Our Medicare Claims Processing Services**

Medicare billing follows strict CMS rules, payer-specific edits, and detailed documentation
standards that differ from commercial insurance. In-house teams often struggle with delayed
submissions, incomplete records, and unresolved denials that affect cash flow. MedFeeTree’s
outsourced Medicare claims processing services manage each stage with accuracy, consistency, and
accountability

**Medicare Claim Preparation and Coding Review**

Before submission, our team reviews ICD-10 diagnosis codes, CPT procedure codes, modifiers, Advance
Beneficiary Notice (ABN) requirements, and place-of-service details. We also validate medical
necessity documentation against Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) and National Coverage
Determinations (NCDs), ensuring every claim aligns with Medicare guidelines. This reduces front-end
rejections, improves claim accuracy, and supports smoother acceptance at the Medicare Administrative
Contractor (MAC) level.

**Electronic Claims Submission and Clearinghouse Management**

Claims are submitted electronically through approved clearinghouses using Medicare 837P and 837I
transaction standards. We monitor acknowledgments, track claim status via MAC portals, and resolve
clearinghouse rejections promptly. Each claim is also tracked for timely filing compliance,
preventing delays and ensuring submissions move efficiently through the adjudication process without
backlog accumulation.

**Medicare Denial Management and Appeals**

Medicare denials include reason and remark codes that require structured handling. Our team performs
root cause analysis, corrects documentation or coding issues, and resubmits claims with supporting
records. For complex cases, we prepare redetermination requests and Qualified Independent
Contractors (QIC) reconsiderations, following Medicare’s multi-level appeal process to maximize
recovery of eligible reimbursements.

**Secondary and Crossover Claim Processing**

For Medicare-primary patients with secondary insurance or Medigap coverage, we manage coordination
of benefits accurately. This includes crossover claim submission, verification of supplemental payer
details, and resolution of payment discrepancies. Our process ensures the full patient liability is
addressed and prevents revenue leakage due to incomplete secondary reimbursements.

**Medicare Claims Billing and Follow-Up Services**

We conduct regular AR reviews, track pending claims, and follow up with MAC representatives when
processing delays occur. Each aged claim is actively pursued until payment, adjustment, or formal
closure. This structured follow-up prevents revenue loss, reduces aging balances, and improves
overall reimbursement consistency across the billing cycle.

**Medicare Claims Processing for Small Practices**

Smaller practices often lack dedicated billing teams for Medicare complexities. Our service provides
end-to-end support, including coding validation, submission, denial handling, and follow-up. This
ensures accurate processing, faster reimbursements, and reduced administrative burden without
requiring in-house billing staff or additional operational overhead.
