# About us

## Our mission is global access to quality healthcare

Medigo is your insurance partner for network access, industry know-how & cost containment,
award-winning customer service, and fluid solutions

#### Access to our global provider network

Our network includes leading providers in five continents so we can support insurers with global
provider access, preferential rates, and SMOs

#### Award-winning customer service

Our award-winning team is experienced managing claims globally and speaks 15+ languages including
Mandarin, Arabic & Russian

#### Industry know-how and cost containment

In-house medical team with complex billing expertise, global procedure cost database, and a global
network with preferential rates and fixed price packages

#### Fluid solutions tailored to our partners

We may not do everything in-house but we do *manage* it all. We make life easier for insurance
companies by connecting the dots

## Our history

Medigo launched in 2013 as a medical travel platform with the slogan, **‘Medical Travel Made
Simple’. **

By 2016 our website was getting over 350,000 visits a month. In 2017, Medigo was on the front page
of The Telegraph in the UK. Between 2013 and 2020, we arranged thousands of treatments ranging from
simple health check-ups to breakthrough cancer therapies.

In 2017, we expanded into providing TPA services. In 2020, we decided to shut down our medical
travel platform and focus solely on business services, leveraging our valuable global network and
know-how.

It’s Time to Rethink What’s Possible

# Your Partner in
# Managing the
# Total Cost of Care

We offer a comprehensive portfolio of healthcare administrative technology products and services
that help health plans innovate, grow, and provide better healthcare experiences for those they
serve.

[iStock-1342134434.png]

## 40 Years of Proven Health Plan Expertise

Healthcare administration is complex. With industry changes coming fast, it’s more challenging than
ever. As it becomes harder to compete, your plan is at risk of being left behind.

NASCO sits at the operational core of health plans. For 40 years, we’ve powered the administrative
backbone for some of the most complex payer environments in the country.

We help connect critical pieces of the healthcare ecosystem and improve essential healthcare
administrative functions across the front, middle, and back-office including claims processing,
billing, benefits, non-claims-based reimbursement, and member servicing. With our holistic suite of
technology and services, we help health plans drive innovation, affordability, and better member
experiences.

[NASCO Logo icon]

## How We Enable Health Plans

We help Blues and other regional health plans modernize operations, reduce complexity, and improve
member services

### Grow

membership with innovative products

### Engage

members proactively and optimally

### Administer

complex benefits efficiently and at scale

### Bill

### Measure

## Our Solutions

A comprehensive suite of innovative products and services that meet health plans where they are and
scale with their evolving needs.

## 40 Years of Proven Health Plan Expertise

Healthcare administration is complex. With industry changes coming fast, it’s more challenging than
ever. As it becomes harder to compete, your plan is at risk of being left behind.

NASCO sits at the operational core of health plans. For 40 years, we’ve powered the administrative
backbone for some of the most complex payer environments in the country.

We help connect critical pieces of the healthcare ecosystem and improve essential healthcare
administrative functions across the front, middle, and back-office including claims processing,
billing, benefits, non-claims-based reimbursement, and member servicing. With our holistic suite of
technology and services, we help health plans drive innovation, affordability, and better member
experiences.

NABH

NABH (National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers) is an organization in India that sets standards for quality healthcare services in various healthcare settings such as hospitals, clinics, and nursing homes. NABH accreditation is the recognition that a healthcare facility has met these quality standards and is committed to providing safe, effective, and patient-centered care.

A NABH consultant is a professional who provides guidance and assistance to healthcare facilities seeking NABH accreditation. Their role is to help healthcare facilities understand the NABH standards and requirements, assess their current practices and procedures, identify areas for improvement, and develop and implement a plan to meet the NABH standards.

TPA Desk Management

Supervising and managing a team of claims processors and administrators to ensure timely and accurate processing of health insurance claims.
Reviewing and verifying the accuracy and completeness of claim submissions, including medical records, bills, and other supporting documents.
Adjudicating claims by established policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and contractual obligations.
Negotiating with healthcare providers to resolve disputed claims, including fees and reimbursement amounts.
Analyzing claim data and identifying trends or patterns that may indicate fraudulent or abusive billing practices.
Developing and implementing strategies to improve claims processing efficiency and accuracy, and reduce claims costs.
Collaborating with other departments, such as customer service, network management, and medical management, to ensure seamless and coordinated delivery of health benefits to members.

Benefit to Hospitals

Cashless processing eliminates the need for manual cash handling and associated administrative tasks, such as counting, reconciling, and depositing cash. This leads to increased operational efficiency, as hospital staff can focus on core responsibilities instead of cash management.

Handling cash involves various costs, including cashiers’ wages, secure storage facilities, armored transportation, and the risk of theft or loss. By adopting cashless processing, hospitals can reduce or eliminate these expenses, resulting in significant cost savings over time.

Medi Claim Bill Review Systems

Healthcare Industry Medical Bill Review Systems services involve the evaluation and analysis of medical bills to ensure accuracy, appropriateness, and compliance with regulations. These systems play a crucial role in reducing healthcare costs, minimizing billing errors, and optimizing reimbursement processes.

Overall, Medical Bill Review Systems services are vital in the healthcare
industry to ensure accurate billing, optimize reimbursements, and control costs. They contribute to improved financial outcomes, regulatory compliance, and enhanced patient care by minimizing billing errors, detecting fraud, and providing valuable insights for decision-making.

Medical Claims Processing Streamlined for Quick Results

Medical Billing Experts has been helping healthcare providers increase revenue by organizing their medical claims processes. Our strength lies in our commitment to accuracy, efficiency and flexibility, which we incorporate across the entire gamut of healthcare claims processing service.

We have developed a robust model for managing claims operations for our clients. These models have evolved through our decade long experience in claims processing and offer our clients the most optimal way to process claims. Some of these models are based on categories of rejected claims, created by special teams assigned with the task of monitoring, understanding and pursuing rejected claims.

We also provide our clients with complete control over rejected claims. As one of the leading medical claims processing companies in the industry, our clients can check how the claim is progressing in real time and analyze the efficiency of the various stages of the medical claims management process.

NABH

NABH (National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers) is an organization in India that sets standards for quality healthcare services in various healthcare settings such as hospitals, clinics, and nursing homes. NABH accreditation is the recognition that a healthcare facility has met these quality standards and is committed to providing safe, effective, and patient-centered care.

A NABH consultant is a professional who provides guidance and assistance to healthcare facilities seeking NABH accreditation. Their role is to help healthcare facilities understand the NABH standards and requirements, assess their current practices and procedures, identify areas for improvement, and develop and implement a plan to meet the NABH standards.

TPA Desk Management

Supervising and managing a team of claims processors and administrators to ensure timely and accurate processing of health insurance claims.
Reviewing and verifying the accuracy and completeness of claim submissions, including medical records, bills, and other supporting documents.
Adjudicating claims by established policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and contractual obligations.
Negotiating with healthcare providers to resolve disputed claims, including fees and reimbursement amounts.
Analyzing claim data and identifying trends or patterns that may indicate fraudulent or abusive billing practices.
Developing and implementing strategies to improve claims processing efficiency and accuracy, and reduce claims costs.
Collaborating with other departments, such as customer service, network management, and medical management, to ensure seamless and coordinated delivery of health benefits to members.

Benefit to Hospitals

Cashless processing eliminates the need for manual cash handling and associated administrative tasks, such as counting, reconciling, and depositing cash. This leads to increased operational efficiency, as hospital staff can focus on core responsibilities instead of cash management.

Handling cash involves various costs, including cashiers’ wages, secure storage facilities, armored transportation, and the risk of theft or loss. By adopting cashless processing, hospitals can reduce or eliminate these expenses, resulting in significant cost savings over time.

Healthcare Industry Medical Bill Review Systems services involve the evaluation and analysis of medical bills to ensure accuracy, appropriateness, and compliance with regulations. These systems play a crucial role in reducing healthcare costs, minimizing billing errors, and optimizing reimbursement processes.

Overall, Medical Bill Review Systems services are vital in the healthcare
industry to ensure accurate billing, optimize reimbursements, and control costs. They contribute to improved financial outcomes, regulatory compliance, and enhanced patient care by minimizing billing errors, detecting fraud, and providing valuable insights for decision-making.

Medical Billing Experts has been helping healthcare providers increase revenue by organizing their medical claims processes. Our strength lies in our commitment to accuracy, efficiency and flexibility, which we incorporate across the entire gamut of healthcare claims processing service.

We have developed a robust model for managing claims operations for our clients. These models have evolved through our decade long experience in claims processing and offer our clients the most optimal way to process claims. We also provide our clients with complete control over rejected claims. OASIS entered the healthcare industry to provide back-office services to payers and providers.

Insurance TPA (Third Party Administration) services typically involve the management of health
insurance claims and related administrative tasks. By outsourcing these tasks to a specialized
provider, hospitals can free up their resources to focus on providing high-quality care to patients.
Additionally, TPA services can help hospitals ensure that claims are processed efficiently and
accurately, reducing the risk of errors and delays that can impact patient care.

Overall, it’s clear that your experience in the insurance industry has given you valuable insights
into how hospitals and healthcare providers can work with TPAs to improve the quality of care they
provide.

In addition, your understanding of the insurance industry and how it works can help hospitals to
navigate the complex world of insurance cashless and reimbursement claims. This can be especially
helpful in ensuring that hospitals receive appropriate compensation for the care they provide.

# Prolific Studio - Top-Rated Animation Production CompanyProlific Studio - Top-Rated Animation
# Production Company

We specialize in creating engaging 2D and 3D animations that help businesses achieve their marketing
and branding objectives. Whether you’re a small local business or a large conglomerate, we’re here
to make your vision in to reality!

Contact Us Today!

## Who We AreWho We Are

Prolific Studio is one of the leading animation studios with studios across the globe. We specialize
in providing the best animation solutions that appeal to viewers worldwide. Our experienced team of
creatives and animators put their imaginative, inventive, and dynamic skills into each project to
ensure high-quality animations that deliver results for brands.

#### Where Imagination Meets Innovation

We develop animations that fulfill the project’s objectives. We turn ideas into animated
masterpieces using advanced tools and the highest standards.

[two-characters Image]

## Our 2D & 3D Animation ServicesOur 2D & 3D Animation Services

Gaming Trailer Cel Animation Motion Graphics Cartoon Animation Logo Animation

We produce exciting gameplay trailers that highlight your characters and story. With stunning
graphics, captivating sounds, and smooth transitions, we build excitement that makes it hard to
resist wanting to play the game.

## Industries We Serve

We have combined art and experience to create flawless 2D and 3D animation services irrespective of
the sector we work in. Entertainment and games, education and advertising, healthcare, and
e-commerce—whatever your field, our visuals are designed to speak directly to your target audience.

We do not believe in a one-fits-all solution. With experience across multiple industries we
customize all animations based on detailed audience personas and industry trends. With Prolific
Studio by your side you can rest assured you will not receive any generic content.

# Case STUDYCase STUDY

## Shock Analog-Digital GA-2100 Series

A bold 3D animation showcases the G-SHOCK GA-2100’s slim, rugged design and key features like shock
and water resistance. Sleek visuals, crisp lighting and smooth transitions reflect its modern,
minimal aesthetic for digital platforms.

[Explore Case Study][50][Service Details][51]

## N-Seam Saver

A fun 3D animated ad for N-Seam Saver follows a teen and her mom struggling with shrunken jeans
until a superhero arrives with the fix. Humor, exaggerated expressions and smooth animation make the

# Case Study for: Prolific Studio | G-Shock Analog-Digital GA-2100 SeriesCase Study for: Prolific
# Studio | G-Shock Analog-Digital GA-2100 Series

Prolific Studio produced a bold, high impact 3D animation for the G-SHOCK GA-2100 Series, showcasing
the watch’s slim profile, rugged design and signature analog digital build. With cinematic camera
moves, crisp lighting and smooth transitions, the animation emphasizes features like shock
resistance, 200 meter water resistance and the carbon core guard structure. The visual language was
kept sleek and minimal to reflect the GA-2100’s bold aesthetic, making it ideal for digital
platforms and social rollouts.

### Project Objective

To create a modern, visually powerful 3D animation that highlights the durability and style of the
GA-2100 Series in a way that resonates with today’s audience.

### Target Audience

Urban trendsetters, active lifestyle consumers and G-SHOCK fans who appreciate minimalist design
with maximum performance in rugged accessories.

### Our Streamlined Approach

We built a clean visual sequence focused on product movement, reflective lighting, and rhythm-driven
cuts, matched with a contemporary soundtrack to enhance viewer engagement.

## Challenges FacedChallenges Faced

One major challenge was ensuring the slim design of the GA-2100 looked strong and durable, not
fragile. Capturing the right textures for resin, glass, and carbon core elements required custom
shading and material tuning. We also had to showcase water resistance and shock durability without
literal effects like splashes or collisions, keeping the focus on elegance and function. Maintaining
visual consistency across multiple shots without revealing repetitive angles took careful planning.

[Challenges Image]
[Challenges Image]

## SolutionsSolutions

Our team developed a precise 3D model using manufacturer-provided references and focused on
cinematic lighting to bring out every contour and surface. We choreographed product rotations and
transitions to match the beat of the soundtrack, giving the piece a dynamic, premium feel. Carefully
timed cuts and slow zooms highlighted key features without cluttering the frame. The result was a
slick, high-performance animation that reflects both the toughness and minimalism of the G-SHOCK
brand.

## Results and SuccessResults and Success

The animation became a key asset in G-SHOCK’s digital launch strategy, performing exceptionally well
across Instagram, YouTube, and targeted ad placements. It drew attention from both long-time fans
and first-time viewers, increasing product click-through rates and boosting watchlist adds across
e-commerce platforms. Retail partners used the video in-store and online to elevate product
presentation. The client highlighted the animation as a perfect match for the GA-2100’s sleek yet
rugged identity.

# Case Study for: Prolific Studio | N-Seam SaverCase Study for: Prolific Studio | N-Seam Saver

Prolific Studio created a fun, upbeat 3D animated commercial for N-Seam Saver, blending humor and
relatability with sleek product integration. The story follows a teen girl and her mom as they
comically wrestle with a pair of shrunken jeans. Just when all hope seems lost, a superhero named
Super Seam Saver bursts onto the scene with the ultimate solution: the N-Seam Saver Super Stretch
Hangers. Through playful animation, smooth transitions, and exaggerated expressions, the spot
highlights the product’s benefit in a way that is entertaining and easy to remember.

### Project Objective

To promote N-Seam Saver hangers using an engaging 3D animated ad that entertains while clearly
demonstrating the product’s function and value.

### Target Audience

Parents, teens and anyone frustrated by clothing shrinkage, especially consumers searching for
simple and effective laundry or wardrobe solutions

### Our Streamlined Approach

We used a character driven narrative supported by stylized 3D animation, snappy timing and product
focused visuals to balance entertainment with product clarity.

## Challenges FacedChallenges Faced

The main challenge was finding the right balance between humor and product messaging. Characters had
to feel relatable, while still fitting a cartoonish tone that enhanced comedy. The jeans-stretching
sequence needed careful rigging and physics to exaggerate struggle without breaking realism.
Introducing the product as a hero moment without it feeling cheesy or forced also required careful
direction. Animating cloth interaction and dynamic expressions while keeping the timing tight pushed
both animation and rendering teams creatively.

[Challenges Image]
[Challenges Image]

## SolutionsSolutions

We created custom rigs for the jeans to simulate tension and elasticity while ensuring character
motion remained fluid. Using classic squash and stretch animation principles, we exaggerated key
poses to sell comedic beats. Super Seam Saver’s entrance was enhanced with bold lighting and
dramatic camera moves to emphasize her role as the problem solver. The hanger demonstration used
close up cuts and stylized overlays to highlight product functionality without slowing the
narrative. The final piece delivered laughs, clarity and strong brand presence.

## Results and SuccessResults and Success

The commercial gained strong traction across social media and product landing pages, helping boost
both brand awareness and engagement. N-Seam Saver reported an increase in direct traffic and time
spent on product pages post-launch. Viewers praised the ad for being both useful and entertaining,
with high replay value. Retailers also noted the video’s effectiveness in visually communicating the
product’s benefit at point-of-sale displays and promotional rollouts.

# Academy

Prolific Studio partnered with the creators of Dreamwood Academy to produce a bold, fast-paced 2D
animated series set in a magical world of mayhem. With vibrant visuals and expressive characters,
the show blends comedy, heart, and adventure into one whimsical ride. Our animation team developed
fluid movement, exaggerated expressions and sharp scene transitions to match the energy of each
episode. From enchanted classroom chaos to over the top magical battles, every moment was designed
to keep young viewers entertained and emotionally connected.

### Project Objective

To create a visually dynamic 2D animated series that balances comedy, fantasy, and character-driven
storytelling for kids and pre-teens.

### Target Audience

Children aged 8-14, parents looking for fun, age appropriate content, and streaming platforms
focused on original animated series for younger audiences.

### Our Streamlined Approach

We began with script and storyboard collaboration, then moved into character rigging and stylized
keyframe animation, with fast feedback loops to maintain energy and consistency.

## Challenges FacedChallenges Faced

One of the biggest challenges was achieving smooth, exaggerated character motion within tight
episode timelines. The series required a high level of comedic timing and physical expression, which
meant facial rigs and limb controls had to be flexible and reusable. Backgrounds had to be
imaginative yet readable and transitions needed to flow quickly between magical spells, action gags,
and emotional beats. Maintaining consistency across episodes, while working with evolving scripts
and character arcs, required careful coordination between art and animation teams.

[Challenges Image]
[Challenges Image]

## SolutionsSolutions

Our team developed a modular animation rig system for quick turnarounds while preserving expressive
range. We used Toon Boom Harmony for advanced frame control and After Effects for stylized
transitions. Color keys and mood boards ensured background consistency, and comedic beats were
fine-tuned in animatics before production. Regular creative check-ins helped us align with the
show’s voice and pacing, allowing for playful improvisation without sacrificing production flow. The
result was a bright, fast-moving series that delighted both kids and distributors.

## Results and SuccessResults and Success

Dreamwood Academy was picked up for wider distribution and praised for its vibrant animation style
and quick humor. Early screenings tested strongly with kids, and network partners noted its
rewatchability and strong character appeal. The series gained momentum across streaming platforms,
helping the creators secure additional episode orders and merch interest. Prolific Studio’s
animation work was highlighted in press kits and marketing assets as a key visual strength of the
show.

# Case Study for: Prolific Studio | Avalon: Dawn Rises - Lords | Animus InteractiveCase Study for:
# Prolific Studio | Avalon: Dawn Rises - Lords | Animus Interactive

Prolific Studio partnered with Animus Interactive to produce a high intensity 3D animated trailer
for Avalon: Dawn Rises – Lords. Set in a brutal, Viking inspired world, the trailer highlights the
game’s themes of rage, conquest, and survival. With cinematic camera work, visceral character
moments, and sweeping battlefield sequences, the trailer delivers an immersive experience. One of
the most powerful scenes features a battle scarred warlord slamming his fist in fury, symbolizing
the raw power and emotion that define the game’s universe.

### Project Objective

To create a cinematic 3D trailer that builds excitement and emotional impact around the game’s
world, characters, and battle mechanics.

### Target Audience

Hardcore strategy gamers, Viking and medieval warfare fans, and players who appreciate story rich,
visually intense gaming experiences.

### Our Streamlined Approach

We used a cinematic first 3D animation workflow, focusing early on storyboards, character staging,
and mood lighting while using real time previews for efficient feedback and iteration.

## Challenges FacedChallenges Faced

The biggest challenge was animating a realistic but stylized warlord whose expressions had to convey
complex emotions without dialogue. Creating large scale battle scenes with dozens of moving
soldiers, environmental effects, and fire simulations was demanding on both render times and system
performance. Maintaining visual consistency between the game’s look and the cinematic feel also
required tight coordination with the client’s in game assets and lore.

[Challenges Image]
[Challenges Image]

## SolutionsSolutions

We captured raw motion performance using mocap and enhanced key poses with hand animation to amplify
emotion and weight. Redshift was used to achieve cinematic lighting, while procedural crowd systems
helped us animate large battlefield scenes without compromising render speed. Camera movements were
mapped using previs to preserve narrative energy. The result was a cohesive 3D trailer that looked
and felt like a premium AAA game teaser, aligning perfectly with Animus Interactive’s vision.

## Results and SuccessResults and Success

The trailer generated buzz among early-access players and was used as the flagship asset during the
game’s pre-launch campaign. Animus Interactive reported a notable spike in social engagement and
wishlist additions following its release. The animation was praised for its cinematic quality,
helping the studio position Avalon: Dawn Rises – Lords as a visually rich, high-stakes strategy
game. It also received strong reactions at industry showcases and boosted investor confidence ahead
of the next development phase.

# Case Study for: Prolific Studio | Borlaug 3D AnimationCase Study for: Prolific Studio | Borlaug 3D
# Animation

Prolific Studio partnered with Borlaug to create a stylized 3D animated video that raises awareness
about climate and facility control in shared environments. The story follows two filthy characters
who sneak into a bar and spread animated germs and fungal growth, visually representing poor climate
conditions. The chaos transitions into a man waking from a nightmare and checking his tablet,
reassured by Borlaug’s system maintaining stable conditions. Through humor and exaggerated visual
storytelling, the video creatively communicates the importance of air quality and environmental
monitoring in a way that’s both engaging and easy to understand.

### Project Objective

To educate viewers on the role of climate control systems in maintaining clean, safe environments
using a fun, animated short that leaves a memorable impression.

### Target Audience

Facility managers, tech savvy property owners, commercial building stakeholders, and environmental
consultants who seek smarter solutions for air quality and climate regulation.

### Our Streamlined Approach

We combined exaggerated character animation with clean visual storytelling, built a humorous but
relatable storyline, and used detailed simulation effects to highlight the difference Borlaug’s
systems make..

## Challenges FacedChallenges Faced

One key challenge was designing characters that looked gross enough to represent contamination, yet
humorous enough to be likable. Simulating animated fungal spread and germ particles without
overloading render times also required careful optimization. We needed to create smooth visual
transitions from a chaotic bar scene to a calm bedroom environment, while conveying the shift in
mood and tone. Finally, the in app UI had to look futuristic, functional and believable! all within
a few seconds of screen time.

[Challenges Image]
[Challenges Image]

## SolutionsSolutions

Our design team created custom shaders and rigging for the germ characters, ensuring a balance of
humor and detail. We used Blender’s geometry nodes and VFX compositing to simulate slime, fungal
growth, and airborne particles efficiently. The lighting team crafted a smooth, cinematic transition
from party to peaceful night using Redshift’s dynamic lighting tools. We also designed a tablet
interface from scratch and animated it with subtle, readable micro interactions to communicate
system status instantly. Each scene was rendered in layers for faster compositing and real time
flexibility during post production.

## Results and SuccessResults and Success

The animation was featured in Borlaug’s internal training modules and public awareness campaigns,
where it immediately stood out for its originality and clarity. It significantly increased viewer
retention compared to traditional explainers and was praised for making a technical topic feel fun
and accessible. The client reported stronger engagement during presentations and workshops, and the
video became a go-to tool for showcasing Borlaug’s value proposition in a memorable way.

with you through each phase, making room for feedback while staying efficient. From concept to
polished final cut, we make sure every frame delivers emotion, style, and purpose.

### Project Objective

To bring a true love story to life through cinematic 3D animation, capturing the heartfelt journey
of Gregg and Lise — from an unexpected bus encounter to a deep and lasting connection formed during
their college years in Hawai. The goal was to preserve the emotional essence of their story and
present it in a warm, visual narrative.

### Target Audience

Young adults, animation lovers, romantic drama fans, and anyone who appreciates real-life stories
filled with emotion and nostalgia. The film also served as a personal keepsake for Gregg Fox, former
founder of Fox Racing.

### Our Streamlined Approach

We kept things simple and focused! Starting with a clear understanding of your vision, then moving
into storyboarding, design and expressive animation. Our team works closely with you through each
phase, making room for feedback while staying efficient. From concept to polished final cut, we make
sure every frame delivers emotion, style, and purpose.

## Challenges FacedChallenges Faced

Character Personality: The characters needed to feel grounded and real. Gregg had to come across as
observant and kind, while Lise needed a balance of vulnerability and strength. Their chemistry had
to feel authentic without feeling overly scripted or exaggerated. Realism and Fluidity: The
animation focused on small, emotionally rich moments — the glance on the bus, a party filled with
laughter, and the quiet intensity of a heartfelt goodbye. Achieving natural facial expressions and
believable body movement was crucial for emotional impact. Technical Constraints: We were working
within a limited runtime and a modest budget while aiming for high-quality 3D visuals. The challenge
was to maintain cinematic polish without sacrificing detail or storytelling clarity.

[Challenges Image]
[Challenges Image]

## SolutionsSolutions

In-depth Character Study: Our team collaborated closely with Gregg to understand the tone and
emotional beats of the story. His personal insights helped us design character models, clothing
styles, and environments that felt true to the early 2000s Hawai college scene. Skilled Animation
Team: Prolific Studio’s 3D team used stylized realism to convey emotional nuance, creating lifelike
characters with subtle animations and expressive facial rigs. Lighting and textures were crafted to
reflect the warmth of island life and youthful energy. Iterative Feedback Process: We involved Gregg
throughout the pipeline, from character modeling and animatics to scene blocking and rendering. His
feedback helped guide emotional accuracy and ensure the pacing hit every important beat of their
journey. Optimization for Game Engine: The final video was delivered in multiple formats, optimized
for personal playback, digital screening, and potential future festival submissions. Sound design
was kept intimate, supporting the story’s emotional tone without overshadowing it.

## Results and SuccessResults and Success

The final 3D animation became more than a personal tribute — it was a cinematic love letter to a
real relationship. Gregg described the film as “emotional, timeless, and incredibly true to how it
all happened.” The project showcased Prolific Studio’s ability to turn real-life experiences into
meaningful animated stories, combining technical artistry with human emotion in every frame.

### How We Are Improving Your Healthcare Experience

Q What Kind of Healthcare Plans does Redirect Health Offer?
A

Redirect Health offers a variety of healthcare plans suitable for individuals and businesses,
featuring benefits like $0 copays for routine care, and low deductibles for hospitalization. These
plans are designed for affordability and to provide comprehensive benefits, ensuring easy access to
quality healthcare services for a fixed, low monthly price.

Q Redirect Health Seems Too Good to Be True. What’s the Deal?
A

Redirect Health’s approach to healthcare focuses on eliminating administrative waste, ensuring that
our members aren’t burdened with unnecessary costs. We streamline the process to identify the most
cost-efficient solutions for common healthcare needs. This means “redirecting” care towards more
effective and economical options, without compromising on the quality of service. Our strategy is to
provide high-quality healthcare that is both affordable and accessible.

Q What Exactly Does Redirect Health Do Differently?
A

At Redirect Health, we differentiate ourselves by ensuring all members have access to healthcare
consultant advocates, ready to provide the right level of care. Our members can easily reach out via
the [Redirect Health Member App][62], or by calling or texting us 24/7, in both English and Spanish.
These advocates specialize in guiding members to the most suitable healthcare options, ensuring they
never pay more than they should. Our unique approach is focused on making healthcare accessible,
efficient, and affordable for everyone.

Q What if I Need Support Outside of My Healthcare Plan Benefits?
A

At Redirect Health, we understand that healthcare needs can extend beyond basic coverage. That’s why
our plans are designed with no copays on routine care and low deductibles for hospitalization,
ensuring affordability and comprehensive care. Beyond these benefits, our ‘Impact Together’ program
provides an additional layer of support. This includes aid during medical treatments or recovery, as
well as assistance during various non-medical challenges. Through Impact Together, members can tap
into a strong support system within Redirect Health and their own community, receiving financial,
physical, and emotional help when needed. Learn more about how you can leverage this supportive
network in times of need by visiting [Redirecthealth.com/impact-together][63].

# About Springer

Springer is a leading global academic and scientific publisher, providing researchers and
professionals in academia, scientific institutions, and corporate R&D departments with quality
content through innovative information, products, and services.

Springer offers one of the world’s most extensive collections of eBooks covering science,
technology, medicine, humanities, and social sciences, and a comprehensive range of over 220,000
books and more than 2,700 journals.

## Supporting the research community

Springer is part of Springer Nature, a global publisher that serves and supports the research
community. Springer Nature aims to advance discovery by publishing robust and insightful science,
supporting the development of new areas of research and making ideas and knowledge accessible around
the world.

## 180 years of community-focused innovation

Springer has been at the forefront of scholarly publishing for nearly two centuries — supporting
authors and pioneering digital access and open science.

We led the way in digitisation and discoverability, launching one of the earliest online platforms
dedicated to academic research. Springer was also the first publisher to digitise its entire back
catalogue, making over 100,000 titles — dating back to the 1840s — accessible to researchers
worldwide.

Our commitment to innovation continued with the introduction of new models for eBooks and access,
and the launch of many Springer open access titles following the acquisition of [BMC][59] in the
mid-2000s. This positioned Springer as the largest open access publisher at the time, and a
trailblazer in creating sustainable routes to open access publishing for all.

Springer’s legacy is rooted in a strong social mission — from Julius Springer’s advocacy for
copyright reform in the 1840s to our ongoing engagement with communities, policymakers, and
organisations to champion open access and sustainable publishing today.

## Springer’s German-language brands

You can publish with Springer in German to reach one of Europe’s largest academic and professional
audiences and gain visibility in a market known for high-quality scientific and specialist content.
Springer’s German-language brands are the pride of its long, respected heritage and established
author/editor network.

## Before you ask what Staple costs, calculate what you are spending now

### Manual data entry errors cost $50+ each to correct

Identifying the error, tracing it to the source document, correcting the ERP entry, notifying
affected parties, and re-reconciling downstream.

### The headcount problem scales with volume.

Without automation, every new market adds documents, languages, and headcount. With Staple, your
team stays flat as volume doubles.

### Run your own numbers

Your monthly document volume × error rate × $50 = monthly correction cost

A team processing 100,000 documents a month at a 1% error rate spends $50,000 a month, or $600,000 a
year, on corrections alone.

How does pricing work?

Three plans: Standard starts at $6,000 per year. Premium and Customised are priced on volume and
requirements. Every plan includes data extraction, SAP integration, and 300+ language support.

What accuracy can I expect on my documents?

Accuracy depends on document type and language mix. On standard digital documents, extraction
accuracy exceeds 95%. On multilingual documents Staple reached 99.6%. Bring your documents to a demo
and we will run extractions on your actual files.

What compliance certifications does Staple hold?

SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, HIPAA, GDPR, and Peppol. SSO and role-based access control as
standard. Dedicated China instance for data residency. IMDA Spark accredited by the Singapore
government. No rebuild required. We carry the audit scope your board expects.

How long is the minimum contract?

Standard plan requires a 3-year commitment. Premium and Customised plans are scoped to your
requirements.

## See what Staple costs for your deployment

Book a 30-minute demo with a document processing specialist. Bring your document volume, language
mix, and current systems. We will give you a clear picture of cost with extraction accuracy on your
actual files.

About us

# Built to make audits boring

We founded Staple to solve one problem: regulated enterprises were processing thousands of documents
per month with tools that generated risk instead of defensible records. Every tool on the market
extracted data. None of them could prove where it came from.

[Background Image]

Document processing is a compliance problem now. Most document processors are generative: they
extract data without producing a defensible evidence chain. No trail, no verifiable logic, no proof
the extraction is correct. Add different jurisdictions and multilingual documents, and the risk
compounds.

Traditional document processors retrofit compliance on top of generative engines.

We built Staple from day one as compliance infrastructure: deterministic by construction, certified
to the standards your auditors require, with cryptographic signatures on every field.

Every extracted value carries a defensible record, which you can query on demand without
reconstructing the trail from emails and screenshots.

## Leadership Team

39 people
One focus: defensible document processing.

### Ben Stein

CEO and Co-founder

[Person Photo]

Accounting, law, and software. CFO and consultant at KPMG advising enterprise clients on pre- and
post-merger integration across Singapore, India, Australia, Korea, the UK, Hong Kong, and Japan. He
founded Staple after seeing what manual document processing costs at scale, and what happens when
document processing tools fail on the documents enterprises generate.

Show bio

### Dr Josh Kettlewell

CTO and Co-founder

[Person Photo]

PhD computer scientist specialising in machine learning, cryptography, and quantum computing.
Research positions at MIT-SUTD and NUS in Singapore, published in academic journals. He designed
Staple's core extraction models to train natively on Asian document formats rather than adapt from
Latin-script engines.

Show bio

### Boon Thai Hoh

CRO

[Person Photo]

An early employee and COO of SAP in Asia, BT is an experienced enterprise software specialist who
joined Staple to build the go-to-market and SAP platform relationships.

Show bio

### Anurag Srivastava

Industry Advisor

[Person Photo]

Former Head of Region for Kofax and advisor to AiDA Technologies, where he supported AiDA's exit to
Amplify Health. Advises Staple on partnerships and go-to-market strategy.

Show bio

# AP automation across every format your suppliers send

Invoices, POs, and delivery notes from paper, PDF, and mandated e-invoice networks around the world.
Staple extracts, reconciles, and pushes validated data into your existing AP system. Every
extraction carries a defensible record.

Book a Demo
[Hero Image]

## The AP team's daily grind

Documents arrive from suppliers as PDFs, e-invoices or paper and your team matches them by hand. The
delivery note doesn't match the PO, so someone opens a spreadsheet.

* At $50+ per error to find, correct, and re-process, the cost scales with every new supplier.
* Every new market also means a new e-invoicing mandate, a new tax authority, and a new set of
rules. Your ERP doesn't connect to them, so your team validates manually or buys a point solution
for each one.
* When an auditor asks where a figure came from, reconstructing the trail from email threads and
shared drives takes days.

## How Staple handles AP

### Line-item matching

PO, delivery note, invoice, receipt, and contract matched on one screen with automatic discrepancy
detection. Not just totals, but line by line. Quantity mismatches, price variances and partial
shipments flagged before they reach your systems. No more spreadsheet reconciliation.

See how document matching works
[Card Image]

### E-invoicing compliance built in

Staple connects to tax authorities worldwide, from Peppol in Ireland, to InvoiceNow in Singapore and
CFDI in Mexico. E-invoices are validated with the relevant tax authority and reconciled with your
purchase orders and receipts in the same workflow as your PDF and paper invoices.

[Card Image]

### Defensible record for every extraction

The source document, extraction model version, timestamp, and a cryptographic signature is attached
to every field, from inbox to ERP. When an auditor asks where a figure came from, you query it. You
don't reconstruct it.

See how extraction evidence works
[Card Image]

### Native multilingual processing

Bahasa, Chinese, Korean, Thai and Vietnamese, including handwriting and rubber stamps. Vendor
documents from anywhere in your supply chain without bilingual staff.

See multilingual processing
[Card Image]

### Built-in SAP Concur integration

Three dedicated modules on the SAP Concur App Center across 30+ countries. Staple processes the
documents and SAP runs your workflow. No middleware, no custom development.

See SAP integration
[Card Image]
[Card Image]

Paper, PDFs, and e-invoices are validated against the relevant tax authority in the same pipeline.

Your customer sends a payment with a remittance telling you which invoices it covers. It could be in
English. It could also be a PDF in Thai, a scan in Chinese, or a spreadsheet with no structure.

Your team opens the bank statement, the remittance, the ledger, and reconciles manually. Short
payments, disputed line items, unapplied credit notes add hours of manual work every cycle.

Then there’s e-invoicing regulations. You now need to submit invoices to the tax authority, while
receiving validated e-invoices from suppliers in formats your ERP doesn't process natively. So your
team runs a separate submission process for each jurisdiction.

The longer it takes, the longer you wait for an accurate view of your cash flow.

automatically. No per-customer configuration.

generate the required unique ID or QR code. The e-invoice is delivered to your customer via Peppol,
API, or email. It’s the same platform that validates inbound supplier e-invoices in AP. One platform
and one workflow for both directions.

[Card Image]

Every field lands with its source document, model version, timestamp and cryptographic signature
attached. When Compliance asks where a figure came from, your team queries it, they don’t
reconstruct.

Customer remittances in Bahasa, Chinese, Korean, Thai, and Vietnamese are processed natively.
No translation workflow.

Customer payments matched against sales invoices, remittance advice, bank statement entries, and
credit notes simultaneously. Short payments, unapplied credits, and line item mismatches identified.

Reconciled AR data is pushed into SAP Concur and your ERP. Staple processes the documents and your

# Verify every document before the loan is approved

Automated extraction, tamper detection, and anomaly checks across any bank statement or credit
report. Every field is verified with evidence before the credit decision is made.

Book a Demo
[Hero Image]

## The problem

Your loan officers and credit analysts work from bank statements and reports to build the case for
every approval. The balances, transaction histories, repayment patterns feed directly into credit
decisions. But the documents themselves can be fabricated, altered, or inconsistent. Manual reviews
are no match for the sophistication or pace of modern loan fraud.

**Manual reviews can't keep up.** Every loan application adds documents that need to be verified,
not just extracted. Your team can check the figures, but they cannot inspect pixel-level tampering
or spot contradictions between documents.

**Most tools don't verify what they extract.** They extract the data on the page. They don't check
whether the document has been altered, whether figures are internally consistent, or whether income
on a bank statement contradicts a credit report. Extraction without verification passes risk
straight to the loan approval.

**Regulators require document trails.** When an auditor pulls a loan file, every extracted figure
needs to trace back to the original statement, not to a spreadsheet your team reconstructed.

## What Staple does

### Structured extraction from any format, any bank

Scanned PDFs, digital exports, photographs, and
dot-matrix statements. No templates. Statements: opening and closing balances, transaction lines,
account holder, period, currency, bank identifiers. Credit reports: scores, payment history,
outstanding obligations.

[Card Image]

### An audit trail for every field

Verifiable record for every extracted value, which you can produce on demand.

[Card Image]

### Multilingual processing

Bahasa, Chinese, Korean, Thai and Vietnamese with native language models trained on Asian financial
documents. A Thai baht amount formatted as “฿1,250,000.00” and one formatted as “1,250,000.00 บาท”
are recognised as the same figure.

See multilingual processing
[Card Image]

### Document matching for financial workflows

Bank statements are cross-checked against credit reports and KYC documents with a field-by-field
comparison on account numbers, balances, and transaction totals. Discrepancies are highlighted
automatically.

# Verify identity documents across every format

Extract and verify passports, national IDs, work permits, and handwritten forms in 300+ languages.
Covers all formats regulators worldwide require.

Book a Demo
[Hero Image]

## The KYC challenge

Every jurisdiction has its own identity documents with formats, fields, scripts and legal
requirements that change at every border.

**Manual processing that doesn't scale.** Your current process handles the documents your team can
read. The rest go to a manual queue, back to the applicant, or through an external bureau that adds
days to onboarding. Every new market adds new formats and new languages to the backlog.

**Regulators want evidence, not screenshots. **Every jurisdiction requires documented, traceable
evidence of identity verification, producible on demand during an audit. Your current process might
produce the verification but not the trail.

**The trail is the hard part. **When an examiner asks how a name was extracted from an identity
document, or why a field was accepted at a specific confidence level, your team reconstructs the
answer from email threads and manual logs. That reconstruction is the compliance risk.

## What Staple processes

### National identity documents

Singapore NRIC

Malaysian MyKad

Thai บัตรประชาชน

Hong Kong HKID

Chinese 居民身份证

Indonesian KTP

Philippine PSA-issued ID

Vietnamese CCCD

South Korean 주민등록증

[Content Image]

### Travel documents

Passports, visa stamps, entry/exit endorsements.

[Content Image]

### Work authorisation

Employment passes and work permits.

[Content Image]

### Supporting KYC documents

Bank statements, utility bills and corporate registration documents.

[Content Image]

Handwriting, rubber stamps, worn documents, and mixed-language fields. Staple extracts the data and
pushes verified records into your onboarding system. New document type, new jurisdiction? Same
process.

See multilingual processing
][3]
[Content Image]

## How Staple handles KYC

### Automated classification and field mapping

Each document is identified by type and jurisdiction. Fields are extracted and mapped to the fields
your system expects, such as name, date of birth, document number, expiry, issuing authority. There
is no manual sorting and no routing by document type before processing.

[Card Image]

### Reconciliation against source records

Extracted fields are cross-checked against the source document at the field level, with confidence
scores, model version, and a cryptographic signature attached to every data point. When an examiner
asks how a name was extracted from an old identity document, you just query the record. You don't
reconstruct it from email threads.

[Card Image]

### Direct integration into your onboarding system

Verified records push into your existing business systems structured, field-mapped, and audit-ready.
There are no additional steps or files. The data moves from source document to system entry with the
audit trail built in.

[Card Image]
[Card Image]

## Extractions that hold up under scrutiny

### ISO 42001 certification

AI extraction decisions documented: how the model was trained, how confidence is scored, how edge
cases escalate. When an examiner asks why a field was extracted, you answer with a verifiable
record, not a shrug.

### Field-level audit trail

Every data point verifiable from source document to system record. Producible on demand, not
reconstructed from email threads.

## Common questions

How does automated invoice processing work in a multi-country AP operation?

Automated invoice processing captures structured data from invoices arriving in any format,
language, or layout and delivers it into the AP system without manual entry. In a multi-country
operation, the challenge is not just volume but variety: different formats per supplier, different
languages per country, and different e-invoice mandates per jurisdiction. A capable system handles
all of them in a single flow, extracting header fields and line items, validating against purchase
orders and delivery notes, connecting to tax authority networks for e-invoice compliance, and
feeding verified, audit-ready data into the ERP. Staple does this across 300+ languages and 12
countries in one pipeline, with no manual entry step and a full audit trail on every field.

What is three-way matching in invoice processing and why does it matter?

Three-way matching is the process of cross-checking an invoice against its corresponding purchase
order and goods receipt note to confirm that what was ordered, received, and billed are consistent
at the line-item level. When quantities, prices, or terms do not match, the discrepancy is flagged
before payment is approved. Without automated three-way matching, AP teams reconcile these documents
manually in spreadsheets, which is the primary source of month-end close delay in high-volume
operations. Staple performs three-way matching automatically across invoices, POs, and delivery
notes, flagging every variance before data reaches the ERP.

Why do template-based OCR tools fail in multi-country invoice processing?

Template-based OCR tools require a pre-configured template for each supplier's invoice layout. When
a supplier changes their format, adds a new field, or sends an invoice in a different language, the
template breaks and extraction fails. In a multi-country AP operation with hundreds of suppliers
across different countries sending invoices in inconsistent formats and languages, maintaining
accurate templates is a full-time job that scales with every new supplier added. Context-based
extraction reads what a field means rather than where it sits on the page, so accuracy holds
regardless of layout variation, language, or document type. Staple uses context-aware extraction
across all invoice formats, eliminating the need for per-supplier template configuration.

How do enterprises handle e-invoice compliance alongside paper invoice processing without a separate
tool for every country?

E-invoice mandates require invoices to be submitted to a government tax authority for validation
before they are legally recognised as a transaction. Each country has its own mandate, its own tax
authority network, and its own submission protocol: Singapore uses InvoiceNow, Malaysia uses
MyInvois, India uses IRP, and requirements differ further across France, Germany, Poland, and the
UAE. Managing these separately requires country-specific integrations and ongoing compliance
maintenance every time regulations change. A unified invoice processing platform connects to all
relevant tax authority networks while handling paper and PDF invoices in the same flow, so every
invoice type is processed, validated, and reconciled in one place. Staple covers e-invoice
compliance across 12 countries alongside paper and PDF invoices with no separate tool per mandate.

What does an audit-ready invoice processing system actually require?

An audit-ready invoice processing system must produce more than accurate data. It must be able to
demonstrate, for every extracted field, exactly where the figure came from, which model version
extracted it, what confidence score it carried, who reviewed it, and when it was processed. This
processing history must travel with the output and be cryptographically sealed so that any
unauthorised change after the fact is immediately visible. When a payment is disputed, a line item
is questioned, or a regulator asks why a figure in the ERP differs from the original invoice, the
answer must already be in the data. Staple enforces this at the field level across every invoice it
processes, making the audit trail a property of the output rather than something reconstructed from
email threads and shared drives.

What is the difference between invoice data extraction and invoice data verification?

Invoice data extraction converts the content of an invoice into structured digital fields: vendor
name, invoice number, line items, quantities, unit prices, and totals. Extraction answers the
question of what the document says whereas invoice data verification checks whether what was
extracted is accurate, consistent, and trustworthy.

Verification answers the question of whether the data can be relied upon. It includes AI contextual
checks that understand the meaning of each transaction, cross-source reconciliation against purchase
orders and delivery notes, business rules that flag anomalies against your thresholds, and external
validation against tax authorities for e-invoices. Most invoice processing tools stop at extraction.

Without verification, extracted data can contain errors, falsified figures, or inconsistencies that
only surface during an audit or a disputed payment. Staple performs both extraction and verification
in a single pipeline before data reaches the ERP.

How does Staple integrate with ERP systems like SAP, Oracle, and Concur?

Staple connects to existing ERP and AP systems via three pre-built SAP modules and a native API. No
middleware is required and no custom development is needed on the ERP side. Verified invoice data is
delivered into SAP, Oracle, Concur, Coupa, and Yonyou in the structured format each system expects,
eliminating the manual entry step that sits between document receipt and ERP input. The existing AP
workflow stays in place. Staple sits at the front end of that workflow, handling the document intake
and data preparation step that ERP systems were never built to perform. For enterprises running
multiple ERP instances across countries, Staple feeds each system from a single extraction and
verification pipeline.

How long does implementing automated invoice processing typically take?

Implementation timelines for automated invoice processing depend on the complexity of the existing
AP stack, the number of ERP systems that need to receive data, and the volume and variety of invoice
types in scope.

For enterprises connecting Staple to a single ERP instance, most implementations go live within
weeks.

For multi-country operations involving multiple ERP systems, e-invoice mandates across
jurisdictions, and high document variety, a phased implementation approach is standard: one country
or entity goes live first, the configuration is validated against real documents, and additional
markets are added progressively. No workflow upheaval is required. Staple slots into the existing
document intake process as the extraction and verification layer, without replacing the systems
downstream.

## Common questions

What does "one global data processing platform" actually mean for an enterprise?

It means replacing a fragmented stack of point solutions: OCR tool, e-invoice compliance platform,
translation service, reconciliation system, exception spreadsheets with a single platform that
handles document verification, extraction, translation, business rules verification, reconciliation,
and e-invoice compliance in one workflow. It does not mean replacing the ERP, the AP system, or the
compliance platform. It means replacing the extraction and verification layer that sits in front of
all of them. Every downstream system receives consistent, verified, audit-ready data from one
source, with one audit trail running across every document type and every country.

Why do enterprises end up running multiple disconnected document processing tools?

Enterprises accumulate document processing tools incrementally: an OCR tool for invoice scanning, a
translation service for multilingual documents, a country-specific compliance integration when a new
mandate arrives, a separate workflow for AML review, and spreadsheets for exceptions none of the
tools handle cleanly. Each decision was rational at the time. The result is a stack no single team
owns, that nobody can audit end-to-end, and that grows more expensive with every new country or
document type added. The tools were not designed to connect to each other. The audit trail stops at
the edge of each vendor's system.

What triggers document processing consolidation in a global enterprise?

Consolidation is rarely triggered by cost. The actual triggers are regulatory deadlines that expose
gaps in the current stack, audit moments where a regulator asks for a field-level audit trail that
cannot be produced, and data inconsistency that becomes undeniable during expansion into a new
country. Enterprises living with a fragmented stack for years do not consolidate until one of these
moments makes the status quo more expensive than change. The audit moment converts chronic
operational pain into an active budget priority. Cost becomes a factor during procurement
negotiations, not before.

What is document tamper checking and why does it need to happen before extraction?

Document tamper checking determines whether the document container itself has been altered before
any data is extracted from it. File metadata analysis and image anomaly detection identify whether a
document has been forged, modified, or substituted after issue. If tamper checking happens after
extraction, the data has already been processed from a potentially compromised source. Checking the
document first ensures that the extraction, verification, and audit trail that follow are built on a
document that can be trusted. For invoices, KYC files, and compliance packs, this is the first layer
of the audit trail.

What is the difference between data extraction and data verification?

Data extraction reads structured fields from an unstructured document: supplier name, invoice total,
line items, and account numbers. Data verification checks whether the extracted values are correct
and consistent. Extraction can be accurate and the data can still be wrong: a falsified invoice
figure extracts cleanly but fails verification when checked against the PO or master data. Staple
applies both layers to every document: context-aware extraction that handles any format or layout,
followed by AI contextual verification, business rules checks, and cross-source reconciliation that
confirm the extracted data before it reaches any downstream system.

How does Staple handle e-invoice compliance across different countries without a separate
integration for each?

Country-specific e-invoice mandates (different formats, different tax authority connections, and
different submission requirements) are absorbed into the platform and maintained by Staple.
Regulations change, new mandates are introduced, and technical schemas update automatically without
triggering a new IT project. AP and AR e-invoice flows across Europe, LATAM, and APAC are unified
under one schema. A global enterprise deploys once and extends to new countries within the same
platform. No new vendor, no new integration, no separate audit trail.

What is a tamper-evident audit trail and why do regulators require it?

A tamper-evident audit trail is a sealed, unalterable record of what was extracted from every
document, by which process, under which rules, at what time, and with what verification result. It
is applied uniformly across all document types, use cases, and countries. Regulators do not accept
partial records. When asked to demonstrate what was extracted and when, the answer must be complete
regardless of whether the document was an invoice processed six months ago or a KYC pack processed
last week. Running multiple tools produces multiple incompatible records. Staple embeds the unified
tamper-evident audit trail at the field level across every document it processes.

How does Staple integrate with existing ERP and compliance systems?

Staple sits at the front of the existing technology stack, between document receipt and system
input. It replaces the extraction and verification layer that was never built into those systems.
Verified, audit-ready data is delivered into downstream systems (such as ERP, AP workflow,
compliance platform, fund administration systems) via pre-built SAP modules and native API, in the
structured format each system expects. No system replacement or workflow rebuild. The ERP continues
to operate as the system of record. Staple handles what those systems were never built to perform:
taking unstructured documents and producing verified, audit-ready data.

Process e-invoices, PDFs, and paper documents. Connect to tax authorities worldwide and manage AP
and AR invoice workflows in one place.

## Global e-invoicing is becoming harder to manage

Finance teams are stuck managing multiple tools, formats, and regulations for each country. The
complexity scales faster than the team

High maintenance costs and ops inefficiency

Managing separate systems for paper, PDF, and e-invoices across different countries forces teams
into manual, error-prone workflows to bridge the gaps between disconnected platforms.

Constant burden of evolving global mandates

Staying ahead of rapidly changing e-invoice regulations is an impossible task for internal teams.
Every update triggers a new IT project, distracting the team and increasing the risk of an audit
failure.

Increased financial risk and tax leakage

Miscalculating tax across jurisdictions leads to rejected submissions and missed tax credits.
Without automated e-invoice validation, companies can face direct financial loss and non-compliance
penalties.

Inability to scale or centralize operations

The lack of a unified global standard prevents centralizing processing into a Shared Service Centre
(SSC). Localized handling requirements create bottlenecks that stop the team from achieving
operational scale.

## Same backbone. Both directions.

In AR automation, Staple issues e-invoices to customers after submission to tax authorities. In AP
automation, Staple receives and validates supplier paper and e-invoices with tax authorities.

Without Staple, you need to build custom mapping for every country. With Staple, we map once, and
the same structure works everywhere thanks to a standardized JSON format that can receive data from
and connect to any tax authority worldwide, including PEPPOL.

About us

# Built to make audits boring

We founded Staple to solve one problem: regulated enterprises were processing thousands of documents
per month with tools that generated risk instead of defensible records. Every tool on the market
extracted data. None of them could prove where it came from.

[Background Image]

Document processing is a compliance problem now. Most document processors are generative: they
extract data without producing a defensible evidence chain. No trail, no verifiable logic, no proof
the extraction is correct. Add different jurisdictions and multilingual documents, and the risk
compounds.

Traditional document processors retrofit compliance on top of generative engines.

We built Staple from day one as compliance infrastructure: deterministic by construction, certified
to the standards your auditors require, with cryptographic signatures on every field.

Every extracted value carries a defensible record, which you can query on demand without
reconstructing the trail from emails and screenshots.

## Questions from enterprise evaluators

What happens in the demo?

This is a 30-minute session with a document processing specialist from Staple. We walk through the
platform and run live extractions on your documents, if you bring them. You will see accuracy on
your actual files, not a canned dataset.

Who should attend?

Whoever owns the document processing workflow. That is usually the AP or operations lead, sometimes
with IT or procurement. Bring the person who can describe the current pain. They get the most from
the session.

How does pricing work?

Three plans: Standard starts at $6,000 per year. Premium and Customised are priced on volume and
requirements. Every plan includes data extraction, SAP integration, and 300+ language support. [See
Pricing][3]

What accuracy can I expect on my documents?

Accuracy depends on document type and language mix. On standard digital documents, extraction
accuracy exceeds 95%. On multilingual documents Staple reached 99.6%. Bring your documents to a demo
and we will run extractions on your actual files.

What compliance certifications does Staple hold?

SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, HIPAA, GDPR, and Peppol. SSO and role-based access control as
standard. Dedicated China instance for data residency. IMDA Spark accredited by the Singapore
government. No rebuild required; we carry the audit scope your board expects.

How long is the minimum contract?

Standard plan requires a 3-year commitment. Premium and Customised plans are scoped to your
requirements.

# What Happened to Top Moving Van Lines?

Top Moving Van Lines is closed. Free Consumer Advocate help recovering deposits and finding vetted
movers. Call (913) 222-8908 for human guidance.

## About What Happened to Top Moving Van Lines? from Home Moving Now

Home Moving Now is an independent consumer advocate for households planning a move. We research
moving companies, auto transport carriers, storage providers, and packing services so consumers can
compare options without sales pressure. Our team verifies USDOT and MC numbers through the FMCSA,
reviews insurance and bonding, checks complaint history, and surfaces red flags like unrealistic
lowball quotes, large up-front cash deposits, and broker bait-and-switch tactics.

This page on What Happened to Top Moving Van Lines? is part of our complete moving education
library. Use it alongside our cost calculator, scam-prevention guides, broker deposit recovery
resources, and vetted partner directory. If you are comparing local movers, long distance carriers,
container companies like PODS and U-Pack, freight trailer options, truck rentals from U-Haul,
Penske, Budget, Ryder, or Enterprise, or full-service interstate van lines, we can help you weigh
the trade-offs honestly.

Need free help right now? Call our consumer advocate team at (913) 222-8908 or visit
https://www.homemovingnow.com for vetted moving quotes, cost estimates, and step-by-step planning
checklists. We never sell your information to rogue brokers, and our recommendations are based on
documented carrier performance, not pay-to-play placement.

all_classified.company_summary: Treehugger is a comprehensive online resource dedicated to promoting sustainable living and environmental awareness. The platform offers a wide range of content covering topics such as eco-friendly home design, conservation, clean beauty, and sustainable practices in various industries. Targeting environmentally conscious individuals and communities, Treehugger aims to educate and inspire its audience to adopt greener lifestyles and make informed choices for the planet.

##### 📢 Important Update

The facility for Direct UAN Allotment through this portal has been discontinued.

You can now easily generate your UAN through Aadhaar-based Face Authentication (FAT) on the **UMANG
App**.

To proceed:

##### 📢 महत्वपूर्ण सूचना

इस पोर्टल के माध्यम से प्रत्यक्ष यूएएन आवंटन (Direct UAN Allotment) की सुविधा बंद कर दी गई है।

अब आप आधार आधारित फेस ऑथेंटिकेशन (Face Authentication - FAT) के माध्यम से यूएएन आसानी से **UMANG ऐप** पर जनरेट
